hinglish_roman: Ek car rest se 5 s mein ek samaan dar se 20 m/s tak tez hoti hai, 10 s tak 20 m/s pe chalti hai, phir 6 s mein ek samaan dar se brake lagakar rukti hai. Kul tay doori nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A car on a highway moves at a constant 6 m/s for 2 minutes, then accelerates at 1 m/s² for 6 s. Find its displacement in the 2 min 6 s interval.
hinglish_roman: Highway pe ek car 2 minute tak sthir 6 m/s se chalti hai, phir 6 s tak 1 m/s² se accelerate karti hai. 2 min 6 s mein uska displacement nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: Cars A and B start from rest with constant acceleration. A reaches 5 m/s in 5 s; B reaches 3 m/s in 10 s. Find each car's acceleration and its displacement in its time interval.
hinglish_roman: Cars A aur B rest se sthir acceleration se chalti hain. A 5 s mein 5 m/s tak pahunchti hai; B 10 s mein 3 m/s tak. Har car ka acceleration aur uske samay antaraal mein displacement nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: What factors affect the stopping distance of a vehicle? Why must we keep a safe distance from the vehicle ahead?
hinglish_roman: Gaadi ki rukne ki doori kin baaton pe nirbhar karti hai? Aage wali gaadi se surakshit doori kyun rakhni chahiye?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is uniform circular motion? Why is it called accelerated motion even though the speed is constant?
hinglish_roman: Uniform circular motion kya hai? Speed sthir hone pe bhi ise accelerated motion kyun kehte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: For an object in uniform circular motion of radius R, write the formula for its speed. Find the speed if R = 7 m and one revolution takes 22 s.
hinglish_roman: R radius ki uniform circular motion mein object ki speed ka formula likho. Agar R = 7 m aur ek chakkar 22 s mein ho toh speed nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: Rohan studies from 6 PM to 7:30 PM. For the tip of a 7 cm long minute hand, find the distance travelled, displacement, average speed and magnitude of average velocity in this interval. (Use π = 22/7)
hinglish_roman: Rohan shaam 6 se 7:30 baje tak padhta hai. 7 cm lambi minute ki sui ki nok ke liye is antaraal mein tay doori, displacement, average speed aur average velocity ka magnitude nikaalo. (π = 22/7 lo)

subject: Physics
original_english: A marble moving around the inside of a ring keeps going in a circle. What happens when the ring is lifted, and why?
hinglish_roman: Ring ke andar ghoomti goli gol chakkar lagaati rehti hai. Ring uthaane pe kya hota hai, aur kyun?

subject: Physics
original_english: Give examples of motion in one, two and three dimensions.
hinglish_roman: Ek, do aur teen dimensions mein motion ke examples do.

subject: Physics
original_english: Which statement about displacement is true? (i) It is never zero (ii) Its magnitude can be greater than the distance travelled (iii) Its magnitude is less than or equal to the distance travelled (iv) Its magnitude is always less than the distance travelled
hinglish_roman: Displacement ke baare mein kaun sa kathan sahi hai? (i) Yeh kabhi zero nahi hota (ii) Iska magnitude distance se zyada ho sakta hai (iii) Iska magnitude distance ke barabar ya kam hota hai (iv) Iska magnitude hamesha distance se kam hota hai

subject: Physics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: The slope of a position-time graph gives ______, the slope of a velocity-time graph gives ______, and the area under a velocity-time graph gives ______.
hinglish_roman: Blank bharo: Position-time graph ka slope ______ deta hai, velocity-time graph ka slope ______ deta hai, aur velocity-time graph ke neeche ka area ______ deta hai.

subject: Physics
original_english: Assertion (A): A body in uniform circular motion has an acceleration. Reason (R): In uniform circular motion, the speed of the body keeps changing. Choose: (i) Both true, R explains A (ii) Both true, R does not explain A (iii) A true, R false (iv) A false, R true
hinglish_roman: Assertion (A): Uniform circular motion mein body ka acceleration hota hai. Reason (R): Uniform circular motion mein body ki speed badalti rehti hai. Chuno: (i) Dono sahi, R A ko samjhata hai (ii) Dono sahi, R A ko nahi samjhata (iii) A sahi, R galat (iv) A galat, R sahi

subject: Physics
original_english: What can a force do to an object? Why must the direction of a force be specified?
hinglish_roman: Force kisi object pe kya kar sakta hai? Force ki disha batana kyun zaroori hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: How can the magnitude of a force be measured? What is weight?
hinglish_roman: Force ka magnitude kaise naapa ja sakta hai? Weight kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: What are balanced and unbalanced forces? Explain with a tug of war.
hinglish_roman: Balanced aur unbalanced forces kya hain? Rassa-kashi se samjhao.

subject: Physics
original_english: Forces of 10 N and 6 N act on a block. Find the net force when (a) both act to the right (b) 10 N acts right and 6 N left (c) 10 N acts left and 6 N right.
hinglish_roman: Ek block pe 10 N aur 6 N ke forces lagte hain. Net force nikaalo jab (a) dono daayein ho (b) 10 N daayein aur 6 N baayein ho (c) 10 N baayein aur 6 N daayein ho.

subject: Physics
original_english: In a snake boat race practice, 100 oarsmen each apply 200 N. 95 row backwards to propel the boat forward, but 5 row in the opposite direction by mistake. What is the net force on the boat?
hinglish_roman: Snake boat race ki practice mein 100 naavik har ek 200 N lagaate hain. 95 naav ko aage badhaane ke liye peechhe chappu chalaate hain, par 5 galti se ulti disha mein chalaate hain. Naav pe net force kitna hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A weightlifter holds a barbell steady. Which forces act on the barbell, and are they balanced?
hinglish_roman: Ek weightlifter barbell ko sthir pakde hue hai. Barbell pe kaun se forces lag rahe hain, aur kya woh balanced hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: Why does a box not move when a small force is applied, and why does a moving object stop when we stop pushing it?
hinglish_roman: Thoda force lagaane pe box kyun nahi hilta, aur dhakelna band karne pe chalta object kyun ruk jaata hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: In the stack-of-coins activity, coins launched by the same stretched rubber band travel different distances on wood, laminate and marble. What does this show, and how is it confirmed with a spring balance?
hinglish_roman: Sikkon ke dher wali activity mein ek hi kheenche rubber band se chhode sikke lakdi, laminate aur marble pe alag-alag doori tay karte hain. Isse kya pata chalta hai, aur spring balance se ise kaise confirm karte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: How does friction help us walk? Why are soles and tyres grooved, and why is it hard to walk on wet polished floors or ice?
hinglish_roman: Friction humein chalne mein kaise madad karta hai? Joote ke talve aur tyres pe groove kyun hote hain, aur geele chikne farsh ya barf pe chalna mushkil kyun hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Which forces act on a box being pushed along the floor? How can friction be reduced?
hinglish_roman: Farsh pe dhakele ja rahe box pe kaun se forces lagte hain? Friction kaise kam kiya ja sakta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: State Newton's first law of motion. What is inertia?
hinglish_roman: Newton ka pehla niyam batao. Inertia kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: How did Galileo's thought experiment change the idea that a force is needed to keep an object moving?
hinglish_roman: Galileo ke thought experiment ne is vichaar ko kaise badla ki object ko chalaate rehne ke liye force chahiye?

subject: Physics
original_english: A table is moved across the floor at constant velocity using a horizontal force F. How much is the friction from the floor? What is the net force on a 100 g toy car moving at a constant 0.5 m/s?
hinglish_roman: Ek mez ko horizontal force F se farsh pe sthir velocity se chalaaya jaata hai. Farsh ka friction kitna hai? Sthir 0.5 m/s se chalti 100 g ki toy car pe net force kitna hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: If no net force acts on an object, which situations are possible? (i) It remains at rest if at rest (ii) It keeps moving with constant velocity if already moving (iii) It moves with a constant acceleration. Options: (a) only (i) (b) (i) and (ii) (c) (ii) and (iii) (d) all three
hinglish_roman: Agar kisi object pe koi net force na lage, toh kaun si sthitiyan sambhav hain? (i) Rest mein ho toh rest mein rahe (ii) Chal raha ho toh sthir velocity se chalta rahe (iii) Sthir acceleration se chale. Vikalp: (a) sirf (i) (b) (i) aur (ii) (c) (ii) aur (iii) (d) teeno

subject: Physics
original_english: True or False: An object moving with constant velocity must have a net force acting on it.
hinglish_roman: True ya False: Sthir velocity se chalte object pe net force zaroor lagna chahiye.

subject: Physics
original_english: State Newton's second law of motion and define one newton.
hinglish_roman: Newton ka doosra niyam batao aur ek newton ki paribhasha do.

subject: Physics
original_english: How do the cart experiments show the relation between force, mass and acceleration?
hinglish_roman: Cart wale experiments force, mass aur acceleration ka sambandh kaise dikhaate hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: A barbell has 10 kg fixed on each side of a 10 kg bar. How much force must a weightlifter apply to hold it steady? (g = 9.8 m/s²)
hinglish_roman: Ek barbell mein 10 kg ki rod ke dono taraf 10-10 kg lage hain. Use sthir pakadne ke liye weightlifter ko kitna force lagaana hoga? (g = 9.8 m/s²)

subject: Physics
original_english: A 25 kg block rests on a floor where the maximum friction is 50 N. Find its displacement in 2 s if pushed with a constant force of (i) 50 N and (ii) 55 N.
hinglish_roman: 25 kg ka block farsh pe rakha hai jahan maximum friction 50 N hai. Agar use (i) 50 N aur (ii) 55 N ke sthir force se dhakela jaaye, toh 2 s mein uska displacement nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A 1500 kg sports car moving east speeds up from rest to 10 m/s in 5 s, moves at constant velocity from 5 s to 10 s, and slows to rest from 10 s to 15 s. Find the force on it in each interval.
hinglish_roman: Poorab ki taraf chalti 1500 kg ki sports car 5 s mein rest se 10 m/s tak tez hoti hai, 5 se 10 s tak sthir velocity se chalti hai, aur 10 se 15 s mein rukti hai. Har antaraal mein us pe force nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A 50 g bullet moving at 100 m/s enters a wooden block and stops after penetrating 50 cm. Estimate the stopping force, assuming constant acceleration.
hinglish_roman: 100 m/s se chalti 50 g ki goli lakdi ke block mein 50 cm ghuskar ruk jaati hai. Sthir acceleration maankar rokne wale force ka andaaza lagao.

subject: Physics
original_english: A footballer kicks a 0.4 kg ball from rest to 108 km/h with an estimated force of 800 N. Find the time of contact between foot and ball.
hinglish_roman: Ek footballer 0.4 kg ki gend ko rest se 108 km/h tak lagbhag 800 N ke force se maarta hai. Pair aur gend ke sampark ka samay nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A 2 kg object moving at a constant 10 m/s enters a rough patch with 7 N friction, and at the same time an extra 3 N force opposing the motion is applied. How far does it travel before stopping?
hinglish_roman: Sthir 10 m/s se chalta 2 kg ka object 7 N friction wale khurdure hisse mein aata hai, aur usi samay motion ke khilaaf 3 N ka extra force lagaaya jaata hai. Rukne se pehle woh kitni door jaayega?

subject: Physics
original_english: Why does a fielder pull the hands back while catching a fast ball? How do airbags and landing mats reduce injury?
hinglish_roman: Tez gend pakadte waqt fielder haath peechhe kyun kheenchta hai? Airbags aur landing mats chot kaise kam karte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is momentum, and how is Newton's second law stated in terms of momentum?
hinglish_roman: Momentum kya hai, aur momentum ke roop mein Newton ka doosra niyam kaise likha jaata hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Two children of different masses sit on identical swings. To give both the same initial acceleration, which child needs a larger push, and why?
hinglish_roman: Alag mass ke do bachche ek jaise jhoolon pe baithe hain. Dono ko same shuruaati acceleration dene ke liye kise zyada dhakka chahiye, aur kyun?

subject: Physics
original_english: When a net force acts on an object, it accelerates: (i) opposite to the force, with acceleration proportional to the force (ii) opposite to the force, with acceleration proportional to the mass (iii) in the direction of the force, with acceleration inversely proportional to the force (iv) in the direction of the force, with acceleration proportional to the force
hinglish_roman: Jab kisi object pe net force lagta hai, toh woh accelerate karta hai: (i) force ke ulta, acceleration force ke anupaati (ii) force ke ulta, acceleration mass ke anupaati (iii) force ki disha mein, acceleration force ke vyutkramaanupaati (iv) force ki disha mein, acceleration force ke anupaati

subject: Physics
original_english: State Newton's third law of motion. Why don't the action and reaction forces cancel each other?
hinglish_roman: Newton ka teesra niyam batao. Action aur reaction forces ek-doosre ko cancel kyun nahi karte?

subject: Physics
original_english: Give everyday examples of Newton's third law.
hinglish_roman: Newton ke teesre niyam ke roz ke examples do.

subject: Physics
original_english: How does a rocket lift off, and how did Chandrayaan-3's Vikram lander use the same principle to land?
hinglish_roman: Rocket kaise udaan bharta hai, aur Chandrayaan-3 ke Vikram lander ne utarne ke liye isi siddhaant ka use kaise kiya?

subject: Physics
original_english: A 0.1 kg bullet is fired from a 5 kg gun with a force of 2 N. Find the initial accelerations of the bullet and the gun.
hinglish_roman: 5 kg ki bandook se 0.1 kg ki goli 2 N ke force se chalaayi jaati hai. Goli aur bandook ke shuruaati acceleration nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: The Earth and a falling fruit pull each other with equal forces. Why does the fruit move towards the Earth but the Earth does not seem to move? Similarly, why does a compass needle move but not the bar magnet near it?
hinglish_roman: Dharti aur girta phal ek-doosre ko barabar force se kheenchte hain. Phal Dharti ki taraf kyun jaata hai par Dharti hilti kyun nahi dikhti? Isi tarah, paas rakhe bar magnet ke saamne compass ki sui kyun hilti hai par magnet nahi?

subject: Physics
original_english: A cart loaded with vegetables collides with an identical empty cart. During the collision: (i) the loaded cart exerts a larger force (ii) the empty cart exerts a larger force (iii) neither cart exerts a force (iv) both exert forces of equal magnitude on each other
hinglish_roman: Sabziyon se bhari thela-gaadi ek jaisi khaali thela-gaadi se takraati hai. Takkar ke dauraan: (i) bhari gaadi zyada force lagati hai (ii) khaali gaadi zyada force lagati hai (iii) koi gaadi force nahi lagati (iv) dono ek-doosre pe barabar magnitude ka force lagati hain

subject: Physics
original_english: A sailor jumps forward from a small boat to the shore. Will the boat move? If so, in which direction, and why?
hinglish_roman: Ek naavik chhoti naav se kinaare ki taraf aage koodta hai. Kya naav hilegi? Agar haan, toh kis disha mein, aur kyun?

subject: Physics
original_english: How can we find the acceleration of two boxes connected by a string and pulled by a force F on a frictionless surface?
hinglish_roman: Bina friction wali satah pe dhaage se jude aur force F se kheenche ja rahe do boxes ka acceleration kaise nikaalte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: A tractor pulls a harrow of mass m₁ with force F, giving acceleration a₁, and a trolley of mass m₂ with the same force, giving a₂. Find the acceleration when it pulls the trolley with the harrow on it, in terms of a₁ and a₂. (Ignore friction.)
hinglish_roman: Ek tractor m₁ mass ke harrow ko force F se kheenchkar acceleration a₁ deta hai, aur m₂ mass ki trolley ko usi force se a₂ deta hai. Jab woh trolley pe harrow rakhkar kheenche, toh acceleration a₁ aur a₂ ke roop mein nikaalo. (Friction chhod do.)

subject: Physics
original_english: Assertion (A): Action and reaction forces are equal and opposite, yet they do not cancel each other. Reason (R): Action and reaction forces act on two different objects. Choose: (i) Both true, R explains A (ii) Both true, R does not explain A (iii) A true, R false (iv) A false, R true
hinglish_roman: Assertion (A): Action aur reaction forces barabar aur ulte hote hain, phir bhi ek-doosre ko cancel nahi karte. Reason (R): Action aur reaction forces do alag objects pe lagte hain. Chuno: (i) Dono sahi, R A ko samjhata hai (ii) Dono sahi, R A ko nahi samjhata (iii) A sahi, R galat (iv) A galat, R sahi

subject: Physics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: The SI unit of force is the ______. The acceleration due to the Earth's gravitational force is g = ______ m/s², and it does not depend on the ______ of the object.
hinglish_roman: Blank bharo: Force ki SI unit ______ hai. Dharti ke gurutvaakarshan bal se acceleration g = ______ m/s² hai, aur yeh object ke ______ pe nirbhar nahi karta.

subject: Physics
original_english: Define work done by a constant force. What is one joule?
hinglish_roman: Sthir force dwara kiye gaye work ki paribhasha do. Ek joule kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Using the example of lifting wheat bags, explain why work depends on both force and displacement.
hinglish_roman: Gehun ki boriyan uthaane ke example se samjhao ki work force aur displacement dono pe kyun nirbhar karta hai.

subject: Physics
original_english: When is the work done by a force zero? Why do we feel tired pushing a wall even though no work is done?
hinglish_roman: Force dwara kiya gaya work kab zero hota hai? Deewar dhakelne pe work zero hone ke baavjood hum thak kyun jaate hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is the difference between positive and negative work? Explain with a dumbbell.
hinglish_roman: Positive aur negative work mein kya fark hai? Dumbbell se samjhao.

subject: Physics
original_english: A goalkeeper's hand moves back 15 cm as she stops a ball with a force of 200 N. How much work does she do on the ball?
hinglish_roman: 200 N ke force se gend rokte hue goalkeeper ka haath 15 cm peechhe jaata hai. Woh gend pe kitna work karti hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Is a weightlifter doing work on a barbell while holding it steady? Is the work done by friction on a sliding stack of coins positive, negative or zero?
hinglish_roman: Barbell ko sthir pakde weightlifter kya us pe work kar rahi hai? Phisalte sikkon ke dher pe friction ka work positive, negative ya zero hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A constant force of 10 N acts on an object while it moves 1 m in the direction of the force. Find the work done using a force-displacement graph.
hinglish_roman: Ek object pe 10 N ka sthir force lagta hai jab woh force ki disha mein 1 m chalta hai. Force-displacement graph se work nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: What is energy? State the work-energy theorem with examples.
hinglish_roman: Urja kya hai? Examples ke saath work-energy theorem batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: In a carrom shot, the striker hits a white coin which then hits the black coin. Who does work on whom, and how do the energies change?
hinglish_roman: Carrom ke shot mein striker safed goti ko maarta hai jo phir kaali goti ko maarti hai. Kaun kis pe work karta hai, aur urja kaise badalti hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Besides mechanical work, how can energy be transferred? Give examples of conversion between forms of energy.
hinglish_roman: Mechanical work ke alaava urja kaise transfer ho sakti hai? Urja ke roop badalne ke examples do.

subject: Physics
original_english: What is kinetic energy? Derive the expression K = ½mv².
hinglish_roman: Kinetic energy kya hai? K = ½mv² ka expression derive karo.

subject: Physics
original_english: If the velocity of a vehicle doubles, how does its kinetic energy change? Two objects A and B of masses m and 4m have the same kinetic energy; find the ratio of their speeds.
hinglish_roman: Gaadi ki velocity double ho jaaye toh uski kinetic energy kaise badlegi? m aur 4m mass ke do objects A aur B ki kinetic energy same hai; unki speeds ka anupaat nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: An Indian bowler delivers a 0.2 kg cricket ball at about 154.8 km/h. Find its kinetic energy.
hinglish_roman: Ek Indian bowler 0.2 kg ki cricket gend lagbhag 154.8 km/h se phenkta hai. Uski kinetic energy nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A 15000 kg jet lands on an aircraft carrier and is stopped within 100 m by a wire exerting a constant backward force of 367500 N. What was its velocity just before the wire caught it?
hinglish_roman: 15000 kg ka jet aircraft carrier pe utarta hai aur 367500 N ka sthir peechhe ka force lagaane wale taar se 100 m mein ruk jaata hai. Taar pakadne se theek pehle uski velocity kya thi?

subject: Physics
original_english: A man of 60 kg rides a 100 kg scooter to a speed v. The next day his 40 kg son joins him, and they reach the same speed in the same time. Find the ratio of fuel used on the two days, ignoring losses.
hinglish_roman: 60 kg ka aadmi 100 kg ke scooter ko speed v tak le jaata hai. Agle din uska 40 kg ka beta saath baithta hai, aur same samay mein same speed tak pahunchte hain. Nuksaan chhodkar dono din ke fuel ka anupaat nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: What is potential energy? Explain with a stretched band, a bow, a spring and a pair of magnets.
hinglish_roman: Potential energy kya hai? Kheenche band, dhanush, spring aur magnets ke jode se samjhao.

subject: Physics
original_english: Derive the expression for gravitational potential energy, U = mgh. What does the sand-bed activity show?
hinglish_roman: Gravitational potential energy U = mgh ka expression derive karo. Ret ke bistar wali activity kya dikhaati hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A fielder throws a 200 g ball about 10 m high in celebration. Find its potential energy at the highest point. (g = 10 m/s²)
hinglish_roman: Ek fielder khushi mein 200 g ki gend ko lagbhag 10 m upar phenkta hai. Sabse oonche point pe uski potential energy nikaalo. (g = 10 m/s²)

subject: Physics
original_english: A 50 kg student is lifted 72.5 m to the top of a building in an elevator, and later climbs the stairs to the same top. Find the gain in potential energy in both cases. (g = 10 m/s²) What do you conclude?
hinglish_roman: 50 kg ke student ko lift se 72.5 m oonchi building ke top tak le jaaya jaata hai, aur baad mein woh seedhiyon se usi top tak chadhta hai. Dono cases mein potential energy ki badhat nikaalo. (g = 10 m/s²) Tum kya nishkarsh nikaalte ho?

subject: Physics
original_english: State the law of conservation of mechanical energy and show it for a freely falling object.
hinglish_roman: Mechanical energy ke sanrakshan ka niyam batao aur aazaad girte object ke liye ise dikhao.

subject: Physics
original_english: How does a simple pendulum show conservation of mechanical energy? Why does it eventually stop?
hinglish_roman: Simple pendulum mechanical energy ka sanrakshan kaise dikhata hai? Yeh aakhir ruk kyun jaata hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Neglecting friction, find the speed of a child at the bottom of a slide of height h. If h = 5 m and g = 10 m/s², what is the speed? Does the mass of the child or the shape of the slide matter?
hinglish_roman: Friction chhodkar h oonchaai ki slide ke neeche bachche ki speed nikaalo. Agar h = 5 m aur g = 10 m/s² ho toh speed kya hai? Kya bachche ka mass ya slide ka aakaar maayne rakhta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A 2 kg ball is thrown up at 20 m/s and reaches a height of 19.4 m. What is the sign of the work done by gravity going up and coming down? How much work was done by air resistance? (g = 10 m/s²)
hinglish_roman: 2 kg ki gend 20 m/s se upar phenki jaati hai aur 19.4 m oonchaai tak pahunchti hai. Upar jaate aur neeche aate gravity ke work ka chinh kya hai? Hawa ke virodh ne kitna work kiya? (g = 10 m/s²)

subject: Physics
original_english: Gravity on the Moon is about 1/6 of that on Earth. If an astronaut can throw a ball 8 m high on Earth, how high will it go on the Moon with the same upward velocity?
hinglish_roman: Chandrama pe gravity Dharti ki lagbhag 1/6 hai. Agar astronaut Dharti pe gend 8 m oonchi phenk sakta hai, toh same upar ki velocity se Chandrama pe gend kitni oonchi jaayegi?

subject: Physics
original_english: A 1.5 kg coconut falls from a 10 m tree onto wet sand and stops by making a depression. Find (i) its speed just before impact and (ii) the depth of the depression if the sand's average resistive force is 3000 N. (g = 10 m/s²)
hinglish_roman: 1.5 kg ka nariyal 10 m oonche ped se geeli ret pe girkar gaddha banakar ruk jaata hai. (i) Takraane se theek pehle uski speed aur (ii) agar ret ka average virodhi force 3000 N ho toh gaddhe ki gehraai nikaalo. (g = 10 m/s²)

subject: Physics
original_english: A 10000 kg truck at 72 km/h with failed brakes enters an escape ramp inclined at 30°, rising 1 m for every 2 m along the ramp. The sand exerts 50000 N against its motion. Find the minimum ramp length to stop it. (g = 10 m/s²)
hinglish_roman: Brake fail hone pe 72 km/h se chalta 10000 kg ka truck 30° jhuke escape ramp pe chadhta hai, jo ramp pe har 2 m pe 1 m oonchaai deta hai. Ret motion ke khilaaf 50000 N lagati hai. Use rokne ke liye ramp ki kam se kam lambaai nikaalo. (g = 10 m/s²)

subject: Physics
original_english: Identify the energy transformation in: a truck moving uphill, an unwinding watch spring, photosynthesis, water flowing from a dam, a burning matchstick, a solar panel and a glowing bulb.
hinglish_roman: In sthitiyon mein urja ka roop badalna batao: chadhaai chadhta truck, khulti ghadi ki spring, photosynthesis, dam se behta paani, jalti maachis ki teeli, solar panel aur jalta bulb.

subject: Physics
original_english: When a ball thrown upward reaches its highest point, which statement is correct? (i) The force on the ball is zero (ii) Its acceleration is zero (iii) Its kinetic energy is zero (iv) Its potential energy is maximum. Options: (a) (i) and (ii) (b) (iii) and (iv) (c) only (ii) (d) all four
hinglish_roman: Upar phenki gend sabse oonche point pe pahunche toh kaun sa kathan sahi hai? (i) Gend pe force zero hai (ii) Uska acceleration zero hai (iii) Uski kinetic energy zero hai (iv) Uski potential energy maximum hai. Vikalp: (a) (i) aur (ii) (b) (iii) aur (iv) (c) sirf (ii) (d) chaaron

subject: Physics
original_english: What is power? What are its SI unit and the horsepower?
hinglish_roman: Power kya hai? Iski SI unit aur horsepower kya hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: A weightlifter lifts 75 kg by 2 m in 5 s. Find the power. A 1000 kg car goes from rest to 72 km/h in 10 s; find the engine power. (g = 10 m/s²)
hinglish_roman: Ek weightlifter 75 kg ko 5 s mein 2 m uthaati hai. Power nikaalo. 1000 kg ki car 10 s mein rest se 72 km/h tak jaati hai; engine ki power nikaalo. (g = 10 m/s²)

subject: Physics
original_english: A crane lifts a mass to the 10th floor in a certain time, then lifts the same mass to the 20th floor in double the time. How do the energy and power required compare? Does raising a flag faster change the work done?
hinglish_roman: Ek crane ek mass ko kuch samay mein 10vi manzil tak uthaati hai, phir usi mass ko double samay mein 20vi manzil tak. Zaroori urja aur power ki tulna kaise hai? Kya jhanda jaldi uthaane se work badalta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: What are simple machines? Define effort, load and mechanical advantage. What is the mechanical advantage of a fixed pulley?
hinglish_roman: Simple machines kya hain? Effort, load aur mechanical advantage ki paribhasha do. Fixed pulley ka mechanical advantage kitna hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Derive the mechanical advantage of an inclined plane. Why does a gentler slope need less effort?
hinglish_roman: Inclined plane ka mechanical advantage derive karo. Kam dhalaan pe kam effort kyun lagta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A ramp is used to raise an object over a 30 cm high step, with the ramp's base 40 cm wide. Find the mechanical advantage of the ramp.
hinglish_roman: Ek ramp se object ko 30 cm oonchi seedhi pe chadhaaya jaata hai, ramp ka aadhaar 40 cm chauda hai. Ramp ka mechanical advantage nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: Why are roads on hills built to wind around in gentle slopes? Why is an inclined ladder easier to climb than a vertical one?
hinglish_roman: Pahaadon pe sadkein seedhi upar jaane ki jagah halki dhalaan mein ghoomti hui kyun banaayi jaati hain? Tirchhi seedhi chadhna seedhi khadi seedhi se aasaan kyun hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is a lever? State the principle of the lever and its mechanical advantage.
hinglish_roman: Lever kya hai? Lever ka siddhaant aur uska mechanical advantage batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: A seesaw has seats A and E at 2 m and B and D at 1 m from the fulcrum C, on opposite sides (A, B on one side; D, E on the other). Where should children of 15 kg and 30 kg sit to balance it?
hinglish_roman: Ek seesaw pe fulcrum C se 2 m pe seats A aur E aur 1 m pe B aur D hain, ulti taraf (A, B ek taraf; D, E doosri taraf). Ise balance karne ke liye 15 kg aur 30 kg ke bachche kahan baithein?

subject: Physics
original_english: What are the three classes of levers? Give examples of each.
hinglish_roman: Levers ke teen class kaun se hain? Har ek ke examples do.

subject: Physics
original_english: Why do we push a hard object closer to the fulcrum of scissors to cut it? Why do all real machines eventually slow down and stop?
hinglish_roman: Sakht cheez kaatne ke liye use kainchi ke fulcrum ke paas kyun dhakelte hain? Saari asli machines aakhir dheemi hokar ruk kyun jaati hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: True or False: A simple machine reduces the total work needed to do a task.
hinglish_roman: True ya False: Simple machine kisi kaam ke liye zaroori kul work kam kar deti hai.

subject: Physics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: Kinetic energy = ______. Potential energy near the Earth's surface = ______. Power is the ______ at which work is done, and its SI unit is the ______.
hinglish_roman: Blank bharo: Kinetic energy = ______. Dharti ki satah ke paas potential energy = ______. Power woh ______ hai jis pe work hota hai, aur iski SI unit ______ hai.

subject: Physics
original_english: How does a traditional gharat (panchakki) use energy, and how is the same idea used today?
hinglish_roman: Paaramparik gharat (panchakki) urja ka use kaise karti hai, aur aaj yahi vichaar kaise use hota hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: How is sound produced? Explain with the rubber band activity and other examples.
hinglish_roman: Aawaaz kaise paida hoti hai? Rubber band activity aur doosre examples se samjhao.

subject: Physics
original_english: How do humans and some animals produce sound?
hinglish_roman: Insaan aur kuch jaanwar aawaaz kaise paida karte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is a tuning fork? How does it show that sound is produced by vibrating objects?
hinglish_roman: Tuning fork kya hai? Yeh kaise dikhata hai ki aawaaz kaanpti cheezon se paida hoti hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Can sound travel through solids and liquids? How can you show this?
hinglish_roman: Kya aawaaz solids aur liquids se guzar sakti hai? Ise kaise dikhaoge?

subject: Physics
original_english: Describe the vacuum bell jar experiment. What does it show, and why can't astronauts hear each other during a spacewalk?
hinglish_roman: Vacuum bell jar experiment ka varnan karo. Yeh kya dikhata hai, aur spacewalk ke dauraan astronauts ek-doosre ko kyun nahi sun sakte?

subject: Physics
original_english: A movie shows a spacecraft exploding in space with a flash of light and a loud sound at the same moment. What is wrong with this?
hinglish_roman: Ek film mein antariksh mein spacecraft ke phatne pe ek hi pal mein roshni ki chamak aur tez aawaaz dikhaayi jaati hai. Isme kya galat hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: How does sound travel through air? Explain compressions and rarefactions.
hinglish_roman: Aawaaz hawa mein kaise chalti hai? Compressions aur rarefactions samjhao.

subject: Physics
original_english: In the slinky activity, a mark on one turn does not travel along the slinky. What does this tell us about sound waves?
hinglish_roman: Slinky activity mein ek turn pe laga nishaan slinky ke saath aage nahi badhta. Isse sound waves ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: What are longitudinal and transverse waves? Why is sound called a longitudinal mechanical wave?
hinglish_roman: Longitudinal aur transverse waves kya hain? Aawaaz ko longitudinal mechanical wave kyun kehte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: Which observation best supports the idea that sound is a mechanical wave? (i) Sound shows reflection (ii) Sound needs a medium to propagate (iii) Sound has frequency (iv) Sound carries energy
hinglish_roman: Kaun si observation sabse achhe se dikhaati hai ki aawaaz mechanical wave hai? (i) Aawaaz reflect hoti hai (ii) Aawaaz ko chalne ke liye medium chahiye (iii) Aawaaz ki frequency hoti hai (iv) Aawaaz urja le jaati hai

subject: Physics
original_english: Assertion (A): Compressions and rarefactions move through the medium. Reason (R): Individual particles of the medium continuously move forward with the wave. Choose: (i) Both true, R does not explain A (ii) Both true, R explains A (iii) A true, R false (iv) A false, R true
hinglish_roman: Assertion (A): Compressions aur rarefactions medium mein chalte hain. Reason (R): Medium ke kan wave ke saath lagaataar aage badhte hain. Chuno: (i) Dono sahi, R A ko nahi samjhata (ii) Dono sahi, R A ko samjhata hai (iii) A sahi, R galat (iv) A galat, R sahi

subject: Physics
original_english: How are sudden loud sounds like thunder or firecrackers produced? What is a sonic boom?
hinglish_roman: Bijli ki kadak ya pataakhon jaisi achaanak tez aawaazein kaise paida hoti hain? Sonic boom kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: How does the grains-on-a-sheet activity show that sound carries energy? How do microphones and speakers use this?
hinglish_roman: Chaadar pe daane wali activity kaise dikhaati hai ki aawaaz urja le jaati hai? Microphone aur speaker ise kaise use karte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: When sound travels from a tuning fork to your ear, what actually reaches your ear? (i) Air particles near the tuning fork (ii) Energy carried by sound waves (iii) The tuning fork material (iv) A continuous stream of compressed air
hinglish_roman: Tuning fork se kaan tak aawaaz jaane pe kaan tak asal mein kya pahunchta hai? (i) Tuning fork ke paas ke hawa ke kan (ii) Sound waves ki laayi urja (iii) Tuning fork ka padaarth (iv) Dabi hawa ki lagaataar dhaara

subject: Physics
original_english: How is a sound wave shown on a density-distance graph? What are the crest and trough?
hinglish_roman: Density-distance graph pe sound wave kaise dikhaayi jaati hai? Crest aur trough kya hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: Define wavelength, frequency and time period of a sound wave, with their units. How are frequency and time period related?
hinglish_roman: Sound wave ki wavelength, frequency aur time period ki units ke saath paribhasha do. Frequency aur time period kaise jude hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: If there are 10 density oscillations in 2 s at a point, find the frequency and time period. If 20 compressions pass a point in 4 s, what is the frequency?
hinglish_roman: Agar ek point pe 2 s mein 10 density oscillations hon, toh frequency aur time period nikaalo. Agar 4 s mein 20 compressions ek point se guzrein, toh frequency kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A piston in a long air-filled tube produces a sound wave of frequency 20 Hz. How many oscillations does it complete per minute? What is its time period?
hinglish_roman: Hawa se bhari lambi tube mein piston 20 Hz frequency ki sound wave banata hai. Woh ek minute mein kitne oscillations karta hai? Iska time period kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: What are the amplitude and intensity of a sound wave? Why does sound get fainter with distance?
hinglish_roman: Sound wave ka amplitude aur intensity kya hain? Doori ke saath aawaaz dheemi kyun hoti hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A thin rubber band vibrates faster than a thick one. How do the frequency and time period of their sounds differ?
hinglish_roman: Patla rubber band mote se tez kaanpta hai. Unki aawaazon ki frequency aur time period kaise alag hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: For a sound wave in a given medium, increasing its frequency will increase its: (i) wavelength (ii) speed (iii) number of compressions per second (iv) time period
hinglish_roman: Kisi medium mein sound wave ki frequency badhaane se kya badhega? (i) Wavelength (ii) Speed (iii) Per second compressions ki sankhya (iv) Time period

subject: Physics
original_english: Derive the relation between the speed, wavelength and frequency of a sound wave. On what does the speed of sound depend?
hinglish_roman: Sound wave ki speed, wavelength aur frequency ka sambandh derive karo. Aawaaz ki speed kis pe nirbhar karti hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Human hearing spans about 20 Hz to 20 kHz. Find the corresponding wavelengths in air, taking the speed of sound as 344 m/s.
hinglish_roman: Insaan lagbhag 20 Hz se 20 kHz tak sun sakte hain. Aawaaz ki speed 344 m/s lekar hawa mein inki wavelengths nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A sound wave in steel has a wavelength of 50 m, and the speed of sound in steel is 5000 m/s. Find its frequency and time period. Also find the time period of a wave of wavelength 3.44 m travelling at 344 m/s.
hinglish_roman: Steel mein ek sound wave ki wavelength 50 m hai, aur steel mein aawaaz ki speed 5000 m/s hai. Iski frequency aur time period nikaalo. 344 m/s se chalti 3.44 m wavelength wali wave ka time period bhi nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: During a storm, thunder is heard 5 s after the lightning is seen. Estimate the distance to the lightning, taking the speed of sound as 340 m/s.
hinglish_roman: Toofan mein bijli dikhne ke 5 s baad kadak sunaayi deti hai. Aawaaz ki speed 340 m/s lekar bijli ki doori ka andaaza lagao.

subject: Physics
original_english: The speed of sound is about 5000 m/s in steel, 1500 m/s in water and 340 m/s in air. Find the ratio of the speed in water to that in air, and in steel to that in water.
hinglish_roman: Aawaaz ki speed steel mein lagbhag 5000 m/s, paani mein 1500 m/s aur hawa mein 340 m/s hai. Paani aur hawa ki speed ka, aur steel aur paani ki speed ka anupaat nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: Gunjan and her friend stand 340 m apart along a steel fence. Her ear is on the fence when the friend knocks it. Find the time difference between the sound arriving through steel (5000 m/s) and through air (340 m/s). Can she hear the two separately?
hinglish_roman: Gunjan aur uski dost steel ki baadh ke saath 340 m door khadi hain. Dost ke baadh thokne pe Gunjan ka kaan baadh pe hai. Steel (5000 m/s) aur hawa (340 m/s) se aane wali aawaaz ke samay ka antar nikaalo. Kya woh dono alag sun sakti hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Sound travels at about 344 m/s at 22 °C and 331 m/s at 0 °C. Roughly how much extra time will thunder take to travel 1720 m if the temperature drops from 22 °C to 0 °C?
hinglish_roman: 22 °C pe aawaaz lagbhag 344 m/s aur 0 °C pe 331 m/s se chalti hai. Agar temperature 22 °C se 0 °C ho jaaye, toh bijli ki kadak ko 1720 m chalne mein lagbhag kitna extra samay lagega?

subject: Physics
original_english: Two identical sound sources, A in air and B in water, send sound horizontally to a cliff and back over the same distance. The sound returns to A after 4.5 times the time it takes for B. Find the ratio of the speeds of sound in air and water.
hinglish_roman: Do ek jaise sound sources, A hawa mein aur B paani mein, same doori pe cliff tak aur waapas horizontally aawaaz bhejte hain. A tak aawaaz B ke samay se 4.5 guna samay mein lautti hai. Hawa aur paani mein aawaaz ki speeds ka anupaat nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: What are pitch and loudness? How are they related to the physical properties of sound?
hinglish_roman: Pitch aur loudness kya hain? Yeh aawaaz ke physical gunon se kaise jude hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is the human audible range? What are infrasonic and ultrasonic waves, and which animals can hear them?
hinglish_roman: Insaan ki sunne ki range kya hai? Infrasonic aur ultrasonic waves kya hain, aur kaun se jaanwar inhe sun sakte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is the difference between a tone and a musical note? What are timbre and an octave?
hinglish_roman: Tone aur musical note mein kya fark hai? Timbre aur octave kya hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: How is loudness measured, and why is noise pollution harmful?
hinglish_roman: Loudness kaise naapi jaati hai, aur shor pradooshan nuksaandeh kyun hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is an echo? Find the minimum distance of a reflecting surface needed to hear an echo, taking the speed of sound as 340 m/s.
hinglish_roman: Echo (gunj) kya hai? Aawaaz ki speed 340 m/s lekar echo sunne ke liye reflect karne wali satah ki kam se kam doori nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: You clap in an empty corridor and hear the echo after 0.5 s. If sound travels at 340 m/s, how far is the wall? Also, how far should a surface be for an echo to arrive 0.2 s after the sound, at 343 m/s?
hinglish_roman: Khaali galiyaare mein taali bajaane pe 0.5 s baad echo sunaayi deti hai. Aawaaz 340 m/s se chale toh deewar kitni door hai? 343 m/s pe echo aawaaz ke 0.2 s baad aaye, iske liye satah kitni door honi chahiye?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is reverberation? How are auditoriums designed to control it? Will a reflection arriving 0.05 s after the sound produce an echo?
hinglish_roman: Reverberation kya hai? Auditoriums ko ise niyantrit karne ke liye kaise design kiya jaata hai? Aawaaz ke 0.05 s baad aane wala reflection kya echo banayega?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is echolocation? How do bats use it, and how is the same principle used in sonar?
hinglish_roman: Echolocation kya hai? Chamgaadad ise kaise use karte hain, aur sonar mein yahi siddhaant kaise use hota hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A naval sonar signal returns after 0.90 s in seawater where sound travels at 1530 m/s. How far is the object? If another sonar signal returns after 4 s with sound at 1500 m/s, what is the ocean depth?
hinglish_roman: Samudri paani mein navy ka sonar signal 0.90 s baad lautta hai jahan aawaaz 1530 m/s se chalti hai. Object kitni door hai? Agar doosra sonar signal 1500 m/s pe 4 s baad laute, toh samudra ki gehraai kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A ship's sonar detects an echo from a sunken wreck after 5 s, with ultrasound travelling at 1525 m/s in seawater. How deep is the wreck? A car's parking sensor beeps at 1.2 m from an obstacle; how long does its ultrasound take for the round trip at 345 m/s?
hinglish_roman: Ek jahaz ka sonar doobe jahaz se 5 s baad echo pakadta hai, jahan ultrasound samudri paani mein 1525 m/s se chalta hai. Doobe jahaz ki gehraai kitni hai? Car ka parking sensor rukaavat se 1.2 m pe beep karta hai; 345 m/s pe uske ultrasound ko jaane-aane mein kitna samay lagta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: List the applications of ultrasonic and infrasonic waves.
hinglish_roman: Ultrasonic aur infrasonic waves ke upyog batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: Assertion (A): We cannot hear a bell ringing in a closed jar after most of the air is pumped out. Reason (R): Sound requires a medium to travel. Choose: (i) Both true, R does not explain A (ii) Both true, R explains A (iii) A true, R false (iv) A false, R true
hinglish_roman: Assertion (A): Band jar se zyadatar hawa nikaalne ke baad usme bajti ghanti sunaayi nahi deti. Reason (R): Aawaaz ko chalne ke liye medium chahiye. Chuno: (i) Dono sahi, R A ko nahi samjhata (ii) Dono sahi, R A ko samjhata hai (iii) A sahi, R galat (iv) A galat, R sahi

subject: Physics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: Speed of sound = ______ × ______. Sound travels fastest in ______ and slowest in ______. A reflected sound is heard as a separate echo only if it arrives at least ______ s after the original sound.
hinglish_roman: Blank bharo: Aawaaz ki speed = ______ × ______. Aawaaz ______ mein sabse tez aur ______ mein sabse dheemi chalti hai. Reflect hui aawaaz alag echo tabhi sunaayi deti hai jab woh asli aawaaz ke kam se kam ______ s baad aaye.

subject: Physics
original_english: How does the human ear work, and how do two ears help locate the direction of a sound?
hinglish_roman: Insaan ka kaan kaise kaam karta hai, aur do kaan aawaaz ki disha pata karne mein kaise madad karte hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: State the laws of reflection of light. What are the properties of the image formed by a plane mirror?
hinglish_roman: Light ke reflection ke niyam batao. Plane mirror se bane image ki kya properties hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What evidence shows that light travels in straight lines, and when does this straight-line (ray) treatment fail?
hinglish_roman: Kaun sa saboot dikhata hai ki light seedhi line mein chalti hai, aur ye straight-line (ray) treatment kab fail hota hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: How does the modern quantum theory describe the nature of light?
hinglish_roman: Modern quantum theory light ki nature ko kaise batati hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Differentiate between a concave mirror and a convex mirror.
hinglish_roman: Concave mirror aur convex mirror mein antar batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: Define pole, centre of curvature, radius of curvature and principal axis of a spherical mirror.
hinglish_roman: Spherical mirror ke pole, centre of curvature, radius of curvature aur principal axis ki paribhasha do.

subject: Physics
original_english: Define the principal focus of a concave mirror and of a convex mirror. What is focal length?
hinglish_roman: Concave aur convex mirror ke principal focus ki paribhasha do. Focal length kya hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Why does a sheet of paper start burning when sunlight reflected from a concave mirror is focused on it?
hinglish_roman: Concave mirror se reflect hui dhoop ko kaagaz pe focus karne se kaagaz jalne kyun lagta hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: The radius of curvature of a spherical mirror is 20 cm. What is its focal length? Also find the focal length of a convex mirror of radius of curvature 32 cm.
hinglish_roman: Ek spherical mirror ka radius of curvature 20 cm hai. Uski focal length kya hai? 32 cm radius of curvature waale convex mirror ki focal length bhi nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: What is the aperture of a spherical mirror? What does R = 2f tell us about the position of the principal focus?
hinglish_roman: Spherical mirror ka aperture kya hota hai? R = 2f principal focus ki position ke baare mein kya batata hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: Describe the position, size and nature of the image formed by a concave mirror for all six positions of the object.
hinglish_roman: Object ki chhe positions ke liye concave mirror se bane image ki position, size aur nature batao.

subject: Physics
original_english:
The image formed by a concave mirror is observed to be virtual, erect and larger than the object. Where should the object be?
(a) Between the principal focus and the centre of curvature
(b) At the centre of curvature
(c) Beyond the centre of curvature
(d) Between the pole of the mirror and its principal focus
hinglish_roman:
Concave mirror ka image virtual, erect aur object se bada dikhta hai. Object kahan hona chahiye?
(a) Principal focus aur centre of curvature ke beech
(b) Centre of curvature pe
(c) Centre of curvature se aage
(d) Mirror ke pole aur principal focus ke beech

subject: Physics
original_english: We wish to obtain an erect image of an object using a concave mirror of focal length 15 cm. What should be the range of object distance? What is the nature and size of the image?
hinglish_roman: 15 cm focal length waale concave mirror se hum erect image chahte hain. Object distance ki range kya honi chahiye? Image ki nature aur size kya hogi?

subject: Physics
original_english: List the rays used for locating the image formed by a spherical mirror in a ray diagram.
hinglish_roman: Ray diagram mein spherical mirror ka image dhoondhne ke liye kaun si rays use hoti hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: Name the type of mirror used in (a) headlights of a car, (b) side/rear-view mirror of a vehicle, (c) solar furnace. Give reasons.
hinglish_roman: (a) Car ki headlights, (b) gaadi ka side/rear-view mirror, (c) solar furnace mein kaun sa mirror use hota hai? Kaaran batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: Give examples of the uses of concave mirrors.
hinglish_roman: Concave mirrors ke upyog ke examples do.

subject: Physics
original_english: What kind of image does a convex mirror form for an object at infinity and for an object at a finite distance?
hinglish_roman: Infinity pe rakhe object aur finite doori pe rakhe object ke liye convex mirror kaisa image banata hai?

subject: Physics
original_english:
No matter how far you stand from a mirror, your image appears erect. The mirror is likely to be
(a) only plane
(b) only concave
(c) only convex
(d) either plane or convex
hinglish_roman:
Aap mirror se kitni bhi door khade ho, aapka image erect dikhta hai. Mirror kaun sa hoga?
(a) sirf plane
(b) sirf concave
(c) sirf convex
(d) plane ya convex

subject: Physics
original_english: How is a full-length image of a tall building or of the Taj Mahal seen in a small mirror? Which mirror is used?
hinglish_roman: Chhote se mirror mein oonchi building ya Taj Mahal ka poora image kaise dikhta hai? Kaun sa mirror use hota hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: State the New Cartesian Sign Convention for reflection by spherical mirrors.
hinglish_roman: Spherical mirrors ke reflection ke liye New Cartesian Sign Convention batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: Write the mirror formula and define magnification produced by a spherical mirror. What does the sign of m tell us?
hinglish_roman: Mirror formula likho aur spherical mirror ke magnification ki paribhasha do. m ka sign kya batata hai?

subject: Physics
original_english: A convex mirror used for rear-view on an automobile has a radius of curvature of 3.00 m. If a bus is 5.00 m from this mirror, find the position, nature and size of the image.
hinglish_roman: Gaadi ke rear-view ke liye use hone waale convex mirror ka radius of curvature 3.00 m hai. Agar bus mirror se 5.00 m door hai, toh image ki position, nature aur size nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: An object 4.0 cm in size is placed 25.0 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 15.0 cm. Where should a screen be placed to get a sharp image? Find the nature and size of the image.
hinglish_roman: 4.0 cm ka object 15.0 cm focal length waale concave mirror ke 25.0 cm aage rakha hai. Sharp image ke liye screen kahan rakhni chahiye? Image ki nature aur size nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: An object is placed at a distance of 10 cm from a convex mirror of focal length 15 cm. Find the position and nature of the image.
hinglish_roman: 15 cm focal length waale convex mirror se 10 cm ki doori pe object rakha hai. Image ki position aur nature nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: An object 5.0 cm long is placed 20 cm in front of a convex mirror of radius of curvature 30 cm. Find the position, nature and size of the image.
hinglish_roman: 5.0 cm lamba object 30 cm radius of curvature waale convex mirror ke 20 cm aage rakha hai. Image ki position, nature aur size nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: An object of size 7.0 cm is placed 27 cm in front of a concave mirror of focal length 18 cm. At what distance should a screen be placed to get a sharp image? Find the size and nature of the image.
hinglish_roman: 7.0 cm ka object 18 cm focal length waale concave mirror ke 27 cm aage rakha hai. Sharp image ke liye screen kitni doori pe rakhni chahiye? Image ki size aur nature nikaalo.

subject: Physics
original_english: A concave mirror produces a three times magnified real image of an object placed 10 cm in front of it. Where is the image located?
hinglish_roman: Concave mirror apne 10 cm aage rakhe object ka teen guna bada real image banata hai. Image kahan hai?

hinglish_roman: Conductor ka resistance kin factors pe nirbhar karta hai? Ye dikhaane waale observations batao.

original_english: What is electrical resistivity? Give its SI unit and typical values for conductors and insulators.
hinglish_roman: Electrical resistivity kya hai? Iski SI unit aur conductors aur insulators ki typical values batao.

subject: Physics
original_english: The resistance of a metal wire of length 1 m is 26 Ω at 20°C. If the diameter of the wire is 0.3 mm, find the resistivity of the metal and identify it using Table 11.2.
hinglish_roman: 1 m lambi metal wire ka resistance 20°C pe 26 Ω hai. Agar wire ka diameter 0.3 mm hai, toh metal ki resistivity nikaalo aur Table 11.2 se metal pehchaano.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: Lambaai l aur cross-section area A waali wire ka resistance 4 Ω hai. Usi material ki l/2 lambaai aur 2A area waali doosri wire ka resistance kya hoga?

subject: Physics
original_english: A copper wire has diameter 0.5 mm and resistivity 1.6 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m. What length of this wire gives a resistance of 10 Ω? How does the resistance change if the diameter is doubled?
hinglish_roman: Copper wire ka diameter 0.5 mm aur resistivity 1.6 × 10⁻⁸ Ω m hai. 10 Ω resistance ke liye wire kitni lambi honi chahiye? Diameter double karne pe resistance kaise badlega?

subject: Physics
original_english: Using Table 11.2: (a) Which is a better conductor, iron or mercury? (b) Which material is the best conductor? (c) Will current flow more easily through a thick or a thin wire of the same material on the same source?
hinglish_roman: Table 11.2 se: (a) Iron aur mercury mein behtar conductor kaun hai? (b) Sabse achha conductor kaun sa material hai? (c) Same source pe same material ki moti ya patli wire, kisme current aasaani se behega?

subject: Physics
original_english: Why are alloys used in heating devices like electric irons and toasters, tungsten for bulb filaments, and copper and aluminium for transmission lines?
hinglish_roman: Electric iron aur toaster jaise heating devices mein alloys, bulb filament mein tungsten, aur transmission lines mein copper aur aluminium kyun use hote hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: Derive the expression for the equivalent resistance of three resistors connected in series.
hinglish_roman: Series mein jude teen resistors ke equivalent resistance ka expression derive karo.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: Parallel mein jude teen resistors ke equivalent resistance ka expression derive karo.

subject: Physics
original_english: An electric lamp of resistance 20 Ω and a conductor of 4 Ω are connected in series to a 6 V battery. Find (a) the total resistance, (b) the current, and (c) the potential difference across the lamp and the conductor.
hinglish_roman: 20 Ω resistance ka electric lamp aur 4 Ω ka conductor 6 V battery se series mein jude hain. Nikaalo (a) kul resistance, (b) current, aur (c) lamp aur conductor ke across potential difference.

subject: Physics
original_english: A battery of three cells of 2 V each is connected in series with resistors of 5 Ω, 8 Ω and 12 Ω and a plug key. What will an ammeter in the circuit and a voltmeter across the 12 Ω resistor read?
hinglish_roman: 2 V ke teen cells ki battery 5 Ω, 8 Ω aur 12 Ω ke resistors aur plug key ke saath series mein judi hai. Circuit ka ammeter aur 12 Ω ke across laga voltmeter kya padhega?

subject: Physics
original_english: A 9 V battery is connected in series with resistors of 0.2 Ω, 0.3 Ω, 0.4 Ω, 0.5 Ω and 12 Ω. How much current flows through the 12 Ω resistor?
hinglish_roman: 9 V battery 0.2 Ω, 0.3 Ω, 0.4 Ω, 0.5 Ω aur 12 Ω ke resistors ke saath series mein judi hai. 12 Ω resistor se kitna current behega?

subject: Physics
original_english: Resistors of 5 Ω, 10 Ω and 30 Ω are connected in parallel to a 12 V battery. Find (a) the current through each resistor, (b) the total current, and (c) the total resistance.
hinglish_roman: 5 Ω, 10 Ω aur 30 Ω ke resistors 12 V battery se parallel mein jude hain. Nikaalo (a) har resistor ka current, (b) kul current, aur (c) kul resistance.

subject: Physics
original_english: In a circuit, R₁ = 10 Ω and R₂ = 40 Ω are in parallel, and this is in series with a parallel group of R₃ = 30 Ω, R₄ = 20 Ω and R₅ = 60 Ω. A 12 V battery is connected. Find the total resistance and the total current.
hinglish_roman: Ek circuit mein R₁ = 10 Ω aur R₂ = 40 Ω parallel mein hain, aur ye R₃ = 30 Ω, R₄ = 20 Ω aur R₅ = 60 Ω ke parallel group ke saath series mein hai. 12 V battery judi hai. Kul resistance aur kul current nikaalo.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: 100 Ω ka electric lamp, 50 Ω ka toaster aur 500 Ω ka water filter 220 V source se parallel mein jude hain. Teeno jitna current lene waali electric iron ka resistance kya hoga, aur usme kitna current behega?

subject: Physics
original_english: How can three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω and 6 Ω be connected to give a total resistance of (a) 4 Ω, (b) 1 Ω? Also, how would you connect three 6 Ω resistors to get (i) 9 Ω, (ii) 4 Ω?
hinglish_roman: 2 Ω, 3 Ω aur 6 Ω ke teen resistors ko kaise jodein ki kul resistance (a) 4 Ω, (b) 1 Ω ho? Aur teen 6 Ω resistors se (i) 9 Ω, (ii) 4 Ω kaise milega?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is (a) the highest and (b) the lowest total resistance obtainable by combining four coils of 4 Ω, 8 Ω, 12 Ω and 24 Ω?
hinglish_roman: 4 Ω, 8 Ω, 12 Ω aur 24 Ω ki chaar coils jodkar (a) sabse zyada aur (b) sabse kam kul resistance kitna mil sakta hai?

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: 220 V line pe 5 A le jaane ke liye 176 Ω ke kitne resistors parallel mein chahiye?

subject: Physics

(a) 1/25
(b) 1/5
(c) 5
(d) 25
hinglish_roman:
R resistance waali wire ko paanch barabar tukdon mein kaatkar parallel mein joda gaya. Agar equivalent resistance R′ hai, toh R/R′ hai
(a) 1/25
(b) 1/5
(c) 5
(d) 25

subject: Physics
original_english: Why is a series arrangement not used for domestic circuits? What are the advantages of connecting devices in parallel?
hinglish_roman: Ghar ke circuits mein series arrangement kyun nahi use hota? Devices ko parallel mein jodne ke kya fayde hain?

subject: Physics
original_english: What is the heating effect of electric current? Derive Joule's law of heating.
hinglish_roman: Electric current ka heating effect kya hai? Joule's law of heating derive karo.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: 220 V pe electric iron maximum heating pe 840 W aur minimum heating pe 360 W energy leti hai. Dono cases mein current aur resistance nikaalo.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: 4 Ω resistance mein har second 100 J garmi banti hai. Resistor ke across potential difference nikaalo.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: (a) 50 V potential difference se ek ghante mein 96000 C charge le jaane mein kitni garmi banti hai? (b) 20 Ω resistance ki electric iron 5 A current leti hai. 30 s mein kitni garmi banegi?

subject: Physics
original_english:

(a) 1:2
(b) 2:1
(c) 1:4
(d) 4:1
hinglish_roman:
Same material, lambaai aur diameter ki do wires ko same potential difference pe pehle series aur phir parallel mein joda gaya. Series aur parallel mein bani garmi ka ratio hai
(a) 1:2
(b) 2:1
(c) 1:4
(d) 4:1

subject: Physics
original_english: How is the heating effect of current used in an electric bulb? Why are bulbs filled with nitrogen and argon?
hinglish_roman: Electric bulb mein current ka heating effect kaise use hota hai? Bulb mein nitrogen aur argon kyun bhari jaati hai?

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: Electric fuse kya hai aur circuit ko kaise bachaata hai? 220 V pe 1 kW iron ke liye kaun sa fuse lagana chahiye?

hinglish_roman: Electric power ki paribhasha aur formulas do. 1 watt kya hai? Electrical energy ki commercial unit kya hai?

hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Electric circuit mein electrons kharch hote hain, aur hum unke liye bijli board ko paise dete hain. (b) I²R, VI aur V²/R teeno electrical power hain, par IR nahi.

subject: Physics

hinglish_roman: 400 W ka fridge roz 8 ghante chalta hai. Rs 3.00 per kW h ke hisaab se 30 din chalaane ka kharcha kitna hoga?

hinglish_roman: 220 V line pe ek hot plate mein 24 Ω ki do coils A aur B hain, jo alag-alag, series mein ya parallel mein use ho sakti hain. Teeno cases mein current nikaalo.

hinglish_roman: Compass ki madad se bar magnet ki magnetic field lines kaise banaate hain?

hinglish_roman: Seedhe current-carrying conductor ke aas-paas ki magnetic field batao. Ye current aur wire se doori pe kaise nirbhar karti hai?

(b) Straight lines parallel to the wire

Lambi seedhi wire ke paas ki magnetic field ko kaun sa sahi batata hai?

hinglish_roman: Fleming's left-hand rule batao. Magnetic field mein current waale conductor pe force sabse zyada kab hota hai?

(b) to the left

(d) into the page

chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) The x-coordinate of any point on the y-axis is ______. (b) The y-coordinate of any point on the x-axis is ______. (c) The coordinates of the origin are ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) y-axis ke har point ka x-coordinate ______ hota hai. (b) x-axis ke har point ka y-coordinate ______ hota hai. (c) Origin ke coordinates ______ hain.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Point W has x-coordinate −5. What can you say about the coordinates of a point H on the line through W parallel to the y-axis? In which quadrants can H lie?
hinglish_roman: Point W ka x-coordinate −5 hai. W se guzarne waali y-axis ke parallel line pe point H ke coordinates ke baare mein kya keh sakte ho? H kin quadrants mein ho sakta hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Reiaan's rectangular study table has three feet at (8, 9), (11, 9) and (11, 7). Where is the fourth foot? What are the length and width of the table? Can you find its height?
hinglish_roman: Reiaan ki rectangular study table ke teen pair (8, 9), (11, 9) aur (11, 7) pe hain. Chautha pair kahan hai? Table ki lambaai aur chaudaai kya hai? Kya uski oonchaai pata kar sakte ho?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: How do we find the distance between two points whose joining segment is not parallel to either axis? Write the distance formula.
hinglish_roman: Jab do points ko jodne waala segment kisi axis ke parallel na ho, toh unke beech ki doori kaise nikaalte hain? Distance formula likho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Find the lengths of the sides of triangle ADM with A(3, 4), D(7, 1) and M(9, 6).
hinglish_roman: A(3, 4), D(7, 1) aur M(9, 6) waale triangle ADM ki bhujaon ki lambaai nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Triangle ADM with A(3, 4), D(7, 1), M(9, 6) is reflected in the y-axis. What are the images of its vertices, and what changes and what stays the same?
hinglish_roman: A(3, 4), D(7, 1), M(9, 6) waale triangle ADM ko y-axis mein reflect kiya gaya. Vertices ke images kya hain, aur kya badalta hai aur kya same rehta hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Consider R(3, 0), A(0, −2), M(−5, −2) and P(−5, 2) joined in order. Find (i) two perpendicular sides, (ii) a side parallel to an axis, (iii) two points that are mirror images in an axis.
hinglish_roman: R(3, 0), A(0, −2), M(−5, −2) aur P(−5, 2) ko kram se joda gaya. Batao (i) do perpendicular bhujaayein, (ii) kisi axis ke parallel ek bhuja, (iii) do points jo kisi axis mein ek doosre ke mirror image hain.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Are the points M(−3, −4), A(0, 0) and G(6, 8) on the same straight line? Suggest a method to check without plotting.
hinglish_roman: Kya M(−3, −4), A(0, 0) aur G(6, 8) ek hi seedhi line pe hain? Bina plot kiye check karne ka tareeka batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Check whether the points R(−5, −1), B(−2, −5) and C(4, −12) lie on the same straight line.
hinglish_roman: Check karo ki R(−5, −1), B(−2, −5) aur C(4, −12) ek hi seedhi line pe hain ya nahi.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: For each set, state whether M is the midpoint of ST: (a) S(−3, 0), M(0, 0), T(3, 0); (b) S(2, 3), M(3, 4), T(4, 5); (c) S(0, 0), M(0, 5), T(0, −10); (d) S(−8, 7), M(0, −2), T(6, −3). What connection do you find?
hinglish_roman: Har set mein batao ki M, ST ka midpoint hai ya nahi: (a) S(−3, 0), M(0, 0), T(3, 0); (b) S(2, 3), M(3, 4), T(4, 5); (c) S(0, 0), M(0, 5), T(0, −10); (d) S(−8, 7), M(0, −2), T(6, −3). Kya sambandh milta hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: M(−7, 1) is the midpoint of A(3, −4) and B(x, y). Find the coordinates of B.
hinglish_roman: M(−7, 1), A(3, −4) aur B(x, y) ka midpoint hai. B ke coordinates nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: P and Q are the points of trisection of AB, with P closer to A. Find P and Q for A(4, 7) and B(16, −2).
hinglish_roman: P aur Q, AB ke trisection points hain, P, A ke paas. A(4, 7) aur B(16, −2) ke liye P aur Q nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Show that A(1, −8), B(−4, 7) and C(−7, −4) lie on a circle K centred at the origin. Find its radius. Do D(−5, 6) and E(0, 9) lie inside, on or outside K?
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki A(1, −8), B(−4, 7) aur C(−7, −4) origin centre waale circle K pe hain. Radius nikaalo. D(−5, 6) aur E(0, 9) circle ke andar, upar ya bahar hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: The midpoints of the sides BC, CA and AB of triangle ABC are D(5, 1), E(6, 5) and F(0, 3). Find A, B and C.
hinglish_roman: Triangle ABC ki bhujaon BC, CA aur AB ke midpoints D(5, 1), E(6, 5) aur F(0, 3) hain. A, B aur C nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: A screen 800 pixels wide and 600 pixels high has its origin at the bottom-left corner. A circle of radius 80 is centred at A(100, 150) and another of radius 100 at B(250, 230). (i) Does any part of either circle lie outside the screen? (ii) Do the circles intersect?
hinglish_roman: 800 pixel chaudi aur 600 pixel oonchi screen ka origin neeche-left kone pe hai. 80 radius ka circle A(100, 150) pe aur 100 radius ka circle B(250, 230) pe hai. (i) Kya kisi circle ka koi hissa screen ke bahar hai? (ii) Kya circles ek doosre ko kaatte hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Plot A(2, 1), B(−1, 2), C(−2, −1) and D(1, −2). Is ABCD a square? Find its area.
hinglish_roman: A(2, 1), B(−1, 2), C(−2, −1) aur D(1, −2) plot karo. Kya ABCD square hai? Uska area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: What would a coordinate system be like without negative numbers? Could it locate every point in a 2-D plane?
hinglish_roman: Bina negative numbers ke coordinate system kaisa hota? Kya ye 2-D plane ka har point dhoondh paata?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: A city has 10 streets in each of the N–S and E–W directions. Intersection (2, 5) means the 2nd N–S street meets the 5th E–W street. How many intersections can be called (4, 3), and how many (3, 4)? Are they the same?
hinglish_roman: Ek shahar mein N–S aur E–W dono disha mein 10-10 galiyan hain. Intersection (2, 5) ka matlab 2nd N–S gali 5th E–W gali se milti hai. Kitne intersections ko (4, 3) aur kitno ko (3, 4) keh sakte hain? Kya ye same hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: True or False: (a) The point (−4, 0) lies in Quadrant II. (b) A point with a negative y-coordinate and positive x-coordinate lies in Quadrant IV. (c) The distance between (x₁, y) and (x₂, y) is |x₂ − x₁|.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Point (−4, 0) Quadrant II mein hai. (b) Negative y-coordinate aur positive x-coordinate waala point Quadrant IV mein hota hai. (c) (x₁, y) aur (x₂, y) ke beech ki doori |x₂ − x₁| hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english:
The coordinates of a point are (−3, −7). The point lies in
(a) Quadrant I
(b) Quadrant II
(c) Quadrant III
(d) Quadrant IV
hinglish_roman:
Ek point ke coordinates (−3, −7) hain. Ye point kahan hai?
(a) Quadrant I
(b) Quadrant II
(c) Quadrant III
(d) Quadrant IV

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Orienting Yourself: The Use of Coordinates
original_english: Using the origin as one vertex, give the vertices of a right-angled isosceles triangle.
hinglish_roman: Origin ko ek vertex lekar ek right-angled isosceles triangle ke vertices batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Raju buys x red boxes with 4 pens each and y blue boxes with 5 pencils each, and gets 3 extra pens free. Write the expression for the total number of pens and pencils and identify its terms, variables, coefficients and constant.
hinglish_roman: Raju 4 pen waale x laal boxes aur 5 pencil waale y neele boxes khareedta hai, aur 3 pen free milte hain. Kul pen aur pencil ka expression likho aur uske terms, variables, coefficients aur constant pehchaano.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A rectangular garden of length l m and width w m is fenced with wire along the lengths at ₹100 per metre and wood along the widths at ₹80 per metre. Seeds cost ₹50 per square metre. Write the expression for the total cost.
hinglish_roman: l m lambe aur w m chaude rectangular garden ki lambaai pe ₹100 per metre ki wire aur chaudaai pe ₹80 per metre ki lakdi ki baad lagti hai. Beej ₹50 per square metre ke hain. Kul kharche ka expression likho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A 20 cm wire is bent into rectangles. If the length is x cm, write the expression for the area. What is the area when x = 6 cm?
hinglish_roman: 20 cm ki wire ko mod kar rectangles banaaye jaate hain. Agar lambaai x cm hai toh area ka expression likho. x = 6 cm pe area kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a univariate polynomial? What is its degree? Name the polynomials of degree 0, 1, 2 and 3 with examples.
hinglish_roman: Univariate polynomial kya hai? Uski degree kya hoti hai? Degree 0, 1, 2 aur 3 ke polynomials ke naam examples ke saath batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the degrees of: (i) 2x² − 5x + 3, (ii) y³ + 2y − 1, (iii) −9, (iv) 4z − 3.
hinglish_roman: Degree nikaalo: (i) 2x² − 5x + 3, (ii) y³ + 2y − 1, (iii) −9, (iv) 4z − 3.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) What are the coefficients of x² and x³ in x⁴ − 3x³ + 6x² − 2x + 7? (b) What is the coefficient of z in 4z³ + 5z² − 11? (c) What is the constant term of 9x³ + 5x² − 8x − 10?
hinglish_roman: (a) x⁴ − 3x³ + 6x² − 2x + 7 mein x² aur x³ ke coefficients kya hain? (b) 4z³ + 5z² − 11 mein z ka coefficient kya hai? (c) 9x³ + 5x² − 8x − 10 ka constant term kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the characteristic feature of linear polynomials? Explain with the chess club example.
hinglish_roman: Linear polynomials ki khaas pehchaan kya hai? Chess club ke example se samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the perimeters of squares with sides 1 cm, 1.5 cm, 2 cm, 2.5 cm and 3 cm. What happens to the perimeter when the side increases by 0.5 cm?
hinglish_roman: 1 cm, 1.5 cm, 2 cm, 2.5 cm aur 3 cm bhuja waale squares ke perimeter nikaalo. Bhuja 0.5 cm badhne pe perimeter ka kya hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The sum of two numbers is 64. One number is 10 more than the other. Find the numbers.
hinglish_roman: Do sankhyaon ka jod 64 hai. Ek sankhya doosri se 10 zyada hai. Sankhyaayein nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How can a polynomial be thought of as an input-output process? Find the outputs of 2x + 3 for x = 4 and x = −6.
hinglish_roman: Polynomial ko input-output process kaise maan sakte hain? x = 4 aur x = −6 ke liye 2x + 3 ke output nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the value of (a) 5x − 3 at x = 0, −1, 2 and (b) 7s² − 4s + 6 at s = 0, −3, 4.
hinglish_roman: Value nikaalo: (a) 5x − 3 ki x = 0, −1, 2 pe aur (b) 7s² − 4s + 6 ki s = 0, −3, 4 pe.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The present age of Salil's mother is three times Salil's present age. After 5 years, their ages will add up to 70 years. Find their present ages.
hinglish_roman: Salil ki maa ki abhi ki umar Salil ki umar ki teen guna hai. 5 saal baad dono ki umar ka jod 70 saal hoga. Dono ki abhi ki umar nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The difference between two positive integers is 63 and their ratio is 2 : 5. Find the integers.
hinglish_roman: Do positive integers ka fark 63 hai aur unka ratio 2 : 5 hai. Integers nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Ruby has 3 times as many two-rupee coins as five-rupee coins. Her total is ₹88. How many coins of each type does she have?
hinglish_roman: Ruby ke paas paanch rupaye ke sikkon se teen guna do rupaye ke sikke hain. Kul ₹88 hain. Har tarah ke kitne sikke hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A farmer cuts a 300-foot fence into two pieces; the longer is four times the shorter. Find their lengths. (b) The length of a rectangle is three more than twice its width and its perimeter is 24 cm. Find its dimensions.
hinglish_roman: (a) Kisaan 300 foot ki baad ko do tukdon mein kaatta hai; bada tukda chhote ka chaar guna hai. Lambaai nikaalo. (b) Rectangle ki lambaai uski chaudaai ke do guna se teen zyada hai aur perimeter 24 cm hai. Dimensions nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In a growing pattern of square tiles, stage 1 has 1 tile and each stage adds 2 more. Find the rule for stage n. How many tiles are in stages 15 and 26? Which stages have 21 and 47 tiles?
hinglish_roman: Square tiles ke badhte pattern mein stage 1 mein 1 tile hai aur har stage 2 tiles jodti hai. Stage n ka rule nikaalo. Stage 15 aur 26 mein kitne tiles hain? Kaun si stages mein 21 aur 47 tiles hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Bela has ₹100 pocket money and spends ₹5 every day. After how many days will she have ₹40 left? What amount is left on the 15th day, and when will all the money be spent?
hinglish_roman: Bela ke paas ₹100 pocket money hai aur woh roz ₹5 kharch karti hai. Kitne din baad ₹40 bachenge? 15ve din kitne bachenge, aur saare paise kab khatam honge?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: An auto-rickshaw fare is ₹25 for the first 2 km and increases by ₹15 per km after that. Find the fare for 10 km, the fare rule for n km, and the distance for a fare of ₹130.
hinglish_roman: Auto-rickshaw ka kiraaya pehle 2 km ke liye ₹25 hai aur uske baad har km ₹15 badhta hai. 10 km ka kiraaya, n km ka rule, aur ₹130 kiraaye ki doori nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A student has ₹500 and gets ₹150 every month. Write the amount after n months. (b) A rally starts with 120 members and 9 drop out each hour. Write the members after n hours. (c) Sarita reads 20 pages a day of a 500-page book. How many pages are left after 15 days?
hinglish_roman: (a) Student ke paas ₹500 hain aur har mahine ₹150 milte hain. n mahine baad ki rakam likho. (b) Rally 120 logon se shuru hoti hai aur har ghante 9 log chhod dete hain. n ghante baad ke log likho. (c) Sarita 500 panne ki kitaab roz 20 panne padhti hai. 15 din baad kitne panne bachenge?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A rectangle has length 13 cm. Find its area for breadths 12, 10 and 8 cm and the linear pattern. (b) A box has length 7 cm and breadth 11 cm. Find its volume for heights 5, 9 and 13 cm and the linear pattern.
hinglish_roman: (a) Rectangle ki lambaai 13 cm hai. Chaudaai 12, 10 aur 8 cm ke liye area aur linear pattern nikaalo. (b) Box ki lambaai 7 cm aur chaudaai 11 cm hai. Oonchaai 5, 9 aur 13 cm ke liye volume aur linear pattern nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Differentiate between linear growth and linear decay with examples.
hinglish_roman: Linear growth aur linear decay mein examples ke saath antar batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) For C(d) = 100 + 60d, find the cost for 15 km and the distance for a cost of ₹700. (b) For h(t) = 3 − 0.5t, find the water height after 5 months.
hinglish_roman: (a) C(d) = 100 + 60d ke liye 15 km ka kharcha aur ₹700 kharche ki doori nikaalo. (b) h(t) = 3 − 0.5t ke liye 5 mahine baad paani ki oonchaai nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A plant 1.75 ft tall grows 0.5 ft each month. Find its height after 7 months and the expression for h. (b) A phone bought for ₹10,000 loses ₹800 in value every year. Find its value after 3 years and the expression for v.
hinglish_roman: (a) 1.75 ft ooncha paudha har mahine 0.5 ft badhta hai. 7 mahine baad oonchaai aur h ka expression nikaalo. (b) ₹10,000 ke phone ki keemat har saal ₹800 ghatti hai. 3 saal baad keemat aur v ka expression nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A village has 750 people and 50 move in every year. Find the population after 6 years. (b) A ₹600 prepaid recharge is reduced by ₹15 each day. Write b(x) and find when the balance runs out.
hinglish_roman: (a) Gaon mein 750 log hain aur har saal 50 aate hain. 6 saal baad aabaadi nikaalo. (b) ₹600 ka prepaid recharge roz ₹15 ghatta hai. b(x) likho aur balance kab khatam hoga nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A telecom bill is ₹350 for 10 GB and ₹550 for 20 GB. If bill y = ax + b for x GB, find a and b. What do they represent?
hinglish_roman: Telecom bill 10 GB pe ₹350 aur 20 GB pe ₹550 hai. Agar x GB ke liye bill y = ax + b hai, toh a aur b nikaalo. Ye kya darshaate hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A learning platform bill is ₹400 for 10 modules and ₹500 for 14 modules. (b) A gym bill is ₹800 for 10 hours of badminton and ₹1100 for 15 hours. In each case y = ax + b; find a and b.
hinglish_roman: (a) Learning platform ka bill 10 modules pe ₹400 aur 14 modules pe ₹500 hai. (b) Gym ka bill 10 ghante badminton pe ₹800 aur 15 ghante pe ₹1100 hai. Har case mein y = ax + b; a aur b nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The relation between Celsius and Fahrenheit is °C = a°F + b. Ice melts at 0 °C = 32 °F and water boils at 100 °C = 212 °F. Find a and b.
hinglish_roman: Celsius aur Fahrenheit ka sambandh °C = a°F + b hai. Barf 0 °C = 32 °F pe pighalti hai aur paani 100 °C = 212 °F pe ubalta hai. a aur b nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How do you plot a linear equation like y = 2x + 1? How can you check whether a point lies on the line?
hinglish_roman: y = 2x + 1 jaisi linear equation ko kaise plot karte hain? Kaise check karein ki koi point line pe hai ya nahi?

subject: Mathematics
