original_english: In y = ax + b, what do a and b represent? How do the lines change when a or b is varied?
hinglish_roman: y = ax + b mein a aur b kya darshaate hain? a ya b badalne pe lines kaise badalti hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Differentiate between the graphs of y = 3x + 1 and y = −3x + 1.
hinglish_roman: y = 3x + 1 aur y = −3x + 1 ke graphs mein antar batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the slope and y-intercept of each line and where it cuts the y-axis: (i) y = −3x + 4, (ii) 2y = 4x + 7, (iii) 5y = 6x − 10, (iv) 3y = 6x − 11. Are any lines parallel?
hinglish_roman: Har line ka slope aur y-intercept nikaalo aur ye y-axis ko kahan kaatti hai: (i) y = −3x + 4, (ii) 2y = 4x + 7, (iii) 5y = 6x − 10, (iv) 3y = 6x − 11. Kya koi lines parallel hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: If a number is multiplied by 5/2 and 2/3 is added to the product, the result is −7/12. Find the number.
hinglish_roman: Kisi sankhya ko 5/2 se guna karke 2/3 jodne pe −7/12 milta hai. Sankhya nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A positive number is 5 times another. If 21 is added to both, one new number becomes twice the other. Find the numbers.
hinglish_roman: Ek positive sankhya doosri ki 5 guna hai. Dono mein 21 jodne pe ek nayi sankhya doosri ki do guna ho jaati hai. Sankhyaayein nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The digits of a two-digit number differ by 3. When the digits are interchanged and the new number is added to the original, the sum is 143. Find the numbers.
hinglish_roman: Do-ank sankhya ke ankon ka fark 3 hai. Ank badalkar bani sankhya ko asli sankhya mein jodne pe 143 milta hai. Sankhyaayein nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Temperature in Kelvin x K and Fahrenheit y °F are related by y = (9/5)(x − 273) + 32. (i) Find the temperature in °F for 313 K. (ii) Find the temperature in K for 158 °F.
hinglish_roman: Kelvin x K aur Fahrenheit y °F ka sambandh y = (9/5)(x − 273) + 32 hai. (i) 313 K ko °F mein badlo. (ii) 158 °F ko K mein badlo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The graph of a linear polynomial p(x) passes through (1, 5) and (3, 11). Find p(x) and the points where its graph cuts the axes.
hinglish_roman: Linear polynomial p(x) ka graph (1, 5) aur (3, 11) se guzarta hai. p(x) aur graph axes ko jahan kaatta hai woh points nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: p(x) = ax + b and q(x) = cx + d satisfy: p(0) = 5; p(x) − q(x) cuts the x-axis at (3, 0); and p(x) + q(x) = 6x + 4 for all x. Find p(x) and q(x).
hinglish_roman: p(x) = ax + b aur q(x) = cx + d aise hain ki: p(0) = 5; p(x) − q(x) x-axis ko (3, 0) pe kaatta hai; aur sabhi x ke liye p(x) + q(x) = 6x + 4. p(x) aur q(x) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The graph of p(x) = ax + b passes through (2, 3) and (6, 11). The graph of q(x) = cx + d passes through (4, −1) and is parallel to p(x). Find p(x), q(x) and where they meet the x-axis.
hinglish_roman: p(x) = ax + b ka graph (2, 3) aur (6, 11) se guzarta hai. q(x) = cx + d ka graph (4, −1) se guzarta hai aur p(x) ke parallel hai. p(x), q(x) aur x-axis se milne ke points nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In a matchstick pattern, each stage adds a hexagon sharing one side with the previous one. Stage 1 is one hexagon. Find the rule for stage n, the matchsticks at stage 15, and whether 200 matchsticks can form a stage.
hinglish_roman: Matchstick pattern mein har stage ek hexagon jodti hai jo pichhle hexagon se ek bhuja share karta hai. Stage 1 ek hexagon hai. Stage n ka rule, stage 15 ki matchsticks, aur kya 200 matchsticks se koi stage banti hai, nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Express work done w by a constant force of 3 units over distance d as a linear equation and find w for d = 2. (b) What do all linear functions f(x) = ax + a with a > 0 have in common?
hinglish_roman: (a) 3 units ke constant force se d doori pe kiye work w ko linear equation mein likho aur d = 2 pe w nikaalo. (b) a > 0 waale saare linear functions f(x) = ax + a mein kya common hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (a) 3z + 7 is a quadratic polynomial. (b) The constant 8 is a polynomial of degree 0. (c) A linear pattern has a constant difference between consecutive terms. (d) Lines y = 2x − 1 and y = 2x + 5 intersect.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) 3z + 7 quadratic polynomial hai. (b) Constant 8 degree 0 ka polynomial hai. (c) Linear pattern mein lagaataar terms ka fark constant hota hai. (d) Lines y = 2x − 1 aur y = 2x + 5 ek doosre ko kaatti hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is one-to-one correspondence? How did it give birth to natural numbers?
hinglish_roman: One-to-one correspondence kya hai? Isse natural numbers ka janm kaise hua?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Compare the Lebombo bone and the Ishango bone as early evidence of counting.
hinglish_roman: Counting ke shuruaati saboot ke roop mein Lebombo bone aur Ishango bone ki tulna karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A Lothal merchant gets 15 copper ingots for every 2 bags of spices. How many ingots for 12 bags? (b) The Ishango bone shows 11, 13, 17, 19. What do they have in common? Give the next three such numbers.
hinglish_roman: (a) Lothal ka vyapaari har 2 bori masaale ke 15 copper ingots paata hai. 12 bori ke kitne ingots milenge? (b) Ishango bone pe 11, 13, 17, 19 hain. Inme kya common hai? Agle teen aise numbers batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Natural numbers are closed under addition. Are they closed under subtraction? Also, how many can you count on one hand using finger joints, and how does it relate to base-12?
hinglish_roman: Natural numbers addition ke under closed hain. Kya ye subtraction ke under closed hain? Saath hi, ungliyon ke jodon se ek haath pe kitna gin sakte ho, aur iska base-12 se kya sambandh hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How did ancient Indians deal with large numbers? What were parārdha and tallakṣhaṇa?
hinglish_roman: Purane Bharatiya log badi sankhyaon ko kaise sambhaalte the? Parārdha aur tallakṣhaṇa kya the?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How did the philosophical idea of Śhūnyatā lead to the mathematical zero?
hinglish_roman: Śhūnyatā ke darshanik vichaar se mathematical zero kaise bana?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How did Brahmagupta define zero, and what rules did he give for it? What is the Bakhśhālī Manuscript's role?
hinglish_roman: Brahmagupta ne zero ki paribhasha kaise di, aur iske kya niyam diye? Bakhśhālī Manuscript ki kya bhoomika hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How did Brahmagupta introduce negative numbers? What are integers?
hinglish_roman: Brahmagupta ne negative numbers kaise shuru kiye? Integers kya hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State Brahmagupta's rules for adding and multiplying integers with examples.
hinglish_roman: Integers jodne aur guna karne ke Brahmagupta ke niyam examples ke saath batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why does a negative times a negative give a positive? Also explain why 10 − (−5) = 15 using debt.
hinglish_roman: Negative × negative positive kyun hota hai? Saath hi karz ke example se samjhao ki 10 − (−5) = 15 kyun hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Ladakh is at 4 °C at noon and the temperature drops by 15 °C by midnight. Find the midnight temperature. (b) A spice trader takes a loan of ₹850, makes a profit of ₹1,200, then a loss of ₹450. Find his final standing. (c) Compute (−12) × 5, (−8) × (−7), 0 − (−14), (−20) ÷ 4.
hinglish_roman: (a) Ladakh mein dopahar ko 4 °C hai aur aadhi raat tak temperature 15 °C girta hai. Aadhi raat ka temperature nikaalo. (b) Masaala vyapaari ₹850 ka loan leta hai, ₹1,200 profit kamaata hai, phir ₹450 ka loss hota hai. Aakhri sthiti nikaalo. (c) (−12) × 5, (−8) × (−7), 0 − (−14), (−20) ÷ 4 nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Define a rational number. Why must q ≠ 0? Do rational numbers include integers?
hinglish_roman: Rational number ki paribhasha do. q ≠ 0 kyun hona chahiye? Kya rational numbers mein integers aate hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Is the p/q representation of a rational number unique? How do we choose the standard form, and when are two rationals equal?
hinglish_roman: Kya rational number ka p/q roop unique hai? Standard roop kaise chunte hain, aur do rationals kab barabar hote hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State the rules for adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing rational numbers, and their closure and other properties.
hinglish_roman: Rational numbers ko jodne, ghataane, guna aur bhaag karne ke niyam, aur unki closure aur doosri properties batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A tailor has 15¾ metres of silk. One kurta needs 2¼ metres. Exactly how many kurtas can he make?
hinglish_roman: Darzi ke paas 15¾ metre silk hai. Ek kurte mein 2¼ metre lagta hai. Woh theek kitne kurte bana sakta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How do you represent a rational number p/q on the number line? Show where 3/4 and 9/4 lie.
hinglish_roman: Rational number p/q ko number line pe kaise dikhaate hain? 3/4 aur 9/4 kahan hain, dikhaao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the absolute value of a rational number? How is the distance between two rationals found?
hinglish_roman: Rational number ki absolute value kya hai? Do rationals ke beech ki doori kaise nikaalte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What does it mean that rational numbers are dense? Why is the average of two rationals always between them?
hinglish_roman: Rational numbers ke dense hone ka kya matlab hai? Do rationals ka average hamesha unke beech kyun hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find (a) three rational numbers between 3.1415 and 3.1416, (b) six rational numbers between 3 and 4, (c) five rational numbers between 2/5 and 3/5.
hinglish_roman: Nikaalo (a) 3.1415 aur 3.1416 ke beech teen rational numbers, (b) 3 aur 4 ke beech chhe rational numbers, (c) 2/5 aur 3/5 ke beech paanch rational numbers.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What are irrational numbers? How did Baudhāyana encounter one?
hinglish_roman: Irrational numbers kya hain? Baudhāyana ka saamna inse kaise hua?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Prove that √2 is irrational using proof by contradiction.
hinglish_roman: Proof by contradiction se siddh karo ki √2 irrational hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Prove that √5 is irrational.
hinglish_roman: Siddh karo ki √5 irrational hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How can you construct a line segment of length √2 and mark it on the number line? How can this be extended?
hinglish_roman: √2 lambaai ka line segment kaise banaate hain aur number line pe kaise mark karte hain? Ise aage kaise badha sakte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What contributions did Āryabhaṭa and Mādhava make to understanding π? Who proved π is irrational?
hinglish_roman: π ko samajhne mein Āryabhaṭa aur Mādhava ka kya yogdaan tha? π ko irrational kisne siddh kiya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What two kinds of decimal expansions can a rational number have? Why must a repeating decimal repeat, e.g. for 1/7?
hinglish_roman: Rational number ke decimal expansion do kis tarah ke ho sakte hain? Repeating decimal ko repeat kyun hona padta hai, jaise 1/7 mein?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: When does a rational number p/q in lowest terms have a terminating decimal? Decide for 7/20, 4/15 and 13/250 without long division.
hinglish_roman: Lowest terms waale rational p/q ka decimal kab terminating hota hai? Bina long division ke 7/20, 4/15 aur 13/250 ke liye batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A rational number in lowest form has denominator 2³ × 5. How many decimal places will its decimal expansion have? Explain.
hinglish_roman: Lowest form waale rational number ka denominator 2³ × 5 hai. Iske decimal expansion mein kitne decimal places honge? Samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that 0.9̅ (0.999…) is exactly equal to 1. What does this say about decimal representations?
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki 0.9̅ (0.999…) bilkul 1 ke barabar hai. Isse decimal representations ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a cyclic number? Explain with the decimal of 1/7.
hinglish_roman: Cyclic number kya hai? 1/7 ke decimal se samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Classify as rational or irrational, giving the fraction if rational: (i) √81, (ii) √12, (iii) 0.33333…, (iv) 0.123451234512345…, (v) 1.01001000100001…, (vi) 23.560185612239874790120.
hinglish_roman: Rational ya irrational batao, rational ho toh fraction bhi do: (i) √81, (ii) √12, (iii) 0.33333…, (iv) 0.123451234512345…, (v) 1.01001000100001…, (vi) 23.560185612239874790120.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Describe how our world of numbers grew in stages, from natural numbers to real numbers.
hinglish_roman: Natural numbers se real numbers tak hamari sankhyaon ki duniya kin charanon mein badhi, batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Is there a real number whose square is −1? What did mathematicians do about it?
hinglish_roman: Kya koi real number hai jiska square −1 ho? Mathematicians ne iske liye kya kiya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Find the rational number x such that x/3 + x/5 = 16/15. (b) If rationals x, y, z satisfy x + y + z = 0 and xy + yz + zx = 0, show that x = y = z = 0.
hinglish_roman: (a) Rational number x nikaalo jahan x/3 + x/5 = 16/15. (b) Agar rationals x, y, z ke liye x + y + z = 0 aur xy + yz + zx = 0, toh dikhaao ki x = y = z = 0.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (a) Every integer is a rational number. (b) Every rational number is an integer. (c) √2 has a repeating decimal expansion. (d) The Babylonians treated zero as a number they could add and multiply.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Har integer rational number hai. (b) Har rational number integer hai. (c) √2 ka decimal expansion repeating hai. (d) Babylonians zero ko aisi sankhya maante the jise jod aur guna kar sakte hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) Integers are denoted by ℤ, from the German word ______. (b) Brahmagupta called positive numbers ______ and negative numbers ______. (c) The number line formed by rationals and irrationals together is the set of ______ numbers.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) Integers ko ℤ likhte hain, German shabd ______ se. (b) Brahmagupta ne positive numbers ko ______ aur negative numbers ko ______ kaha. (c) Rationals aur irrationals milkar jo number line banaate hain woh ______ numbers ka set hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Take any three consecutive square numbers, add the smallest and largest, and subtract twice the middle one. Why is the answer always 2?
hinglish_roman: Koi bhi teen lagaataar square numbers lo, sabse chhote aur sabse bade ko jodo, aur beech waale ka do guna ghataao. Jawab hamesha 2 kyun aata hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the difference between an equation and an identity? Give an example of each.
hinglish_roman: Equation aur identity mein kya antar hai? Dono ka ek-ek example do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How can (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² be shown geometrically and proved for all numbers?
hinglish_roman: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² ko geometrically kaise dikhaate hain aur har number ke liye kaise siddh karte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Which is larger, (a + b)² or a² + b²? When are they equal?
hinglish_roman: (a + b)² aur a² + b² mein kaun bada hai? Ye barabar kab hote hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Expand using (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²: (i) (5x + 2y)², (ii) (7x + 4y)², (iii) (2.5p + 1.5q)².
hinglish_roman: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² se expand karo: (i) (5x + 2y)², (ii) (7x + 4y)², (iii) (2.5p + 1.5q)².

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using (a + b)² find 43², 64², 105² and 205².
hinglish_roman: (a + b)² se 43², 64², 105² aur 205² nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How can (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² be used to factorise? Factorise x² + 4x + 4, 36x² + 12x + 1 and 50p² + 60pq + 18q².
hinglish_roman: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b² se factorise kaise karte hain? x² + 4x + 4, 36x² + 12x + 1 aur 50p² + 60pq + 18q² ko factorise karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Factor completely: (i) 9x² + 24xy + 16y², (ii) 4s² + 20st + 25t², (iii) 49x² + 28xy + 4y², (iv) 16y² − 24y + 9.
hinglish_roman: Poori tarah factor karo: (i) 9x² + 24xy + 16y², (ii) 4s² + 20st + 25t², (iii) 49x² + 28xy + 4y², (iv) 16y² − 24y + 9.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How is (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² obtained, both algebraically and geometrically? Use it to find 29².
hinglish_roman: (a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b² algebraically aur geometrically kaise milta hai? Isse 29² nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using (a − b)², find 79², 193² and 299².
hinglish_roman: (a − b)² se 79², 193² aur 299² nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Derive the identity for (a + b + c)² and use it to find 119².
hinglish_roman: (a + b + c)² ki identity derive karo aur isse 119² nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Choose a suitable identity to find 117², 78², 198², 214², 1104² and 1120².
hinglish_roman: Sahi identity chunkar 117², 78², 198², 214², 1104² aur 1120² nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Expand: (i) (p + 3q + 7r)², (ii) (3x − 2y + 4z)², (iii) (−3m + 4k − l)².
hinglish_roman: Expand karo: (i) (p + 3q + 7r)², (ii) (3x − 2y + 4z)², (iii) (−3m + 4k − l)².

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What method did Śhrīdharāchārya propose for squaring numbers? Use it to find 35², 55², 65², 85² and 105². What pattern do you see?
hinglish_roman: Śhrīdharāchārya ne numbers ka square nikaalne ka kya tareeka diya? Isse 35², 55², 65², 85² aur 105² nikaalo. Kya pattern dikhta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How do algebra tiles show that (x + 3)(x + 4) = x² + 7x + 12? Can 7x be split as 2x + 5x to form the rectangle?
hinglish_roman: Algebra tiles kaise dikhaati hain ki (x + 3)(x + 4) = x² + 7x + 12? Kya 7x ko 2x + 5x mein todkar rectangle ban sakta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Generalise (x + a)(x + b) and (px + a)(qx + b). How do you factorise x² + 11x + 30 and x² − 5x + 6 without tiles?
hinglish_roman: (x + a)(x + b) aur (px + a)(qx + b) ko generalise karo. Bina tiles ke x² + 11x + 30 aur x² − 5x + 6 ko kaise factorise karte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Use suitable identities to find: (i) 23 × 17, (ii) 104 × 96, (iii) 17 × 21, (iv) 18 × 29, (v) 34 × 43, (vi) 97².
hinglish_roman: Sahi identities se nikaalo: (i) 23 × 17, (ii) 104 × 96, (iii) 17 × 21, (iv) 18 × 29, (v) 34 × 43, (vi) 97².

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Factor: (i) 9a² + b² + 4c² − 6ab + 12ac − 4bc, (ii) 16s² + 25t² − 40st, (iii) r² − r − 42, (iv) 49g² + 14gh + h², (v) 64u² + 121v² + 4w² − 176uv − 32uw + 44vw.
hinglish_roman: Factor karo: (i) 9a² + b² + 4c² − 6ab + 12ac − 4bc, (ii) 16s² + 25t² − 40st, (iii) r² − r − 42, (iv) 49g² + 14gh + h², (v) 64u² + 121v² + 4w² − 176uv − 32uw + 44vw.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: James writes (a − b)²(a + b) = (a² − 2ab + b²)(a + b). Reshma writes (a − b)²(a + b) = (a − b)(a² − b²). Who is correct?
hinglish_roman: James likhta hai (a − b)²(a + b) = (a² − 2ab + b²)(a + b). Reshma likhti hai (a − b)²(a + b) = (a − b)(a² − b²). Kaun sahi hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Derive (a + b)³ and (a − b)³. How can (a + b)³ be visualised with a cube?
hinglish_roman: (a + b)³ aur (a − b)³ derive karo. (a + b)³ ko cube se kaise dikhaate hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Find the side of a cube with volume p³ + 6p²q + 12pq² + 8q³. (b) Write 8n³ − 60n²m + 150nm² − 125m³ as (a − b)³.
hinglish_roman: (a) p³ + 6p²q + 12pq² + 8q³ volume waale cube ki bhuja nikaalo. (b) 8n³ − 60n²m + 150nm² − 125m³ ko (a − b)³ roop mein likho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using cube identities, find 199³ and (−107)³.
hinglish_roman: Cube identities se 199³ aur (−107)³ nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that (x − y)(x² + xy + y²) = x³ − y³ and state the identity for x³ + y³. Is x − y a factor of x⁴ − y⁴ and x⁵ − y⁵?
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki (x − y)(x² + xy + y²) = x³ − y³ aur x³ + y³ ki identity batao. Kya x − y, x⁴ − y⁴ aur x⁵ − y⁵ ka factor hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The sum of three numbers is 10, their product is 25 and the sum of their squares is 38. Find the sum of their cubes.
hinglish_roman: Teen sankhyaon ka jod 10, guna 25 aur squares ka jod 38 hai. Unke cubes ka jod nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: If a + b + c = 5 and ab + bc + ca = 10, prove that a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = −25.
hinglish_roman: Agar a + b + c = 5 aur ab + bc + ca = 10, toh siddh karo ki a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = −25.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the value of (i) x³ + y³ − 12xy + 64 when x + y = −4, (ii) x³ − 8y³ − 36xy − 216 when x = 2y + 6.
hinglish_roman: Value nikaalo (i) x³ + y³ − 12xy + 64 jab x + y = −4, (ii) x³ − 8y³ − 36xy − 216 jab x = 2y + 6.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Simplify (x² − 7x + 12)/(5x² + 5x − 100), assuming the denominator is not zero.
hinglish_roman: (x² − 7x + 12)/(5x² + 5x − 100) ko saral karo, maanate hue ki denominator zero nahi hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Saira forms a rectangle from one x × x square, 8 strips of x × 1 and 15 unit squares. Find its sides. (b) A rectangular pool's breadth is 4 m less than its length and its area is 96 m². Find its dimensions.
hinglish_roman: (a) Saira ek x × x square, x × 1 ki 8 pattiyon aur 15 unit squares se rectangle banaati hai. Uski bhujaayein nikaalo. (b) Rectangular pool ki chaudaai lambaai se 4 m kam aur area 96 m² hai. Dimensions nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A rectangle has area 25a² − 30ab + 9b². Find possible length and breadth. (b) A rectangle has area 36s² − 49t². (c) A cuboid has volume 3ps² − 15ps + 12p. Find possible dimensions.
hinglish_roman: (a) Rectangle ka area 25a² − 30ab + 9b² hai. Sambhav lambaai aur chaudaai nikaalo. (b) Rectangle ka area 36s² − 49t² hai. (c) Cuboid ka volume 3ps² − 15ps + 12p hai. Sambhav dimensions nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A square playground of side 40 m has a path of width s m around it. Find the area of the path. (b) A pool has area 2x² + 7x + 3 square hastas and width 2x + 1 hastas. Find its length. (c) A number plus its reciprocal is 10/3. Find the number.
hinglish_roman: (a) 40 m bhuja waale square playground ke chaaron taraf s m chauda raasta hai. Raaste ka area nikaalo. (b) Pool ka area 2x² + 7x + 3 square hasta aur chaudaai 2x + 1 hasta hai. Lambaai nikaalo. (c) Ek sankhya aur uske reciprocal ka jod 10/3 hai. Sankhya nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) By factoring, show that n³ − n is divisible by 6 for every natural number n. (b) If x − 2 and x − 1/2 are both factors of px² + 5x + r, show that p = r.
hinglish_roman: (a) Factor karke dikhaao ki har natural number n ke liye n³ − n, 6 se divisible hai. (b) Agar x − 2 aur x − 1/2 dono px² + 5x + r ke factors hain, toh dikhaao ki p = r.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the products: (i) (−3x + 4)², (ii) (2s + 7)(2s − 7), (iii) (s − 2t)(s² + 2st + 4t²).
hinglish_roman: Guna nikaalo: (i) (−3x + 4)², (ii) (2s + 7)(2s − 7), (iii) (s − 2t)(s² + 2st + 4t²).

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) x³ + y³ = (x + y)(______). (b) (x + a)(x + b) = x² + ______x + ab. (c) An identity is an equation that is true for ______ values of its variables.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) x³ + y³ = (x + y)(______). (b) (x + a)(x + b) = x² + ______x + ab. (c) Identity woh equation hai jo apne variables ki ______ values ke liye sahi ho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Define a circle using the idea of locus. What are its centre, radius, chord and diameter?
hinglish_roman: Locus ke idea se circle ki paribhasha do. Uska centre, radius, chord aur diameter kya hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Give examples of circular shapes found in nature and early art.
hinglish_roman: Prakriti aur shuruaati kala mein milne waale gol aakaaron ke examples do.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Describe the rotational and reflection symmetries of a circle.
hinglish_roman: Circle ki rotational aur reflection symmetries batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) How many rotational and reflection symmetries do a square, a regular pentagon and a regular hexagon have? (b) What is the longest chord in a circle of radius 5 units? Is there a smallest chord?
hinglish_roman: (a) Square, regular pentagon aur regular hexagon ki kitni rotational aur reflection symmetries hain? (b) 5 units radius waale circle ki sabse lambi chord kaun si hai? Kya koi sabse chhoti chord hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: How many circles pass through two given points A and B? Where do their centres lie, and what are the smallest and largest possible radii?
hinglish_roman: Do diye gaye points A aur B se kitne circles guzarte hain? Unke centres kahan hote hain, aur sabse chhota aur sabse bada radius kya ho sakta hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: State and explain Theorem 1: there is a unique circle through three non-collinear points. Why is there no circle through three collinear points?
hinglish_roman: Theorem 1 batao aur samjhao: teen non-collinear points se ek hi circle guzarta hai. Teen collinear points se koi circle kyun nahi guzarta?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: What are the circumcircle and circumcentre of a triangle? Where does the circumcentre lie for acute, obtuse and right-angled triangles?
hinglish_roman: Triangle ka circumcircle aur circumcentre kya hai? Acute, obtuse aur right-angled triangles mein circumcentre kahan hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Is the circumcentre inside or outside: (a) ΔABC with AB = 5 cm, ∠A = 70°, ∠B = 60°; (b) ΔABC with AB = 5 cm, ∠A = 100°, AC = 4 cm? (c) In ΔABC with AB = 6, BC = CA = 7 cm and circumcentre O, how do OA, OB and OC compare?
hinglish_roman: Circumcentre andar hai ya bahar: (a) ΔABC jisme AB = 5 cm, ∠A = 70°, ∠B = 60°; (b) ΔABC jisme AB = 5 cm, ∠A = 100°, AC = 4 cm? (c) ΔABC mein AB = 6, BC = CA = 7 cm aur circumcentre O hai, toh OA, OB aur OC kaise hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Prove Theorem 2 (equal chords subtend equal angles at the centre) and its converse, Theorem 3.
hinglish_roman: Theorem 2 (barabar chords centre pe barabar angle banaati hain) aur uska converse, Theorem 3, siddh karo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Show that the triangle formed by a chord and the centre is isosceles, and that two such triangles with equal bases are congruent.
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki chord aur centre se bana triangle isosceles hai, aur barabar base waale do aise triangles congruent hain.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Prove Theorem 4: the line joining the centre to the midpoint of a chord is perpendicular to the chord. State its converse (Theorem 5).
hinglish_roman: Theorem 4 siddh karo: centre ko chord ke midpoint se jodne waali line chord ke perpendicular hoti hai. Iska converse (Theorem 5) batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) Prove that the perpendicular bisector of a chord passes through the centre. (b) In an isosceles triangle ABC inscribed in a circle with AB = AC, show that the altitude from A passes through the centre.
hinglish_roman: (a) Siddh karo ki chord ka perpendicular bisector centre se guzarta hai. (b) Circle mein inscribed isosceles triangle ABC mein AB = AC hai; dikhaao ki A se altitude centre se guzarta hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Prove Theorem 6: equal chords are equidistant from the centre. What is its converse (Theorem 7)?
hinglish_roman: Theorem 6 siddh karo: barabar chords centre se barabar doori pe hoti hain. Iska converse (Theorem 7) kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Prove Theorem 8: of two unequal chords, the longer one is nearer the centre. Which chord is the longest?
hinglish_roman: Theorem 8 siddh karo: do asamaan chords mein lambi chord centre ke zyada paas hoti hai. Sabse lambi chord kaun si hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Explain why a chord at distance d from the centre of a circle of radius r has length 2√(r² − d²). Use it for r = 7 cm, d = 6 cm.
hinglish_roman: Samjhao ki r radius waale circle ke centre se d doori pe chord ki lambaai 2√(r² − d²) kyun hoti hai. r = 7 cm, d = 6 cm ke liye nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) A chord is 5 cm from the centre of a circle of radius 13 cm. Find its length. (b) A circle of radius 15 cm has a chord 9 cm from the centre. Find its length.
hinglish_roman: (a) 13 cm radius waale circle mein chord centre se 5 cm door hai. Lambaai nikaalo. (b) 15 cm radius waale circle mein chord centre se 9 cm door hai. Lambaai nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) A circle has diameter 26 cm and a chord of 24 cm. Find the chord's distance from the centre. (b) A 16 cm chord is 6 cm from the centre. Find the radius.
hinglish_roman: (a) Circle ka diameter 26 cm aur ek chord 24 cm ki hai. Chord ki centre se doori nikaalo. (b) 16 cm ki chord centre se 6 cm door hai. Radius nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) Parallel chords of 6 cm and 8 cm lie on opposite sides of the centre of a circle of radius 5 cm. Find the distance between their midpoints. (b) Parallel chords of 10 cm and 24 cm lie on the same side of the centre and are 7 cm apart. Find the radius.
hinglish_roman: (a) 5 cm radius waale circle mein 6 cm aur 8 cm ki parallel chords centre ke ulti taraf hain. Unke midpoints ki doori nikaalo. (b) 10 cm aur 24 cm ki parallel chords centre ki ek hi taraf hain aur 7 cm door hain. Radius nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: If chord AB is twice as far from the centre as chord CD, can we conclude CD = 2AB? Also, what shape do the midpoints of all chords of a fixed length form?
hinglish_roman: Agar chord AB centre se chord CD ki do guna doori pe hai, toh kya CD = 2AB keh sakte hain? Saath hi, ek fixed lambaai ki saari chords ke midpoints kaun sa aakaar banaate hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Let A be a point inside a circle with centre O. Show that the shortest chord through A is the one perpendicular to OA.
hinglish_roman: Centre O waale circle ke andar A ek point hai. Dikhaao ki A se guzarne waali sabse chhoti chord woh hai jo OA ke perpendicular ho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: What is an arc? Distinguish between a major arc and a minor arc and define the angle an arc subtends at the centre.
hinglish_roman: Arc kya hai? Major arc aur minor arc mein antar batao aur arc ka centre pe banaaya angle define karo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: State and prove Theorem 9: the angle subtended by an arc at the centre is double the angle it subtends at any point on the circle outside the arc.
hinglish_roman: Theorem 9 batao aur siddh karo: arc dwara centre pe banaaya angle, arc ke bahar circle ke kisi point pe banaaye angle ka do guna hota hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Why is the angle in a semicircle 90°? Use it: if AB is a diameter and C is on the circle, what is ∠ACB?
hinglish_roman: Semicircle mein angle 90° kyun hota hai? Ise lagao: agar AB diameter hai aur C circle pe hai, toh ∠ACB kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) An arc subtends 70° at the centre. What angle does it subtend at a point on the remaining part of the circle? (b) In a circle of radius 12 cm, the central angle AOB is 60°. Find the chord AB.
hinglish_roman: (a) Ek arc centre pe 70° banata hai. Circle ke baaki hisse ke point pe kitna angle banaayega? (b) 12 cm radius waale circle mein central angle AOB 60° hai. Chord AB nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: When are four points concyclic? State Theorem 10 and outline why it is true.
hinglish_roman: Chaar points concyclic kab hote hain? Theorem 10 batao aur samjhao ki ye kyun sahi hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: What is a cyclic quadrilateral? Prove that its opposite angles add up to 180° (Theorem 11). What is the converse?
hinglish_roman: Cyclic quadrilateral kya hai? Siddh karo ki iske opposite angles ka jod 180° hai (Theorem 11). Converse kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) In cyclic ABCD, ∠A = 75° and ∠B = 110°. Find ∠C and ∠D. (b) In cyclic PQRS, ∠P = (2x + 10)° and ∠R = (3x − 20)°. Find x, ∠P and ∠R.
hinglish_roman: (a) Cyclic ABCD mein ∠A = 75° aur ∠B = 110° hai. ∠C aur ∠D nikaalo. (b) Cyclic PQRS mein ∠P = (2x + 10)° aur ∠R = (3x − 20)° hai. x, ∠P aur ∠R nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Can a cyclic quadrilateral have angles ∠A = 80°, ∠B = 110°, ∠C = 100°, ∠D = 70°? Also find the area of a cyclic quadrilateral with sides 5, 5, 12, 12 units.
hinglish_roman: Kya kisi cyclic quadrilateral ke angles ∠A = 80°, ∠B = 110°, ∠C = 100°, ∠D = 70° ho sakte hain? Saath hi 5, 5, 12, 12 units bhujaon waale cyclic quadrilateral ka area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: (a) Show that a rectangle is the only parallelogram that can be inscribed in a circle. (b) Why does the exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equal the interior opposite angle?
hinglish_roman: (a) Dikhaao ki rectangle hi ekmaatra parallelogram hai jo circle mein inscribed ho sakta hai. (b) Cyclic quadrilateral ka exterior angle interior opposite angle ke barabar kyun hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: A regular hexagon is inscribed in a circle of radius r. Find the length of each side and the distance of each side from the centre.
hinglish_roman: r radius waale circle mein regular hexagon inscribed hai. Har bhuja ki lambaai aur centre se har bhuja ki doori nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: True or False: (a) Infinitely many circles pass through two given points. (b) A line can cut a circle at three distinct points. (c) The longer of two chords is farther from the centre. (d) All angles subtended by the same arc at points on the remaining part of the circle are equal.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Do diye gaye points se anginat circles guzarte hain. (b) Ek line circle ko teen alag points pe kaat sakti hai. (c) Do chords mein lambi chord centre se zyada door hoti hai. (d) Ek hi arc dwara circle ke baaki hisse ke points pe bane saare angles barabar hote hain.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round
original_english: Jamuna has a circular piece of paper and wants to find its centre. How can she do it using folding?
hinglish_roman: Jamuna ke paas kaagaz ka gol tukda hai aur woh uska centre dhoondhna chaahti hai. Modkar woh ye kaise kar sakti hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the perimeter of a shape? Give the perimeters of a square, an equilateral triangle and a rectangle.
hinglish_roman: Kisi shape ka perimeter kya hota hai? Square, equilateral triangle aur rectangle ke perimeter batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the C/D ratio of a circle? Why is it the same for all circles, and how can you estimate it at home?
hinglish_roman: Circle ka C/D ratio kya hai? Ye har circle ke liye same kyun hai, aur ghar pe iska anumaan kaise lagaayein?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: List the main historical approximations of π mentioned in the chapter.
hinglish_roman: Chapter mein bataaye gaye π ke mukhya aitihaasik anumaan batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why was Mādhava's discovery about π a turning point? Who first used the symbol π and why?
hinglish_roman: π ke baare mein Mādhava ki khoj ek mod kyun thi? π symbol sabse pehle kisne aur kyun use kiya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why does an inscribed regular hexagon show that π > 3?
hinglish_roman: Andar bana regular hexagon kyun dikhaata hai ki π > 3?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why is π irrational, and what does this mean for approximations like 22/7? How can you remember its digits?
hinglish_roman: π irrational kyun hai, aur 22/7 jaise anumaanon ke liye iska kya matlab hai? Iske digits kaise yaad rakhein?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Derive the length of a semicircle, a quarter circle and a general arc subtending θ° at the centre.
hinglish_roman: Semicircle, quarter circle aur centre pe θ° banaane waale general arc ki lambaai derive karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using π ≈ 22/7: (a) A circle's perimeter is 44 cm. Find its radius. (b) Find the circumference (3 significant figures) for radii 7 cm, 10 cm and 12 cm.
hinglish_roman: π ≈ 22/7 lekar: (a) Circle ka perimeter 44 cm hai. Radius nikaalo. (b) 7 cm, 10 cm aur 12 cm radius ke liye circumference (3 significant figures) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using π ≈ 22/7, find (a) the arc length for r = 3.5 cm, θ = 60°; (b) the arc length for r = 6.3 m, θ = 120°; (c) the perimeter of a sector of radius 14 cm and angle 75°.
hinglish_roman: π ≈ 22/7 lekar nikaalo (a) r = 3.5 cm, θ = 60° ke liye arc ki lambaai; (b) r = 6.3 m, θ = 120° ke liye arc ki lambaai; (c) 14 cm radius aur 75° angle waale sector ka perimeter.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using π ≈ 22/7: (a) A car tyre has diameter 56 cm. How far does the car go in one revolution, and how many revolutions for 10 km? (b) A bicycle wheel of diameter 60 cm turns 100 times. How far does it go? (c) The ratio of the perimeters of two circles is 5 : 4. What is the ratio of their radii?
hinglish_roman: π ≈ 22/7 lekar: (a) Car ke tyre ka diameter 56 cm hai. Ek chakkar mein car kitna chalegi, aur 10 km ke liye kitne chakkar? (b) 60 cm diameter ka cycle pahiya 100 baar ghoomta hai. Kitni doori tay hui? (c) Do circles ke perimeters ka ratio 5 : 4 hai. Radii ka ratio kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why are staggered starts used in a 400 m track? Show that one lap at 0.3 m from the inner border of the innermost lane is 400 m, and find the stagger needed between adjacent lanes.
hinglish_roman: 400 m track pe staggered start kyun hote hain? Dikhaao ki sabse andar ki lane mein andar ki seema se 0.3 m pe ek chakkar 400 m hai, aur lagaataar lanes ke beech stagger nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Two circles of radius r each pass through the other's centre. Find the perimeter of the combined outer shape. (b) Points P and Q are joined by one big semicircle a, and also by three smaller semicircles b, c, d along PQ. Which path is longer?
hinglish_roman: (a) r radius ke do circles ek doosre ke centre se guzarte hain. Mile hue bahari shape ka perimeter nikaalo. (b) P aur Q ek bade semicircle a se, aur PQ ke saath teen chhote semicircles b, c, d se bhi jude hain. Kaun sa raasta lamba hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How is the area of a parallelogram shown to be base × height, and the area of a triangle ½ × base × height? Can a parallelogram's area be found from its sides alone?
hinglish_roman: Parallelogram ka area base × height aur triangle ka area ½ × base × height kaise dikhaate hain? Kya sirf bhujaon se parallelogram ka area nikal sakta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Prove that a median divides a triangle into two triangles of equal area. Why is this surprising?
hinglish_roman: Siddh karo ki median triangle ko barabar area ke do triangles mein baantta hai. Ye hairaan karne waala kyun hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) ABCD is a parallelogram and P, Q are points on AB. Compare area(ΔPCD) and area(ΔQCD). (b) P is any point on median AD of ΔABC. Show area(ΔABP) = area(ΔACP). (c) P is inside square ABCD. Compare area(ΔPAB) + area(ΔPCD) with area(ΔPBC) + area(ΔPDA).
hinglish_roman: (a) ABCD parallelogram hai aur P, Q, AB pe points hain. area(ΔPCD) aur area(ΔQCD) ki tulna karo. (b) ΔABC ki median AD pe P koi point hai. Dikhaao area(ΔABP) = area(ΔACP). (c) P square ABCD ke andar hai. area(ΔPAB) + area(ΔPCD) ki tulna area(ΔPBC) + area(ΔPDA) se karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Consider all rectangles with perimeter 40 units. How many are there? Which has the largest area, and is there one with the smallest area? Do two rectangles with the same area and perimeter have to be congruent?
hinglish_roman: 40 units perimeter waale saare rectangles socho. Aise kitne hain? Kiska area sabse zyada hai, aur kya koi sabse kam area waala hai? Kya same area aur perimeter waale do rectangles congruent hone chahiye?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State Heron's formula and verify it for an equilateral triangle of side a and for a 3-4-5 triangle.
hinglish_roman: Heron's formula batao aur a bhuja waale equilateral triangle aur 3-4-5 triangle ke liye jaancho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A triangle has sides 8 cm and 11 cm and perimeter 32 cm. Find its area. (b) A triangular plot has sides in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7 and perimeter 300 m. Find its area.
hinglish_roman: (a) Triangle ki do bhujaayein 8 cm aur 11 cm aur perimeter 32 cm hai. Area nikaalo. (b) Triangular plot ki bhujaayein 3 : 5 : 7 ke ratio mein aur perimeter 300 m hai. Area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) An isosceles triangle has perimeter 40 cm with equal sides of 15 cm. Find its area. (b) An isosceles triangle has base 10 cm and area 60 cm². Find its equal sides. (c) Find the area of a triangle with sides 7, 24, 25 cm in two ways.
hinglish_roman: (a) Isosceles triangle ka perimeter 40 cm aur barabar bhujaayein 15 cm hain. Area nikaalo. (b) Isosceles triangle ka base 10 cm aur area 60 cm² hai. Barabar bhujaayein nikaalo. (c) 7, 24, 25 cm bhujaon waale triangle ka area do tarah se nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A right-angled triangle has area 54 cm² and one leg 12 cm. Find its perimeter. (b) A triangle's sides are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4 with perimeter 45 cm. Find its area.
hinglish_roman: (a) Right-angled triangle ka area 54 cm² aur ek bhuja 12 cm hai. Perimeter nikaalo. (b) Triangle ki bhujaayein 2 : 3 : 4 ke ratio mein aur perimeter 45 cm hai. Area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Give two other formulas for the area of a triangle involving circles.
hinglish_roman: Circles se jude triangle ke area ke do aur formulas batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Can the area of a quadrilateral be found from its four sides alone? State Brahmagupta's formula and explain how it generalises Heron's formula.
hinglish_roman: Kya sirf chaar bhujaon se quadrilateral ka area nikal sakta hai? Brahmagupta's formula batao aur samjhao ki ye Heron's formula ko kaise generalise karta hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Verify Brahmagupta's formula for a rectangle with sides a and b, and use the area formula to find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 40 cm and 20 cm and equal non-parallel sides of 26 cm.
hinglish_roman: a aur b bhujaon waale rectangle ke liye Brahmagupta's formula jaancho, aur 40 cm aur 20 cm parallel bhujaon aur 26 cm ki barabar non-parallel bhujaon waale trapezium ka area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What are 'special cases' and 'generalisation' in mathematics? Give examples.
hinglish_roman: Maths mein 'special case' aur 'generalisation' kya hain? Examples do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What does 'squaring a rectangle' mean? Describe Baudhāyana's construction and the identity behind it.
hinglish_roman: 'Rectangle ko square karna' ka kya matlab hai? Baudhāyana ka construction aur uske peeche ki identity batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why must the area of a circle be proportional to the square of its circumference? What did the Babylonians and Egyptians use?
hinglish_roman: Circle ka area uski circumference ke square ke anupaati kyun hona chahiye? Babylonians aur Egyptians kya use karte the?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Explain how Archimedes and Nīlakaṇṭha showed that the area of a circle is πr².
hinglish_roman: Samjhao ki Archimedes aur Nīlakaṇṭha ne kaise dikhaaya ki circle ka area πr² hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What are a sector and a segment of a circle? Derive the formula for the area of a sector.
hinglish_roman: Circle ka sector aur segment kya hain? Sector ke area ka formula derive karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using π ≈ 22/7: (a) Find the area of a sector of radius 7 cm and angle 60°. (b) Find the area of a quadrant of a circle with circumference 44 cm. (c) A clock's minute hand is 7 cm. Find the area it sweeps in 10 minutes.
hinglish_roman: π ≈ 22/7 lekar: (a) 7 cm radius aur 60° angle waale sector ka area nikaalo. (b) 44 cm circumference waale circle ke quadrant ka area nikaalo. (c) Ghadi ki minute ki sui 7 cm ki hai. 10 minute mein woh kitna area ghoomti hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A chord of a circle of radius 10 cm subtends 90° at the centre. Find the minor and major sector areas (π ≈ 3.14). (b) A chord of a circle of radius 15 cm subtends 60°. Find the minor and major segment areas (π ≈ 3.14, √3 ≈ 1.73).
hinglish_roman: (a) 10 cm radius waale circle ki chord centre pe 90° banaati hai. Minor aur major sector ke area nikaalo (π ≈ 3.14). (b) 15 cm radius waale circle ki chord 60° banaati hai. Minor aur major segment ke area nikaalo (π ≈ 3.14, √3 ≈ 1.73).

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A car has two non-overlapping wipers, each with a 28 cm blade sweeping 120°. Find the total area cleaned per sweep (π ≈ 22/7).
hinglish_roman: Car mein do wipers hain jo overlap nahi karte, har ek ka blade 28 cm aur 120° ghoomta hai. Har sweep mein saaf hua kul area nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7).

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that the ratio of the area of an inscribed square to the circle is 2/π, and of an inscribed equilateral triangle is 3√3/(4π). Why is the hexagon's ratio 3√3/(2π) exactly twice the triangle's?
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki circle mein bane square ka circle se area ratio 2/π, aur equilateral triangle ka 3√3/(4π) hai. Hexagon ka ratio 3√3/(2π) triangle ka theek do guna kyun hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Two concentric circles have a chord BC (length l) of the larger circle touching the smaller one. Show that the ring between them has area πl²/4. (b) Find the area of a quadrant of a circle with circumference 66 cm (π ≈ 22/7).
hinglish_roman: (a) Do concentric circles hain aur bade circle ki chord BC (lambaai l) chhote circle ko chhooti hai. Dikhaao ki unke beech ki ring ka area πl²/4 hai. (b) 66 cm circumference waale circle ke quadrant ka area nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7).

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Four semicircles are drawn inside a square of side 2 units on its sides as diameters, forming a 4-petal flower. Find the perimeter and area of the flower.
hinglish_roman: 2 units bhuja waale square ke andar uski bhujaon ko diameter maankar chaar semicircles bane hain, jo 4 pankhudi ka phool banaate hain. Phool ka perimeter aur area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that the area of a kite (or rhombus) is half the product of its diagonals. If one diagonal of a rhombus is twice the other and its area is 128 cm², find the shorter diagonal.
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki kite (ya rhombus) ka area uske diagonals ke guna ka aadha hai. Agar rhombus ka ek diagonal doosre ka do guna aur area 128 cm² hai, toh chhota diagonal nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) π is the ratio of a circle's ______ to its ______. (b) The arc length for central angle θ is ______. (c) The area of a sector with angle θ is ______. (d) The Greek word behind the symbol π is ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) π circle ki ______ aur ______ ka ratio hai. (b) Central angle θ ke liye arc ki lambaai ______ hai. (c) θ angle waale sector ka area ______ hai. (d) π symbol ke peeche ka Greek shabd ______ hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What is probability? What are random events, and what is subjective probability?
hinglish_roman: Probability kya hai? Random events kya hote hain, aur subjective probability kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What is randomness? What is a random experiment? Why is rain considered random?
hinglish_roman: Randomness kya hai? Random experiment kya hota hai? Baarish ko random kyun maana jaata hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Why is a coin toss considered a fair way to decide which team bats first in cricket?
hinglish_roman: Cricket mein kaun si team pehle batting karegi, ye tay karne ke liye toss ko nyaayapoorn tareeka kyun maana jaata hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Describe the probability scale from 0 to 1 with examples of each region.
hinglish_roman: 0 se 1 tak ke probability scale ko har hisse ke examples ke saath samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Rank each event as impossible, less likely, even chance, more likely or certain: (i) next Monday comes after Sunday, (ii) it snows in Mumbai in July, (iii) an elephant walks through your classroom today, (iv) you greet at least one friend at school tomorrow.
hinglish_roman: Har event ko namumkin, kam sambhav, barabar sambhaavna, zyada sambhav ya pakka mein rakho: (i) agla Monday Sunday ke baad aayega, (ii) July mein Mumbai mein barf giregi, (iii) aaj ek haathi aapki class se guzrega, (iv) kal school mein aap kam se kam ek dost ko greet karoge.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What are the two main ways of estimating probability objectively? How do they differ?
hinglish_roman: Probability ka objective anumaan lagaane ke do mukhya tareeke kya hain? Ye kaise alag hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Define outcome, sample space and experimental probability. A die rolled 50 times shows 4 exactly 8 times. Find the experimental probability of rolling a 4.
hinglish_roman: Outcome, sample space aur experimental probability ki paribhasha do. 50 baar phenke gaye die pe 4 theek 8 baar aaya. 4 aane ki experimental probability nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Find the theoretical probability of (a) getting a 4 on a fair die, (b) picking B from the letters of 'PROBABILITY', (c) getting an even number on a fair die.
hinglish_roman: Theoretical probability nikaalo: (a) fair die pe 4 aana, (b) 'PROBABILITY' ke aksharon se B chunna, (c) fair die pe even number aana.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: In a class of 50, 20 like mango, 15 apples, 10 bananas and 5 grapes. What is the probability that a random student likes mango? How many mangoes should be bought for a school of 1500, and what is sampling?
hinglish_roman: 50 ki class mein 20 ko aam, 15 ko seb, 10 ko kela aur 5 ko angoor pasand hai. Random student ko aam pasand hone ki probability kya hai? 1500 ke school ke liye kitne aam khareedne chahiye, aur sampling kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: (a) A sample of 30 sweets has 10 red, 8 green, 7 yellow and 5 blue. Find P(green) and estimate the yellow sweets in a bag of 600. (b) In a sample of 40 students, 14 prefer Science, 11 Arts, 9 Sports and 6 Debate club. Find P(Arts) and estimate Sports fans in a school of 800.
hinglish_roman: (a) 30 toffiyon ke sample mein 10 laal, 8 hari, 7 peeli aur 5 neeli hain. P(hari) nikaalo aur 600 ke bag mein peeli toffiyon ka anumaan lagao. (b) 40 students ke sample mein 14 Science, 11 Arts, 9 Sports aur 6 Debate club pasand karte hain. P(Arts) nikaalo aur 800 ke school mein Sports waalon ka anumaan lagao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: A die rolled 12 times shows '3' three times. Find the experimental and theoretical probabilities of rolling a 3. Why might they differ, and what happens for 60, 600 or 6000 rolls?
hinglish_roman: 12 baar phenke die pe '3' teen baar aaya. 3 aane ki experimental aur theoretical probability nikaalo. Ye alag kyun ho sakti hain, aur 60, 600 ya 6000 baar phenkne pe kya hoga?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What is the Gambler's Fallacy? Explain with coin and Snakes and Ladders examples.
hinglish_roman: Gambler's Fallacy kya hai? Sikke aur Snakes and Ladders ke examples se samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What is the origin of the game of Snakes and Ladders?
hinglish_roman: Snakes and Ladders khel ki shuruaat kahan se hui?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What rules must a sample space follow? Give the sample spaces and sizes for rain tomorrow, a match result, one coin, one die and two coins.
hinglish_roman: Sample space ko kin niyamon ka paalan karna chahiye? Kal ki baarish, match ka nateeja, ek sikka, ek die aur do sikkon ke sample spaces aur sizes batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What is an event? Give examples of events as subsets of sample spaces.
hinglish_roman: Event kya hai? Sample space ke subset ke roop mein events ke examples do.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Write the sample space for: (i) rolling a die and tossing a coin together, (ii) a ball drawn from a box of 5 green and 7 red balls, (iii) a snack (Samosa, Pakora, Bhaji) with a drink (Chai, Lassi) at a village fair. Also list the event 'Samosa as snack'.
hinglish_roman: Sample space likho: (i) die phenkna aur sikka uchhaalna saath mein, (ii) 5 hari aur 7 laal gendon ke box se ek gend nikaalna, (iii) gaon ke mele mein snack (Samosa, Pakora, Bhaji) aur drink (Chai, Lassi). Event 'Samosa snack' bhi likho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: What is a tree diagram and when is it useful? Use one for tossing a coin twice and find P(HH) and P(one head and one tail).
hinglish_roman: Tree diagram kya hai aur kab kaam aata hai? Sikka do baar uchhaalne ke liye ise banao aur P(HH) aur P(ek head aur ek tail) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: (a) Basket A has 1 apple and 2 oranges; basket B has 1 banana and 1 mango. One fruit is picked from each. Find the sample space and P(apple and banana). (b) A box has 3 red, 4 black and 2 green pens. You pick one and put it back, then a friend picks one. Find P(both same colour).
hinglish_roman: (a) Tokri A mein 1 seb aur 2 santre; tokri B mein 1 kela aur 1 aam hai. Har tokri se ek phal chuna jaata hai. Sample space aur P(seb aur kela) nikaalo. (b) Box mein 3 laal, 4 kaale aur 2 hare pen hain. Aap ek nikaalkar wapas rakhte ho, phir dost ek nikaalta hai. P(dono same rang) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Which of these experiments have equally likely outcomes? (i) A car starts or does not start. (ii) Tossing a fair coin. (iii) Rolling a fair die. (iv) Choosing a marble from 3 red and 7 blue. (v) A baby is born a boy or a girl.
hinglish_roman: Inme se kin experiments ke outcomes barabar sambhav hain? (i) Car start hoti hai ya nahi. (ii) Fair sikka uchhaalna. (iii) Fair die phenkna. (iv) 3 laal aur 7 neeli goliyon se ek chunna. (v) Bachcha ladka ya ladki paida hota hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Find: (i) P(at least one head) when two coins are tossed, (ii) P(even) for a card drawn from cards 1–10, (iii) P(number > 4) on a die, (iv) P(not red) from 3 red, 2 blue, 1 green ball, (v) P(exactly two heads) when three coins are tossed.
hinglish_roman: Nikaalo: (i) do sikke uchhaalne pe P(kam se kam ek head), (ii) 1–10 cards mein se P(even), (iii) die pe P(4 se bada), (iv) 3 laal, 2 neeli, 1 hari gend se P(laal nahi), (v) teen sikke uchhaalne pe P(theek do heads).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: (a) A spinner shows 1 to 8 equally likely. Find P(8), P(odd), P(> 2), P(< 9), P(multiple of 3). (b) Cards spell 'PEACE'. Find P(P, E or C) and P(not E).
hinglish_roman: (a) Spinner pe 1 se 8 barabar sambhav hain. P(8), P(odd), P(> 2), P(< 9), P(3 ka multiple) nikaalo. (b) Cards pe 'PEACE' likha hai. P(P, E ya C) aur P(E nahi) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: A tyre company records distances before replacement for 1000 tyres: less than 4000 km: 20; 4001–9000: 210; 9001–14000: 325; more than 14000: 445. Find the probability that a tyre lasts (i) less than 4000 km, (ii) between 4000 and 14000 km, (iii) more than 14000 km. Also, if 15 of 50 students like football, what is the relative frequency?
hinglish_roman: Tyre company ne 1000 tyres ke badalne se pehle ki doori darj ki: 4000 km se kam: 20; 4001–9000: 210; 9001–14000: 325; 14000 se zyada: 445. Probability nikaalo ki tyre (i) 4000 km se kam, (ii) 4000 aur 14000 km ke beech, (iii) 14000 km se zyada chale. Saath hi, 50 mein se 15 students ko football pasand hai toh relative frequency kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: A basket has 4 red and 5 blue balls. One ball is drawn and laid aside, then a second is drawn. Find (i) P(red then blue), (ii) P(two blue).
hinglish_roman: Tokri mein 4 laal aur 5 neeli gendein hain. Ek gend nikaalkar alag rakhi jaati hai, phir doosri nikaali jaati hai. Nikaalo (i) P(pehle laal phir neeli), (ii) P(dono neeli).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: (i) Two dice are rolled. Find P(sum is a prime greater than 5). (ii) Three coins are tossed. Find P(first coin is heads and exactly two heads in total). (iii) A four-digit number is formed from 1, 2, 3, 4 without repetition. Find P(it is even).
hinglish_roman: (i) Do dice phenke gaye. P(jod 5 se bada prime) nikaalo. (ii) Teen sikke uchhaale gaye. P(pehla sikka heads aur kul theek do heads) nikaalo. (iii) 1, 2, 3, 4 se bina doharaaye chaar-ank sankhya banti hai. P(even) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: (i) A bag has 4 red, 3 green and 2 blue balls. Two are drawn without replacement. Find P(different colours). (ii) A student guesses all 3 questions of a test, each with 4 options and one correct answer. Find P(exactly 2 correct).
hinglish_roman: (i) Bag mein 4 laal, 3 hari aur 2 neeli gendein hain. Bina wapas rakhe do nikaali gayi. P(alag rang) nikaalo. (ii) Ek student test ke 3 sawaal, har ek mein 4 options aur ek sahi jawab, andaaze se karta hai. P(theek 2 sahi) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: (a) Three coins are tossed and the number of heads recorded. Which is the correct sample space: {1, 2, 3}, {0, 1, 2}, {0, 1, 2, 3, 4} or {0, 1, 2, 3}? (b) A box has balls 1 to 4. What are the sample-space sizes when two balls are drawn with and without replacement?
hinglish_roman: (a) Teen sikke uchhaalkar heads ki sankhya darj ki jaati hai. Sahi sample space kaun sa hai: {1, 2, 3}, {0, 1, 2}, {0, 1, 2, 3, 4} ya {0, 1, 2, 3}? (b) Box mein 1 se 4 tak ki gendein hain. Wapas rakhkar aur bina wapas rakhe do gendein nikaalne pe sample space ke size kya hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: When a pair of dice is thrown, give an event with probability 0 and an event with probability 1. Also, a dye dropped at random on a 3 m × 2 m rectangle may land inside a circle of diameter 1 m in it. Find that probability.
hinglish_roman: Do dice phenkne pe probability 0 waala ek event aur probability 1 waala ek event batao. Saath hi, 3 m × 2 m ke rectangle pe random giraaya gaya dye usme bane 1 m diameter ke circle ke andar gir sakta hai. Uski probability nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (i) The probability of an impossible event is ______. (ii) The set of all possible outcomes of a random experiment is the ______. (iii) The probability of a certain event is ______. (iv) The probability of heads on a fair coin is ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (i) Namumkin event ki probability ______ hai. (ii) Random experiment ke saare sambhav outcomes ka set ______ hai. (iii) Pakke event ki probability ______ hai. (iv) Fair sikke pe heads ki probability ______ hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: The Mathematics of Maybe: Introduction to Probability
original_english: True or False: (a) After five tails in a row on a fair coin, heads is more likely on the next toss. (b) Theoretical probability requires performing an experiment. (c) An event is a subset of the sample space. (d) With very many trials, experimental probability tends towards theoretical probability.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Fair sikke pe lagaataar paanch tails ke baad agle toss pe heads zyada sambhav hai. (b) Theoretical probability ke liye experiment karna zaroori hai. (c) Event sample space ka subset hai. (d) Bahut zyada trials pe experimental probability theoretical ki taraf jaati hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What is a sequence? Give examples of finite and infinite sequences and explain the tₙ notation.
hinglish_roman: Sequence kya hai? Finite aur infinite sequences ke examples do aur tₙ notation samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: How are triangular numbers related to natural numbers, and square numbers to odd numbers?
hinglish_roman: Triangular numbers ka natural numbers se, aur square numbers ka odd numbers se kya sambandh hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: For 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, …, find the next four terms and the first 10 terms of its sequence of running sums. Also write t₅ to t₈ for the triangular numbers.
hinglish_roman: 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, … ke agle chaar terms aur iske running sums ke pehle 10 terms nikaalo. Triangular numbers ke t₅ se t₈ bhi likho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What is an explicit rule for a sequence? Why is it useful? Use uₙ = 2n − 1 to find the 53rd, 108th and 1170th odd numbers and the position of 137.
hinglish_roman: Sequence ka explicit rule kya hai? Ye kyun kaam ka hai? uₙ = 2n − 1 se 53va, 108va aur 1170va odd number aur 137 ki position nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: For sₙ = 5n − 2, write the first 6 terms and the 100th and 1000th terms. Are 308 and 471 terms of this sequence? Why must n be a natural number?
hinglish_roman: sₙ = 5n − 2 ke pehle 6 terms aur 100va aur 1000va term likho. Kya 308 aur 471 is sequence ke terms hain? n natural number kyun hona chahiye?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: For tₙ = 3n − 7: (i) find t₁, t₂, t₃, t₁₂, t₁₈ and t₅₀; (ii) which term is 332? (iii) is 557 a term?
hinglish_roman: tₙ = 3n − 7 ke liye: (i) t₁, t₂, t₃, t₁₂, t₁₈ aur t₅₀ nikaalo; (ii) 332 kaun sa term hai? (iii) kya 557 term hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Find the first five terms of (i) tₙ = 3n − 4, (ii) tₙ = 2 − 5n, (iii) tₙ = n² − 2n + 3. For tₙ = 5n − 3, find t₁₀ and t₁₅, check whether 97 and 172 are terms, and find which term is 607.
hinglish_roman: Pehle paanch terms nikaalo (i) tₙ = 3n − 4, (ii) tₙ = 2 − 5n, (iii) tₙ = n² − 2n + 3. tₙ = 5n − 3 ke liye t₁₀ aur t₁₅ nikaalo, check karo ki 97 aur 172 terms hain ya nahi, aur 607 kaun sa term hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What is a recursive rule? Write 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, … both explicitly and recursively. What is its limitation?
hinglish_roman: Recursive rule kya hai? 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, … ko explicitly aur recursively likho. Iski seema kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Find the first four terms of (a) u₁ = 1, uₙ = 2uₙ₋₁ + 3; is 133 a term? (b) s₁ = 3, sₙ = sₙ₋₁(sₙ₋₁ − 1).
hinglish_roman: Pehle chaar terms nikaalo (a) u₁ = 1, uₙ = 2uₙ₋₁ + 3; kya 133 term hai? (b) s₁ = 3, sₙ = sₙ₋₁(sₙ₋₁ − 1).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) t₁ = −5, tₙ₊₁ = tₙ + 3. Find the first five terms. Is 52 a term? (b) T₁ = 1, T₂ = 2, T₃ = 4, Tₙ = Tₙ₋₁ + Tₙ₋₂ + Tₙ₋₃. Find T₄ to T₈.
hinglish_roman: (a) t₁ = −5, tₙ₊₁ = tₙ + 3. Pehle paanch terms nikaalo. Kya 52 term hai? (b) T₁ = 1, T₂ = 2, T₃ = 4, Tₙ = Tₙ₋₁ + Tₙ₋₂ + Tₙ₋₃. T₄ se T₈ nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What is the Virahānka–Fibonacci sequence? Who studied it and in what context?
hinglish_roman: Virahānka–Fibonacci sequence kya hai? Ise kisne aur kis sandarbh mein padha?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) P₁ = 1, P₂ = 2 and Pₙ = P₁ + P₂ + … + Pₙ₋₁ + 1 for n > 2. Find P₁ to P₈ and simpler rules. (b) W₁ = 1, W₂ = 2 and Wₙ = W₁ + … + Wₙ₋₂ + 2. Find W₁ to W₈. What sequence is it?
hinglish_roman: (a) P₁ = 1, P₂ = 2 aur n > 2 ke liye Pₙ = P₁ + P₂ + … + Pₙ₋₁ + 1. P₁ se P₈ aur saral rules nikaalo. (b) W₁ = 1, W₂ = 2 aur Wₙ = W₁ + … + Wₙ₋₂ + 2. W₁ se W₈ nikaalo. Ye kaun si sequence hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What is an arithmetic progression? Write its general form and nth term, and its recursive rule.
hinglish_roman: Arithmetic progression kya hai? Iska general roop, nth term aur recursive rule likho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: A pattern of squares has 1, 5, 9, 13, … tiny squares in stages 1, 2, 3, 4. Find the rule for stage n and the squares in stages 5, 6, 10, 11, 12 and 20. What do you see when you plot (stage, squares)?
hinglish_roman: Squares ke ek pattern mein stage 1, 2, 3, 4 pe 1, 5, 9, 13, … chhote squares hain. Stage n ka rule aur stage 5, 6, 10, 11, 12 aur 20 ke squares nikaalo. (stage, squares) plot karne pe kya dikhta hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Write the nth term of (i) 2, 5, 8, 11, …, (ii) −5, −1, 3, 7, …, (iii) 1/2, 5/2, 9/2, 13/2, …, (iv) 1.5, 3.5, 5.5, 7.5, … and give a recursive rule for (i).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: A taxi charges a fixed ₹200 booking fee plus ₹40 per km. Write the sequence of total fares for 1, 2, 3, … km, its nth term and the fare for 10 km.
hinglish_roman: Taxi ₹200 fixed booking fee aur ₹40 per km leti hai. 1, 2, 3, … km ke kul kiraaye ki sequence, uska nth term aur 10 km ka kiraaya nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) Find the 10th and 26th terms of 3, 8, 13, 18, … (b) Which term of 21, 18, 15, … is −81? Is 0 a term? (c) Find the nth term and recursive rule of 11, 8, 5, 2, …
hinglish_roman: (a) 3, 8, 13, 18, … ke 10ve aur 26ve terms nikaalo. (b) 21, 18, 15, … ka kaun sa term −81 hai? Kya 0 term hai? (c) 11, 8, 5, 2, … ka nth term aur recursive rule nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) An AP of 50 terms has 3rd term 12 and last term 106. Find the 29th term. (b) Find the 31st term of an AP whose 11th term is 38 and 16th term is 73. (c) Find the AP whose 3rd term is 16 and whose 7th term exceeds the 5th by 12.
hinglish_roman: (a) 50 terms ki AP ka teesra term 12 aur aakhri 106 hai. 29va term nikaalo. (b) Jis AP ka 11va term 38 aur 16va 73 hai, uska 31va term nikaalo. (c) Woh AP nikaalo jiska teesra term 16 hai aur 7va term 5ve se 12 zyada hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) The sum of the 4th and 8th terms of an AP is 24 and of the 6th and 10th terms is 44. Find the first three terms. (b) Harish starts at ₹5,00,000 a year with an increment of ₹20,000 each year. After how many years does his salary reach ₹7,00,000?
hinglish_roman: (a) AP ke 4th aur 8th terms ka jod 24 aur 6th aur 10th ka jod 44 hai. Pehle teen terms nikaalo. (b) Harish ₹5,00,000 saalaana se shuru karta hai aur har saal ₹20,000 badhti hai. Kitne saal baad salary ₹7,00,000 hogi?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) How many two-digit numbers are divisible by 3, and what is their sum? (b) How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 7? (c) How many multiples of 4 lie between 10 and 250?
hinglish_roman: (a) Kitni do-ank sankhyaayein 3 se divisible hain, aur unka jod kya hai? (b) Kitni teen-ank sankhyaayein 7 se divisible hain? (c) 10 aur 250 ke beech 4 ke kitne multiples hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Derive the formula for the sum of the first n natural numbers. Who first wrote it down?
hinglish_roman: Pehle n natural numbers ke jod ka formula derive karo. Ise sabse pehle kisne likha?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Find (a) S₂₀, S₅₀, S₁₀₀ and S₁₀₀₀; (b) 25 + 26 + … + 58; (c) the 10th, 17th and 80th triangular numbers; (d) the marbles in 25 rows with 1, 2, 3, … marbles.
hinglish_roman: Nikaalo (a) S₂₀, S₅₀, S₁₀₀ aur S₁₀₀₀; (b) 25 + 26 + … + 58; (c) 10va, 17va aur 80va triangular number; (d) 1, 2, 3, … goliyon waali 25 rows mein kul goliyan.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) Find the smallest n such that 1 + 2 + … + n exceeds 1000. (b) In how many ways can 100 be written as a sum of two or more consecutive natural numbers?
hinglish_roman: (a) Sabse chhota n nikaalo jisse 1 + 2 + … + n, 1000 se zyada ho. (b) 100 ko do ya zyada lagaataar natural numbers ke jod mein kitne tareekon se likh sakte hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What is a geometric progression? Explain with the growing pattern 3, 6, 12, 24, … and give the general form, nth term and recursive rule.
hinglish_roman: Geometric progression kya hai? Badhte pattern 3, 6, 12, 24, … se samjhao aur general roop, nth term aur recursive rule do.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) A GP has common ratio 2 and 8th term 192. Find its 12th term. (b) Find the 10th and nth terms of 5, 25, 125, … (c) Which term of 2, 6, 18, … is 4374? (d) Which term of 2, 8, 32, … is 131072?
hinglish_roman: (a) GP ka common ratio 2 aur 8va term 192 hai. 12va term nikaalo. (b) 5, 25, 125, … ke 10ve aur nth terms nikaalo. (c) 2, 6, 18, … ka kaun sa term 4374 hai? (d) 2, 8, 32, … ka kaun sa term 131072 hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) t₁ = 2, tₙ₊₁ = 3tₙ − 2. Which term is 730? (b) Which term of √2, 2, 2√2, 4, … is 128? (c) Write a recursive rule for 3, 30, 300, 3000, …
hinglish_roman: (a) t₁ = 2, tₙ₊₁ = 3tₙ − 2. Kaun sa term 730 hai? (b) √2, 2, 2√2, 4, … ka kaun sa term 128 hai? (c) 3, 30, 300, 3000, … ka recursive rule likho.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) Find a GP whose first two terms sum to −4 and whose 5th term is 4 times its 3rd term. (b) The first three terms of a GP sum to 13/12 and their product is −1. Find r and the terms.
hinglish_roman: (a) Aisi GP nikaalo jiske pehle do terms ka jod −4 aur 5va term teesre ka 4 guna ho. (b) GP ke pehle teen terms ka jod 13/12 aur guna −1 hai. r aur terms nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) The 4th, 10th and 16th terms of a GP are x, y and z. Prove that x, y, z are in GP. (b) The first three terms of a GP sum to 26 and their squares sum to 364. Find the terms.
hinglish_roman: (a) GP ke 4th, 10th aur 16th terms x, y aur z hain. Siddh karo ki x, y, z GP mein hain. (b) GP ke pehle teen terms ka jod 26 aur unke squares ka jod 364 hai. Terms nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: (a) A ball dropped from 24 ft rises to 3/4 of its previous height on each bounce. List the heights and find when it stays below 1/6 of the original height. (b) Bacteria double every hour, starting with 30. Find the numbers after 2 hours, 4 hours and n hours.
hinglish_roman: (a) 24 ft se giraai gend har uchhaal pe pichhli oonchaai ke 3/4 tak uthti hai. Oonchaaiyan likho aur batao kab ye asli oonchaai ke 1/6 se neeche rehti hai. (b) Bacteria har ghante double hote hain, shuru mein 30. 2 ghante, 4 ghante aur n ghante baad sankhya nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: A ball dropped from 80 m bounces back to 60% of the height it fell from each time. (i) What height does it reach after the 5th bounce? (ii) What total vertical distance has it travelled when it hits the ground for the 6th time?
hinglish_roman: 80 m se giraai gend har baar jahan se giri uski 60% oonchaai tak uchhalti hai. (i) 5ve uchhaal ke baad kitni oonchaai? (ii) 6vi baar zameen se takraane tak kul kitni vertical doori tay ki?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: How is the Sierpiński triangle constructed? Find rules for the number of black triangles and the black area at stage n. What happens as n grows?
hinglish_roman: Sierpiński triangle kaise banta hai? Stage n pe kaale triangles ki sankhya aur kaale area ke rules nikaalo. n badhne pe kya hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: In the Sierpiński square carpet, each square is divided into 9 equal squares and the centre one is removed, repeatedly. Find the number of red squares and the red area (starting from area 1) at stages 0 to 5 and at stage n.
hinglish_roman: Sierpiński square carpet mein har square ko 9 barabar squares mein baantkar beech waala hataaya jaata hai, baar-baar. Stage 0 se 5 aur stage n pe laal squares ki sankhya aur laal area (shuru mein 1) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: What are fractals? Give examples from nature.
hinglish_roman: Fractals kya hain? Prakriti se examples do.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Differentiate between an arithmetic progression and a geometric progression.
hinglish_roman: Arithmetic progression aur geometric progression mein antar batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Predicting What Comes Next: Exploring Sequences and Progressions
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) A rule that uses the position n to find a term is called an ______ rule. (b) A rule that uses previous terms is called a ______ rule. (c) The nth term of an AP is ______ and of a GP is ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) Position n se term nikaalne waale rule ko ______ rule kehte hain. (b) Pichhle terms use karne waale rule ko ______ rule kehte hain. (c) AP ka nth term ______ aur GP ka ______ hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a proposition? What is the converse of a proposition? Give an example from triangles.
hinglish_roman: Proposition kya hai? Proposition ka converse kya hota hai? Triangles se ek example do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: If a proposition is true, must its converse be true? Explain with the rain example. What is a counterexample?
hinglish_roman: Agar proposition sahi hai, toh kya uska converse bhi sahi hona chahiye? Baarish ke example se samjhao. Counterexample kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What did Fermat claim about numbers of the form 2^(2ⁿ) + 1, and how was it disproved?
hinglish_roman: Fermat ne 2^(2ⁿ) + 1 roop ke numbers ke baare mein kya daava kiya, aur use kaise galat saabit kiya gaya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Proposition: if a number is a multiple of 6, then it is a multiple of 3. Is it true? Write the converse and decide whether it is true.
hinglish_roman: Proposition: agar koi number 6 ka multiple hai, toh woh 3 ka multiple hai. Kya ye sahi hai? Converse likho aur batao woh sahi hai ya nahi.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that 'n is a perfect square' and 'n has an odd number of factors' imply each other, using factor–partner pairs.
hinglish_roman: Factor–partner pairs se dikhaao ki 'n perfect square hai' aur 'n ke factors odd sankhya mein hain' ek doosre ko imply karte hain.

subject: Mathematics
