original_english: Proposition: if two triangles have the same area, then they are congruent. Converse: if two triangles are congruent, they have the same area. Which are true? Can a proposition and its converse both be false?
hinglish_roman: Proposition: agar do triangles ka area same hai, toh ve congruent hain. Converse: agar do triangles congruent hain, toh unka area same hai. Kaun sahi hai? Kya proposition aur converse dono galat ho sakte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State the converse of the Baudhāyana–Pythagoras theorem and prove it.
hinglish_roman: Baudhāyana–Pythagoras theorem ka converse batao aur siddh karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Write the converses and decide truth: (1) If two lines are parallel, the corresponding angles formed by a transversal are equal. (2) If a quadrilateral is a square, all its angles are equal. (3) If x = y, then a + x = a + y.
hinglish_roman: Converse likho aur sahi-galat batao: (1) Agar do lines parallel hain, toh transversal se bane corresponding angles barabar hain. (2) Agar quadrilateral square hai, toh uske saare angles barabar hain. (3) Agar x = y, toh a + x = a + y.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: For real x, y: write the converses and decide truth. (a) If x = y, then x² = y². (b) If x = y, then x³ = y³. (c) If a and b are perfect squares, then ab is a perfect square.
hinglish_roman: Real x, y ke liye converses likho aur sahi-galat batao. (a) Agar x = y, toh x² = y². (b) Agar x = y, toh x³ = y³. (c) Agar a aur b perfect squares hain, toh ab perfect square hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: For a positive integer n, write converses and decide truth: (a) If n is divisible by 24, it is divisible by 4 and 6. (b) If n is divisible by 60, it is divisible by 5 and 12.
hinglish_roman: Positive integer n ke liye converses likho aur sahi-galat batao: (a) Agar n, 24 se divisible hai, toh 4 aur 6 se divisible hai. (b) Agar n, 60 se divisible hai, toh 5 aur 12 se divisible hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: For a positive integer n, write converses and decide truth: (a) If n is the square of a prime, it has exactly 3 factors. (b) If n is a product of two unequal primes, it has exactly 4 divisors. (c) If n and n + 3 have no common factor, then n is not a multiple of 3.
hinglish_roman: Positive integer n ke liye converses likho aur sahi-galat batao: (a) Agar n kisi prime ka square hai, toh uske theek 3 factors hain. (b) Agar n do alag primes ka guna hai, toh uske theek 4 divisors hain. (c) Agar n aur n + 3 ka koi common factor nahi, toh n, 3 ka multiple nahi.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find counterexamples: (i) all numbers 4n² + 1 are prime; (ii) all numbers n² + n + 11 are prime; (iii) all numbers 4n + 3 are prime; (iv) if n is prime, 2ⁿ − 1 is prime; (v) if n is even, 2ⁿ + 1 is prime.
hinglish_roman: Counterexamples dhoondho: (i) saare 4n² + 1 prime hain; (ii) saare n² + n + 11 prime hain; (iii) saare 4n + 3 prime hain; (iv) agar n prime hai toh 2ⁿ − 1 prime hai; (v) agar n even hai toh 2ⁿ + 1 prime hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: 'If a number is divisible by 8, it is divisible by 2 and 4.' Justify it. Is checking divisibility by 2 and 4 enough to test divisibility by 8? Also express the divisibility rule for 3 using if–then statements.
hinglish_roman: 'Agar koi number 8 se divisible hai, toh 2 aur 4 se divisible hai.' Ise siddh karo. Kya 8 se divisibility jaanchne ke liye 2 aur 4 se jaanchna kaafi hai? Saath hi 3 ke divisibility rule ko if–then statements mein likho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A quadrilateral type Q is to be made by joining the ends of two sticks used as diagonals. (i) If 'type Q ⇒ equal diagonals', must the sticks be equal, and does the arrangement matter? (ii) What if instead 'equal diagonals ⇒ type Q'?
hinglish_roman: Do dandiyon ko diagonals ki tarah rakhkar unke sire jodne se type Q ka quadrilateral banana hai. (i) Agar 'type Q ⇒ barabar diagonals', toh kya dandiyan barabar honi chahiye, aur kya rakhne ka tareeka maayne rakhta hai? (ii) Agar iski jagah 'barabar diagonals ⇒ type Q' ho toh?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What are the possible combinations of truth for a proposition and its converse? Give an example of each.
hinglish_roman: Proposition aur uske converse ke sahi-galat hone ke kaun se combinations sambhav hain? Har ek ka example do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (a) If a proposition is true, its converse must be true. (b) 'Y when X' means the same as 'if X then Y'. (c) One counterexample is enough to show a proposition is false. (d) The converse of 'if X then Y' is 'if not X then not Y'.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Agar proposition sahi hai, toh uska converse bhi sahi hona chahiye. (b) 'Y jab X' ka matlab 'agar X toh Y' jaisa hai. (c) Proposition ko galat dikhaane ke liye ek counterexample kaafi hai. (d) 'Agar X toh Y' ka converse 'agar X nahi toh Y nahi' hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A badminton academy has 8 seniors with average height 165.5 cm and 3 juniors with average 149.33 cm. One student averages the two averages; another adds all 11 heights and divides by 11. Which is correct and why?
hinglish_roman: Badminton academy mein 8 seniors ki average height 165.5 cm aur 3 juniors ki 149.33 cm hai. Ek student dono averages ka average leta hai; doosra saari 11 heights jodkar 11 se bhaag deta hai. Kaun sahi hai aur kyun?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Derive the formula for the average of two combined collections. When does simply averaging the averages give the right answer?
hinglish_roman: Do mile hue collections ke average ka formula derive karo. Averages ka seedha average kab sahi jawab deta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Section A (30 students) averaged 72 and Section B (25 students) averaged 76 on a test. Find the combined average.
hinglish_roman: Section A (30 students) ka test average 72 aur Section B (25 students) ka 76 hai. Mila hua average nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Two equal glasses of lemonade have 10% and 20% jaggery. What is the jaggery concentration when mixed? What if instead 500 mL at 10% is mixed with 200 mL at 20%?
hinglish_roman: Nimbu-paani ke do barabar glass mein 10% aur 20% gud hai. Milaane pe gud ki concentration kya hogi? Agar 10% waala 500 mL aur 20% waala 200 mL milaayein toh?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Define the weighted mean. Who first wrote down the formula and for what? How was it used by Śrīdharācārya?
hinglish_roman: Weighted mean ki paribhasha do. Formula sabse pehle kisne aur kis liye likha? Śrīdharācārya ne ise kaise use kiya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Batch A of brass weighs 200 kg (70% copper), Batch B 120 kg (50% copper) and Batch C is 45% copper. Combined, the alloy is 55% copper. Find the weight of Batch C.
hinglish_roman: Brass ka Batch A 200 kg (70% copper), Batch B 120 kg (50% copper) aur Batch C 45% copper hai. Milaane pe alloy 55% copper hai. Batch C ka vazan nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (Śrīdharācārya) Purity of k varṇa means the alloy is k/16 gold. A goldsmith melts 9 units at 12 varṇa, 5 units at 10 varṇa and 17 units at 11 varṇa. Find the purity of the combined gold.
hinglish_roman: (Śrīdharācārya) k varṇa shuddhta matlab alloy mein k/16 sona. Sunaar 12 varṇa ke 9 units, 10 varṇa ke 5 units aur 11 varṇa ke 17 units pighlaata hai. Mile hue sone ki shuddhta nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the spice-mix concentration when (i) 100 mL at 5%, 200 mL at 10% and 300 mL at 15% kadha are mixed, and (ii) 300 mL at 5%, 200 mL at 10% and 100 mL at 15% are mixed.
hinglish_roman: Masala-mix ki concentration nikaalo jab (i) 5% ka 100 mL, 10% ka 200 mL aur 15% ka 300 mL kadha milaaya jaaye, aur (ii) 5% ka 300 mL, 10% ka 200 mL aur 15% ka 100 mL milaaya jaaye.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: The average daily rainfall in May, June and July is 3.5 mm, 10 mm and 8.7 mm. Write and evaluate the combined average daily rainfall for the three months.
hinglish_roman: May, June aur July mein ausat dainik baarish 3.5 mm, 10 mm aur 8.7 mm hai. Teeno mahinon ki mili-juli ausat dainik baarish ka expression likho aur nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Rehmat scored 60% in internals, 64% in the project and 73% in the final exam, combined in the ratio 3 : 2 : 5. Find the annual score and explain how weights work.
hinglish_roman: Rehmat ne internals mein 60%, project mein 64% aur final exam mein 73% laaye, jo 3 : 2 : 5 ke ratio mein jodte hain. Saalaana score nikaalo aur samjhao ki weights kaise kaam karte hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Savitri scored 35/50 in internals, 44/60 in the project and 80/100 in the final, combined in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5. Find her annual percentage. Why can't you just use 35, 44 and 80 directly?
hinglish_roman: Savitri ne internals mein 35/50, project mein 44/60 aur final mein 80/100 laaye, jo 3 : 4 : 5 ke ratio mein jodte hain. Saalaana percentage nikaalo. 35, 44 aur 80 seedhe kyun nahi use kar sakte?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Where else is the weighted mean used? Compute a restaurant rating of 5 for food, 3 for service and 4 for ambience with weights 4 : 3 : 2.
hinglish_roman: Weighted mean aur kahan use hota hai? Food ke 5, service ke 3 aur ambience ke 4 rating ko 4 : 3 : 2 weights se restaurant rating nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A shop made ₹8000 on books (30% profit) and ₹1000 on book covers (50% profit). Find the overall profit percentage. (b) A white stork averaged 44.5 km/day over 20 days and flew 55 km on day 21. Find the new average.
hinglish_roman: (a) Dukaan ne kitaabon se ₹8000 (30% profit) aur kitaab covers se ₹1000 (50% profit) kamaaye. Kul profit percentage nikaalo. (b) Safed saaras ne 20 din mein ausat 44.5 km/din udaan bhari aur 21ve din 55 km udi. Naya average nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) 600 mL of 5% salt solution is mixed with 300 mL of 8% sugar solution. Find the salt and sugar concentrations. (b) 10 L of pani at 8% spice is too spicy. How much water should be added to reduce it to 3/4 of the original concentration?
hinglish_roman: (a) 5% namak ka 600 mL solution 8% cheeni ke 300 mL solution se milaaya gaya. Namak aur cheeni ki concentration nikaalo. (b) 8% masale waala 10 L paani bahut teekha hai. Concentration ko asli ka 3/4 karne ke liye kitna paani milaayein?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A fitness evaluation combines strength, flexibility and agility in the ratio 4 : 5 : 6. Rashi scores 60, 65, 70 and Keerthi 55, 65, 75. Who scores more, and what are their final marks?
hinglish_roman: Fitness evaluation mein strength, flexibility aur agility 4 : 5 : 6 ke ratio mein jodte hain. Rashi ke 60, 65, 70 aur Keerthi ke 55, 65, 75 marks hain. Kiske zyada hain, aur final marks kya hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: 10 customers rated a restaurant (5 to 1). Food: 5, 3, 2, 0, 0 people; Ambience: 0, 4, 5, 1, 0; Service: 1, 2, 2, 4, 1. Find the overall average rating with weights food : ambience : service = 6 : 5 : 4.
hinglish_roman: 10 graahakon ne restaurant ko (5 se 1) rating di. Food: 5, 3, 2, 0, 0 log; Ambience: 0, 4, 5, 1, 0; Service: 1, 2, 2, 4, 1. food : ambience : service = 6 : 5 : 4 weights se kul average rating nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A facility has 60 langurs. Males average 16.5 kg, females 13.8 kg and all 14.925 kg. Are there more males or females? Find the number of males. If a 15.2 kg female joins, find the new female average.
hinglish_roman: Ek facility mein 60 langur hain. Nar ka average 16.5 kg, maada ka 13.8 kg aur sabka 14.925 kg hai. Nar zyada hain ya maada? Nar ki sankhya nikaalo. Agar 15.2 kg ki maada aaye, toh maada ka naya average nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In the langur facility (25 males averaging 16.5 kg), two males weighing 16.9 kg and 16.1 kg are released. Find the new male average. Then one remaining male loses 1 kg; find the average again.
hinglish_roman: Langur facility mein (25 nar, average 16.5 kg) 16.9 kg aur 16.1 kg ke do nar chhode jaate hain. Nar ka naya average nikaalo. Phir bache naron mein se ek ka 1 kg vazan ghatta hai; average phir nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Dead Sea water has ≈ 34% salinity, groundwater ≈ 0.01% and purified water ≈ 0.001%. (i) Find the salinity of 1 L Dead Sea + 2 L purified water. (ii) Can Dead Sea and purified water be mixed to get groundwater salinity? How much purified water per litre? (iii) Can Dead Sea water and groundwater give purified-water salinity?
hinglish_roman: Dead Sea ke paani ki salinity ≈ 34%, groundwater ki ≈ 0.01% aur purified paani ki ≈ 0.001% hai. (i) 1 L Dead Sea + 2 L purified paani ki salinity nikaalo. (ii) Kya Dead Sea aur purified paani milaakar groundwater jitni salinity mil sakti hai? Har litre pe kitna purified paani? (iii) Kya Dead Sea aur groundwater se purified paani jitni salinity milegi?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) In a T20 match a team scores 6 runs in over 1 and 12 in over 2. What is the run rate? After 19 overs the run rate was 6; with 12 runs in the 20th over, what is the final run rate? (b) A pool 30 hastas long has sections of 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 hastas with depths 9, 7, 7, 3, 2 hastas. Find the mean depth.
hinglish_roman: (a) T20 match mein team pehle over mein 6 aur doosre mein 12 run banaati hai. Run rate kya hai? 19 overs ke baad run rate 6 tha; 20ve over mein 12 run se final run rate kya hai? (b) 30 hasta lambe pool ke 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 hasta ke hisson ki gehraai 9, 7, 7, 3, 2 hasta hai. Ausat gehraai nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Shreyas holds 25 shares at an average ₹150 and buys 10 more at ₹30. Find his new average. (b) Vaishnavi holds 5 shares at ₹150 and buys some at ₹30, making her average ₹70. How many did she buy?
hinglish_roman: (a) Shreyas ke paas ₹150 average pe 25 shares hain aur woh ₹30 pe 10 aur khareedta hai. Naya average nikaalo. (b) Vaishnavi ke paas ₹150 pe 5 shares hain aur woh ₹30 pe kuch khareedti hai, jisse average ₹70 ho jaata hai. Usne kitne khareede?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Suvarna owns 1 g of gold bought at ₹15k. Estimate her average price after: (i) buying 1 g at ₹30k, (ii) 2 g at ₹30k, (iii) 1 g at ₹10k, (iv) 10 g at ₹10k, (v) 0.5 g at ₹30k, (vi) 0.5 g at ₹15k.
hinglish_roman: Suvarna ke paas ₹15k pe khareeda 1 g sona hai. Uski average keemat ka anumaan lagao: (i) ₹30k pe 1 g, (ii) ₹30k pe 2 g, (iii) ₹10k pe 1 g, (iv) ₹10k pe 10 g, (v) ₹30k pe 0.5 g, (vi) ₹15k pe 0.5 g khareedne ke baad.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How does a weighted average change if (a) all weights are doubled, (b) all weights are increased by 1? Justify algebraically.
hinglish_roman: Weighted average kaise badalta hai agar (a) saare weights double ho jaayein, (b) saare weights 1 se badh jaayein? Algebra se samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a stacked bar chart? When is it better than a cluster-column chart, and what are its drawbacks?
hinglish_roman: Stacked bar chart kya hai? Ye cluster-column chart se kab behtar hai, aur iski kamiyan kya hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How is a 100% stacked bar chart different from a stacked bar chart? Compare it with a pie chart.
hinglish_roman: 100% stacked bar chart, stacked bar chart se kaise alag hai? Iski tulna pie chart se karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A house's daily electricity use (kWh) was: 2005 — lighting 360, cooling 300, kitchen 120, other 220; 2025 — lighting 220, cooling 800, kitchen 460, other 520. Find the percentage shares for a 100% stacked bar chart and comment.
hinglish_roman: Ek ghar ki dainik bijli khapat (kWh): 2005 — lighting 360, cooling 300, kitchen 120, other 220; 2025 — lighting 220, cooling 800, kitchen 460, other 520. 100% stacked bar chart ke liye percentage shares nikaalo aur tippani karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A 100% stacked bar shows Fatima's garden bloomed 50% in summer, 30% in monsoon, 20% in winter, and Naveen's 40%, 35%, 25%. Which can be inferred: (i) Fatima had more blooms in summer than monsoon; (ii) in summer Fatima had more blooms than Naveen; (iii) in winter Fatima had fewer than Naveen; (iv) both gardens had the same total?
hinglish_roman: 100% stacked bar dikhaata hai ki Fatima ke garden mein 50% phool garmi, 30% monsoon, 20% sardi mein khile, aur Naveen ke 40%, 35%, 25%. Kya nishkarsh nikaala ja sakta hai: (i) Fatima ke garmi mein monsoon se zyada phool khile; (ii) garmi mein Fatima ke Naveen se zyada; (iii) sardi mein Fatima ke Naveen se kam; (iv) dono gardens ka total same tha?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Three triathletes' times (swim, cycle, run) are: A1 1:08, 5:00, 3:15; A2 1:05, 5:10, 3:35; A3 1:22, 5:55, 3:50. Is a stacked bar or a 100% stacked bar more suitable? Which questions can a 100% stacked bar answer: who finished first, what fraction A1 spent cycling, who took longest to run?
hinglish_roman: Teen triathletes ke samay (swim, cycle, run): A1 1:08, 5:00, 3:15; A2 1:05, 5:10, 3:35; A3 1:22, 5:55, 3:50. Stacked bar ya 100% stacked bar, kaun zyada sahi hai? 100% stacked bar kaun se sawaal ka jawab de sakta hai: pehle kaun aaya, A1 ne kitna hissa cycling mein bitaaya, sabse lamba run kiska?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What does the National Time Use Survey 2024 chart show about the average Indian's day? What is the limitation of such an average?
hinglish_roman: National Time Use Survey 2024 ka chart average Bharatiya ke din ke baare mein kya dikhaata hai? Aise average ki seema kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Last year a farm had 60% cows, 25% sheep and 15% chickens. All three populations decreased. Which changes in shares are possible: all shares decreased; all increased; all unchanged; cows down, sheep up, chickens same; cows and sheep up, chickens down?
hinglish_roman: Pichhle saal ek farm mein 60% gaayein, 25% bhedein aur 15% murgiyan thi. Teeno ki sankhya ghati. Hisson mein kaun se badlav sambhav hain: sab ghate; sab badhe; sab same; gaayein ghati, bhedein badhi, murgiyan same; gaayein aur bhedein badhi, murgiyan ghati?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) The weighted mean of x₁, …, xₙ with weights w₁, …, wₙ is ______. (b) When all collections have the same size, the combined average equals the ______ of their averages. (c) From a stacked bar chart we can make a 100% stacked bar chart, but not ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) Weights w₁, …, wₙ ke saath x₁, …, xₙ ka weighted mean ______ hai. (b) Jab saare collections ka size same ho, toh mila hua average unke averages ka ______ hota hai. (c) Stacked bar chart se 100% stacked bar chart ban sakta hai, par ______ nahi.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is an algorithm? What are its main features?
hinglish_roman: Algorithm kya hai? Iski mukhya visheshtaayein kya hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Write the step-by-step algorithm for adding two numbers digit by digit.
hinglish_roman: Do numbers ko ank-dar-ank jodne ka step-by-step algorithm likho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In the addition algorithm: why must columns be aligned from the right, why can the carry never exceed 1, and what goes wrong if Step 5 is omitted?
hinglish_roman: Addition algorithm mein: columns right se kyun milaane chahiye, carry 1 se zyada kyun nahi ho sakta, aur Step 5 hataane se kya galat hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why is the column-addition algorithm much faster than counting dots, and why does it give the correct sum?
hinglish_roman: Column-addition algorithm binduon ko ginne se itna tez kyun hai, aur ye sahi jod kyun deta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Describe the algorithm to find the list of divisors of n. Execute it for 18 and state the basic step it assumes.
hinglish_roman: n ke divisors ki list nikaalne ka algorithm batao. Ise 18 ke liye chalaao aur batao ye kaun sa basic step maanta hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Write the first algorithm for gcd(m, n) using lists of divisors, and execute it for gcd(375, 825).
hinglish_roman: Divisors ki lists se gcd(m, n) ka pehla algorithm likho, aur ise gcd(375, 825) ke liye chalaao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a data structure? Why do algorithms give names to intermediate values?
hinglish_roman: Data structure kya hai? Algorithms beech ki values ko naam kyun dete hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How can the divisor-list gcd algorithm be improved step by step? How efficient is the final version?
hinglish_roman: Divisor-list waale gcd algorithm ko step by step kaise behtar banaate hain? Aakhri version kitna efficient hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) In the last gcd algorithm, what changes if we search common divisors backwards from min(m, n) down to 1? (b) If divisors are listed in pairs like (1, 18), (2, 9), (3, 6), how many numbers must be examined?
hinglish_roman: (a) Aakhri gcd algorithm mein agar common divisors min(m, n) se ulta 1 tak dhoondhein toh kya badlega? (b) Agar divisors (1, 18), (2, 9), (3, 6) jaise jodiyon mein likhein, toh kitne numbers jaanchne padenge?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State and justify Euclid's subtraction algorithm for gcd.
hinglish_roman: Gcd ke liye Euclid ka subtraction algorithm batao aur samjhao ki ye sahi kyun hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Execute Euclid's subtraction algorithm for gcd(375, 825). Why is it still slow for gcd(99, 2)?
hinglish_roman: gcd(375, 825) ke liye Euclid ka subtraction algorithm chalaao. gcd(99, 2) ke liye ye ab bhi dheema kyun hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How does Āryabhaṭa's division method improve Euclid's algorithm? Show it for gcd(99, 2), gcd(825, 375) and gcd(60, 16).
hinglish_roman: Āryabhaṭa ka division method Euclid ke algorithm ko kaise behtar banaata hai? Ise gcd(99, 2), gcd(825, 375) aur gcd(60, 16) ke liye dikhaao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using the improved (division) algorithm, find gcd(51000, 81000), gcd(2587392, 157656) and gcd(1789287, 237656).
hinglish_roman: Behtar (division) algorithm se gcd(51000, 81000), gcd(2587392, 157656) aur gcd(1789287, 237656) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Where does the word 'algorithm' come from?
hinglish_roman: 'Algorithm' shabd kahan se aaya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Describe algorithms to (a) find the lcm of two numbers, (b) check whether n is prime, (c) list the prime divisors of n.
hinglish_roman: Algorithms batao (a) do numbers ka lcm nikaalne ka, (b) n prime hai ya nahi jaanchne ka, (c) n ke prime divisors ki list banaane ka.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Given two lists in increasing order, describe an algorithm to find the elements of List 1 not present in List 2. Why is keeping lists sorted useful?
hinglish_roman: Badhte kram ki do lists di hain; List 1 ke woh elements dhoondhne ka algorithm batao jo List 2 mein nahi hain. Lists ko sorted rakhna kyun upyogi hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) Running through an algorithm step by step is called ______ it. (b) 17 mod 5 = ______ and 33 mod 7 = ______. (c) In Euclid's algorithm, gcd(m, 0) = ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) Algorithm ko step by step chalaana use ______ kehte hain. (b) 17 mod 5 = ______ aur 33 mod 7 = ______. (c) Euclid ke algorithm mein gcd(m, 0) = ______.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How is a quadrilateral defined precisely? Which kinds of four-sided figures does the definition rule out?
hinglish_roman: Quadrilateral ki sateek paribhasha kya hai? Ye paribhasha kaun se chaar-bhuja figures ko bahar karti hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Define the vertices, sides, diagonals, adjacent sides, adjacent angles, opposite sides and opposite angles of a quadrilateral ABCD. By which names can ABCD be denoted?
hinglish_roman: Quadrilateral ABCD ke vertices, sides, diagonals, adjacent sides, adjacent angles, opposite sides aur opposite angles define karo. ABCD ko kin naamon se likh sakte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the difference between a convex and a non-convex quadrilateral? How can you test for convexity?
hinglish_roman: Convex aur non-convex quadrilateral mein kya antar hai? Convexity kaise jaanchte hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Why do engineers need to consider strange four-sided figures like non-convex and self-intersecting ones?
hinglish_roman: Engineers ko non-convex aur self-intersecting jaisi ajeeb chaar-bhuja figures ka dhyaan kyun rakhna padta hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State and prove the three properties of a parallelogram in Theorem 1.
hinglish_roman: Theorem 1 mein parallelogram ki teen properties batao aur siddh karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: List the tests (converse theorems) that show a quadrilateral is a parallelogram, with a brief reason for each.
hinglish_roman: Quadrilateral parallelogram hai ye dikhaane ke tests (converse theorems) har ek ke chhote kaaran ke saath batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the 'backward retracing' strategy for proving a converse? When can it fail?
hinglish_roman: Converse siddh karne ki 'backward retracing' strategy kya hai? Ye kab fail ho sakti hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (i) A parallelogram with a right angle is a rectangle. (ii) A rhombus with perpendicular diagonals is a square. (iii) If the diagonals of a parallelogram are equal, it is a rectangle. (iv) If the diagonals of a quadrilateral are equal, it must be a rectangle.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (i) Right angle waala parallelogram rectangle hai. (ii) Perpendicular diagonals waala rhombus square hai. (iii) Agar parallelogram ke diagonals barabar hon, toh woh rectangle hai. (iv) Agar quadrilateral ke diagonals barabar hon, toh woh rectangle hi hoga.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) If the diagonals of a quadrilateral bisect each other at right angles, must it be a rhombus? (b) Diagonal AC of parallelogram ABCD bisects ∠A. Show it also bisects ∠C and that ABCD is a rhombus.
hinglish_roman: (a) Agar quadrilateral ke diagonals ek doosre ko right angle pe bisect karein, toh kya woh rhombus hoga? (b) Parallelogram ABCD ka diagonal AC, ∠A ko bisect karta hai. Dikhaao ki woh ∠C ko bhi bisect karta hai aur ABCD rhombus hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In parallelogram ABCD, points P and Q on diagonal BD satisfy DP = BQ. Show that APCQ is a parallelogram. Also, if a line through the intersection O of the diagonals meets AB at P and CD at Q, show O is the midpoint of PQ.
hinglish_roman: Parallelogram ABCD ke diagonal BD pe points P aur Q aise hain ki DP = BQ. Dikhaao ki APCQ parallelogram hai. Saath hi, agar diagonals ke milan bindu O se ek line AB ko P aur CD ko Q pe kaate, toh dikhaao ki O, PQ ka midpoint hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Give examples of real-world applications of parallelograms, including in tiling.
hinglish_roman: Parallelograms ke asli duniya mein upyog ke examples do, tiling samet.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State and prove the Midpoint Theorem.
hinglish_roman: Midpoint Theorem batao aur siddh karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State the converse of the Midpoint Theorem (Theorem 7) and give the short proof that uses the Midpoint Theorem itself.
hinglish_roman: Midpoint Theorem ka converse (Theorem 7) batao aur Midpoint Theorem se hi diya gaya chhota proof do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) P, Q, R are midpoints of AB, AC, BC of ΔABC. Show ΔABC splits into four congruent triangles. (b) In ΔABC, M and N are midpoints of AB and AC, and D is any point on BC. Show MN bisects AD.
hinglish_roman: (a) P, Q, R, ΔABC ki AB, AC, BC ke midpoints hain. Dikhaao ki ΔABC chaar congruent triangles mein bant-ta hai. (b) ΔABC mein M aur N, AB aur AC ke midpoints hain, aur D, BC pe koi point hai. Dikhaao ki MN, AD ko bisect karta hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the centroid of a triangle? Prove that the medians meet at a point dividing each in the ratio 2 : 1.
hinglish_roman: Triangle ka centroid kya hai? Siddh karo ki medians ek point pe milte hain jo har ek ko 2 : 1 mein baantta hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State Varignon's theorem (the Midpoint Theorem for quadrilaterals) and prove it.
hinglish_roman: Varignon's theorem (quadrilaterals ke liye Midpoint Theorem) batao aur siddh karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: P, Q, R, S are midpoints of the sides of ABCD. (a) Show PR and QS bisect each other. (b) Show that if AC = BD, then PR ⊥ QS. (c) When is PQRS a square?
hinglish_roman: P, Q, R, S, ABCD ki sides ke midpoints hain. (a) Dikhaao ki PR aur QS ek doosre ko bisect karte hain. (b) Dikhaao ki agar AC = BD, toh PR ⊥ QS. (c) PQRS square kab hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In trapezium ABCD with AB ∥ DC, E is the midpoint of AD and EF ∥ AB meets BC at F. Show F is the midpoint of BC and EF = (AB + CD)/2. Then, for a trapezium with parallel sides AD = 3 cm and BC = 5 cm, find the ratio of the areas of the two parts cut by the segment joining midpoints of the other sides.
hinglish_roman: Trapezium ABCD mein AB ∥ DC hai, E, AD ka midpoint hai aur EF ∥ AB, BC ko F pe kaatti hai. Dikhaao ki F, BC ka midpoint hai aur EF = (AB + CD)/2. Phir 3 cm aur 5 cm parallel sides waale trapezium mein doosri sides ke midpoints jodne waale segment se bane do hisson ke areas ka ratio nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Can the plane be tiled with any quadrilateral? Describe a method. Why can't a regular pentagon tile the plane?
hinglish_roman: Kya kisi bhi quadrilateral se plane ko tile kar sakte hain? Ek tareeka batao. Regular pentagon se plane tile kyun nahi hota?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What are aperiodic tilings? Why are they important, and what was discovered in 2023?
hinglish_roman: Aperiodic tilings kya hain? Ye kyun mahatvapoorn hain, aur 2023 mein kya khoja gaya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A 4-gon has sides 2, 5 and 11. Can the fourth side be 100, 10 or 1? What lengths are possible? (b) How many diagonals does an n-gon have? (c) What is the sum of the angles of an n-gon?
hinglish_roman: (a) Ek 4-gon ki sides 2, 5 aur 11 hain. Kya chauthi side 100, 10 ya 1 ho sakti hai? Kaun si lambaaiyan sambhav hain? (b) n-gon ke kitne diagonals hote hain? (c) n-gon ke angles ka jod kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: In ΔABC, P is on AB and the line through P parallel to BC meets AC at Q. If AP = 1, PB = 2 and AQ = 5, find QC. How can the Midpoint Theorem idea be used to trisect a segment?
hinglish_roman: ΔABC mein P, AB pe hai aur P se BC ke parallel line AC ko Q pe kaatti hai. Agar AP = 1, PB = 2 aur AQ = 5, toh QC nikaalo. Midpoint Theorem ke idea se segment ko teen barabar hisson mein kaise baantein?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that the angle sum of a self-intersecting quadrilateral ABCD (with AB and CD crossing at E) is less than 360°.
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki self-intersecting quadrilateral ABCD (jisme AB aur CD, E pe kaatti hain) ke angles ka jod 360° se kam hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) A quadrilateral with one pair of opposite sides equal and ______ is a parallelogram. (b) The centroid divides each median in the ratio ______. (c) The quadrilateral formed by joining the midpoints of any quadrilateral is a ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) Jis quadrilateral ki ek jodi opposite sides barabar aur ______ hon, woh parallelogram hai. (b) Centroid har median ko ______ ratio mein baantta hai. (c) Kisi bhi quadrilateral ke midpoints jodne se bana quadrilateral ______ hota hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a linear equation in two variables? What is its standard form? Express Radha's purchase (mangoes ₹60/kg, bananas ₹50/kg, total ₹280) as one.
hinglish_roman: Do variables waali linear equation kya hai? Iska standard form kya hai? Radha ki khareedaari (aam ₹60/kg, kela ₹50/kg, kul ₹280) ko aisi equation mein likho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Write in standard form and give a, b, c: (i) 5x + 2y = 2.7, (ii) 4 = 1.5x − 1.3y, (iii) 3y = 5, (iv) y − 15 = 2x, (v) x = 8.
hinglish_roman: Standard form mein likho aur a, b, c batao: (i) 5x + 2y = 2.7, (ii) 4 = 1.5x − 1.3y, (iii) 3y = 5, (iv) y − 15 = 2x, (v) x = 8.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A notebook costs twice a pen. With notebook ₹t and pen ₹p, Charlie writes t = 2p and Meera writes p = 2t. Who is correct? (b) Two batsmen together scored 176 runs; is x + y = 176 correct?
hinglish_roman: (a) Notebook pen se do guna mehenga hai. Notebook ₹t aur pen ₹p lekar Charlie t = 2p aur Meera p = 2t likhti hai. Kaun sahi hai? (b) Do batsmen ne milkar 176 run banaaye; kya x + y = 176 sahi hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a solution of a linear equation in two variables? Why is it an ordered pair? How many solutions does such an equation have?
hinglish_roman: Do variables waali linear equation ka solution kya hai? Ye ordered pair kyun hai? Aisi equation ke kitne solutions hote hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Is (4, 3) a solution of 5x − 6y = 2? (b) Find two solutions each of 7x − 3y = 21 and 2x + 3y = 5. (c) Find two solutions of 2x + y = 7 and four more from its graph.
hinglish_roman: (a) Kya (4, 3), 5x − 6y = 2 ka solution hai? (b) 7x − 3y = 21 aur 2x + 3y = 5 ke do-do solutions nikaalo. (c) 2x + y = 7 ke do solutions aur graph se chaar aur nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) (−3, 4) solves both 3ax + 4y = −2 and 2x + by = 14. Find a and b. (b) (2, −1) solves both 2mx + 3y = 7 and 4x + ny = −10. Find m and n.
hinglish_roman: (a) (−3, 4), 3ax + 4y = −2 aur 2x + by = 14 dono ka solution hai. a aur b nikaalo. (b) (2, −1), 2mx + 3y = 7 aur 4x + ny = −10 dono ka solution hai. m aur n nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the graph of a linear equation in two variables? Explain with 3x + 2y = 12, and show when a line passes through the origin.
hinglish_roman: Do variables waali linear equation ka graph kya hota hai? 3x + 2y = 12 se samjhao, aur dikhaao ki line origin se kab guzarti hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (i) A linear equation in two variables has only one solution. (ii) Its graph always passes through the origin. (iii) x = 3 is a valid linear equation in two variables. (iv) 2x + 3y = 7 has infinitely many solutions. (v) (1, 2) is a solution of 2x + 3y = 7.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (i) Do variables waali linear equation ka sirf ek solution hota hai. (ii) Iska graph hamesha origin se guzarta hai. (iii) x = 3 do variables waali sahi linear equation hai. (iv) 2x + 3y = 7 ke anginat solutions hain. (v) (1, 2), 2x + 3y = 7 ka solution hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that 3x + 4y = 7 and 6x + 8y = 14 have the same solutions. In general, why do ax + by = c and kax + kby = kc (k ≠ 0) have the same set of solutions?
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki 3x + 4y = 7 aur 6x + 8y = 14 ke solutions same hain. Aam taur pe ax + by = c aur kax + kby = kc (k ≠ 0) ke solutions same kyun hote hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the slope (gradient) of a line? Define rise and run and give the slope formula.
hinglish_roman: Line ka slope (gradient) kya hai? Rise aur run define karo aur slope ka formula do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the slopes of the lines through (a) A(−1, 0), B(1, 2), C(4, 5), and (b) A(−4, 5), B(−1, 2). (c) On the line through (2, 0) and (4, 3), find y when x = 8 and x when y = 6.
hinglish_roman: Slopes nikaalo (a) A(−1, 0), B(1, 2), C(4, 5) se guzarti line ka, aur (b) A(−4, 5), B(−1, 2) se guzarti line ka. (c) (2, 0) aur (4, 3) waali line pe x = 8 pe y aur y = 6 pe x nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the slope-intercept form y = mx + d? Prove that m is the slope, and convert ax + by + c = 0 to this form.
hinglish_roman: Slope-intercept form y = mx + d kya hai? Siddh karo ki m slope hai, aur ax + by + c = 0 ko is roop mein badlo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Describe the four cases of slope with examples: positive, negative, zero and undefined.
hinglish_roman: Slope ke chaar cases examples ke saath batao: positive, negative, zero aur undefined.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A loading-dock ramp rises 2.5 m over a run of 4 m. Find its slope. (b) A wheelchair ramp must have a slope of 1 cm rise per 12 cm horizontal. How long must it be for stairs 18 cm high?
hinglish_roman: (a) Loading-dock ka ramp 4 m ke run pe 2.5 m uthta hai. Slope nikaalo. (b) Wheelchair ramp ka slope 12 cm horizontal pe 1 cm uthaan hona chahiye. 18 cm oonchi seedhiyon ke liye ramp kitna lamba hona chahiye?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A tank's water level y (cm) after x minutes follows y = 3x. (i) Find the slope and y-intercept and their meaning. (ii) How high is the water after 5 minutes? (iii) When will it reach 21 cm? (iv) Is (4, 10) on the line? (v) Where does it meet x = 3?
hinglish_roman: Tank mein paani ka star y (cm), x minute baad y = 3x ke hisaab se hai. (i) Slope aur y-intercept aur unka matlab batao. (ii) 5 minute baad paani kitna ooncha? (iii) 21 cm kab hoga? (iv) Kya (4, 10) line pe hai? (v) Ye x = 3 ko kahan milti hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using F = (9/5)C + 32: (i) convert 30 °C to °F, (ii) 95 °F to °C, (iii) 0 °C and 0 °F, (iv) find the temperature that is numerically equal in both scales.
hinglish_roman: F = (9/5)C + 32 se: (i) 30 °C ko °F mein, (ii) 95 °F ko °C mein, (iii) 0 °C aur 0 °F badlo, (iv) woh temperature nikaalo jo dono scales mein same number ho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a pair of linear equations in two variables? What is its solution? Give real-life examples.
hinglish_roman: Do variables waali linear equations ki jodi kya hai? Iska solution kya hai? Asli zindagi ke examples do.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Explain the substitution method by solving 7x − 15y = 2 and x + 2y = 3.
hinglish_roman: 7x − 15y = 2 aur x + 2y = 3 hal karke substitution method samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Explain the elimination method using: the incomes of two people are in the ratio 9 : 7 and their expenditures 4 : 3, and each saves ₹2000 per month. Find their incomes.
hinglish_roman: Elimination method samjhao: do logon ki aay ka ratio 9 : 7 aur kharche ka 4 : 3 hai, aur har ek mahine mein ₹2000 bachaata hai. Unki aay nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Two angles of a triangle are x° and y° with y = 4x, and the third is 50°. Find the angles. (b) The sum of a two-digit number and its reverse is 66 and the digits differ by 2. Find the number(s).
hinglish_roman: (a) Triangle ke do angles x° aur y° hain jahan y = 4x, aur teesra 50° hai. Angles nikaalo. (b) Do-ank number aur uske ulte ka jod 66 hai aur ankon ka fark 2 hai. Number(s) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Can a pair of linear equations have no solution or infinitely many? Give the ratio rules for a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0.
hinglish_roman: Kya linear equations ki jodi ka koi solution na ho ya anginat hon, aisa ho sakta hai? a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0 aur a₂x + b₂y + c₂ = 0 ke ratio rules batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How is a pair of linear equations solved graphically? What do intersecting, parallel and coincident lines mean? Solve x + 3y = 6 and 2x − 3y = 12 graphically.
hinglish_roman: Linear equations ki jodi graph se kaise hal karte hain? Kaatti, parallel aur coincident lines ka kya matlab hai? x + 3y = 6 aur 2x − 3y = 12 ko graph se hal karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Using the ratios, decide whether the lines intersect, are parallel or coincide: (i) 5x − 4y + 8 = 0 and 7x + 6y − 9 = 0; (ii) 9x + 3y + 12 = 0 and 18x + 6y + 24 = 0; (iii) 6x − 3y + 10 = 0 and 2x − y + 9 = 0; (iv) x + 2y − 4 = 0 and 2x + 4y − 12 = 0.
hinglish_roman: Ratios se batao ki lines kaatti hain, parallel hain ya coincident: (i) 5x − 4y + 8 = 0 aur 7x + 6y − 9 = 0; (ii) 9x + 3y + 12 = 0 aur 18x + 6y + 24 = 0; (iii) 6x − 3y + 10 = 0 aur 2x − y + 9 = 0; (iv) x + 2y − 4 = 0 aur 2x + 4y − 12 = 0.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Which pairs have solutions? Find them: (i) x + y = 5, 2x + 2y = 10; (ii) x − y = 8, 3x − 3y = 16; (iii) 2x + y − 6 = 0, 4x − 2y − 4 = 0; (iv) 2x − 2y − 2 = 0, 4x − 4y − 5 = 0.
hinglish_roman: Kin jodiyon ke solutions hain? Nikaalo: (i) x + y = 5, 2x + 2y = 10; (ii) x − y = 8, 3x − 3y = 16; (iii) 2x + y − 6 = 0, 4x − 2y − 4 = 0; (iv) 2x − 2y − 2 = 0, 4x − 4y − 5 = 0.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) For what p does 4x + py + 8 = 0, 2x + 2y + 2 = 0 have a unique solution? (b) Find a, b for which (a + b)x − 2by = 5a + 2b + 1 and 3x − y = 14 have infinitely many solutions. (c) Find k so that x + 2y = 3 and (k − 1)x + (k + 1)y = k + 3 are coincident.
hinglish_roman: (a) p ki kis value ke liye 4x + py + 8 = 0, 2x + 2y + 2 = 0 ka unique solution hai? (b) a, b nikaalo jinke liye (a + b)x − 2by = 5a + 2b + 1 aur 3x − y = 14 ke anginat solutions hon. (c) k nikaalo taaki x + 2y = 3 aur (k − 1)x + (k + 1)y = k + 3 coincident hon.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Two numbers have sum 25 and difference 11. (b) Two integers have sum 5 and difference −21. (c) Two numbers differ by 26 and one is three times the other. (d) Adult and child tickets: 2 adults + 3 children = ₹600, 3 adults + 2 children = ₹700. Solve each.
hinglish_roman: (a) Do numbers ka jod 25 aur fark 11 hai. (b) Do integers ka jod 5 aur fark −21 hai. (c) Do numbers ka fark 26 hai aur ek doosre ka teen guna hai. (d) Tickets: 2 bade + 3 bachche = ₹600, 3 bade + 2 bachche = ₹700. Har ek hal karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) 7 bats and 6 balls cost ₹8880; 3 bats and 5 balls cost ₹4000. Find each price. (b) A taxi charges ₹155 for 10 km and ₹220 for 15 km (fixed charge + per km). Find both charges and the fare for 25 km.
hinglish_roman: (a) 7 bats aur 6 balls ₹8880 ke; 3 bats aur 5 balls ₹4000 ke hain. Har ek ki keemat nikaalo. (b) Taxi 10 km ke ₹155 aur 15 km ke ₹220 leti hai (fixed + per km). Dono charges aur 25 km ka kiraaya nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A fraction becomes 9/11 if 2 is added to numerator and denominator, and 5/6 if 3 is added. Find it. (b) Adding 1 to the numerator and subtracting 1 from the denominator gives 1; adding 1 only to the denominator gives 1/2. Find the fraction.
hinglish_roman: (a) Numerator aur denominator mein 2 jodne pe fraction 9/11, aur 3 jodne pe 5/6 ho jaata hai. Fraction nikaalo. (b) Numerator mein 1 jodne aur denominator se 1 ghataane pe 1 milta hai; sirf denominator mein 1 jodne pe 1/2. Fraction nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Five years ago Nuri was thrice as old as Sonu; ten years later she will be twice as old. Find their ages. (b) The digits of a two-digit number sum to 9, and nine times the number is twice its reverse. Find it. (c) Digits sum to 15 and the reversed number exceeds it by 9. Find the number.
hinglish_roman: (a) Paanch saal pehle Nuri, Sonu se teen guna badi thi; das saal baad do guni hogi. Dono ki umar nikaalo. (b) Do-ank number ke ankon ka jod 9 hai, aur number ka nau guna uske ulte ka do guna hai. Number nikaalo. (c) Ankon ka jod 15 hai aur ulta number usse 9 zyada hai. Number nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Meena withdrew ₹2000 in 25 notes of ₹50 and ₹100. How many of each? (b) A library charges a fixed fee for the first 3 days plus a daily charge after that; 7 days cost ₹27 and 5 days ₹21. Find both charges. (c) Half the perimeter of a garden is 36 m and its length is 4 m more than its width. Find its dimensions.
hinglish_roman: (a) Meena ne ₹50 aur ₹100 ke 25 notes mein ₹2000 nikaale. Har ek kitne? (b) Library pehle 3 din ki fixed fee aur uske baad roz ka charge leti hai; 7 din ke ₹27 aur 5 din ke ₹21. Dono charges nikaalo. (c) Garden ka aadha perimeter 36 m aur lambaai chaudaai se 4 m zyada hai. Dimensions nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Solve Mahāvīrāchārya's problem: 9 citrons and 7 wood-apples cost 107; 7 citrons and 9 wood-apples cost 101. What is special about these equations? Use the same trick for 5 pencils + 7 pens = ₹50 and 7 pencils + 5 pens = ₹46.
hinglish_roman: Mahāvīrāchārya ka sawaal hal karo: 9 citrons aur 7 wood-apples ki keemat 107; 7 citrons aur 9 wood-apples ki 101. In equations mein kya khaas hai? Yahi tarika 5 pencil + 7 pen = ₹50 aur 7 pencil + 5 pen = ₹46 pe lagao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) In cyclic quadrilateral ABCD, ∠A = (x + 7)°, ∠B = (y + 8)°, ∠C = (3y + 23)°, ∠D = (4x + 12)°. Find the angles. (b) A train would take 6 hours less at 6 km/h faster and 6 hours more at 4 km/h slower. Find its speed and distance.
hinglish_roman: (a) Cyclic quadrilateral ABCD mein ∠A = (x + 7)°, ∠B = (y + 8)°, ∠C = (3y + 23)°, ∠D = (4x + 12)°. Angles nikaalo. (b) Train 6 km/h tez chalne pe 6 ghante kam aur 4 km/h dheemi chalne pe 6 ghante zyada leti. Speed aur doori nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Plan A costs ₹50 + ₹0.20/minute and Plan B ₹30 + ₹0.30/minute. When is each cheaper and when are they equal? (b) Jacob's watch reads a minutes past 2; 15 minutes later it reads b minutes past 3, with a = 6b. What time was it at the second look? (c) A father's age equals the sum of his four children's ages; in 20 years the children's sum will be twice his age. Find his age.
hinglish_roman: (a) Plan A ₹50 + ₹0.20/minute aur Plan B ₹30 + ₹0.30/minute hai. Kab kaun sasta hai aur kab barabar? (b) Jacob ki ghadi 2 baje ke a minute baad dikhaati hai; 15 minute baad 3 baje ke b minute baad, jahan a = 6b. Doosri baar dekhne pe kya samay tha? (c) Pita ki umar chaar bachchon ki umar ke jod ke barabar hai; 20 saal baad bachchon ka jod uski umar ka do guna hoga. Pita ki umar nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Given 2x + 3y − 8 = 0, write another equation so that the pair gives (i) intersecting lines, (ii) parallel lines, (iii) coincident lines. Also, how many lines have a given slope, and how many have a given slope and pass through a given point?
hinglish_roman: 2x + 3y − 8 = 0 di hai; ek aur equation likho taaki jodi (i) kaatti lines, (ii) parallel lines, (iii) coincident lines de. Saath hi, diye gaye slope ki kitni lines hoti hain, aur diye gaye slope aur point se guzarne waali kitni?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the history of solving systems of linear equations?
hinglish_roman: Linear equations ke systems hal karne ka itihaas kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) In y = mx + d, m is the ______ and d is the ______. (b) The x-intercept of y = mx + c (m ≠ 0) is ______. (c) The slope of a vertical line is ______ and of a horizontal line is ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) y = mx + d mein m ______ aur d ______ hai. (b) y = mx + c (m ≠ 0) ka x-intercept ______ hai. (c) Vertical line ka slope ______ aur horizontal line ka ______ hai.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: Give the total surface area and volume of a cuboid and a cube. Why is the volume of a cuboid lwh?
hinglish_roman: Cuboid aur cube ka total surface area aur volume batao. Cuboid ka volume lwh kyun hota hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: Cube A has side 6 cm and cuboid B is 9 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm. Compare their volumes and surface areas. Why does this matter in real life?
hinglish_roman: Cube A ki bhuja 6 cm aur cuboid B 9 cm × 6 cm × 4 cm hai. Inke volume aur surface area ki tulna karo. Asli zindagi mein ye kyun maayne rakhta hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A cube has volume 64 cm³. Find its TSA. (b) How many 20 cm cubes fit in a 2 m cubical box? (c) How many 2 m × 1.25 m × 1 m boxes fill a 40 m × 25 m × 10 m godown? (d) Two cubes of volume 125 cm³ are joined end to end. Find the surface area of the cuboid.
hinglish_roman: (a) Cube ka volume 64 cm³ hai. TSA nikaalo. (b) 2 m ke cubical box mein 20 cm ke kitne cubes aayenge? (c) 40 m × 25 m × 10 m ke godown mein 2 m × 1.25 m × 1 m ke kitne box aayenge? (d) 125 cm³ ke do cubes sire se jode gaye. Bane cuboid ka surface area nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A 4 cm cube is cut into 1 cm cubes. Compare the total surface areas. Why does this matter in biology? (b) Three faces of a cuboid meeting at a corner have areas 6, 15 and 10 cm². Find its volume.
hinglish_roman: (a) 4 cm ke cube ko 1 cm ke cubes mein kaata gaya. Total surface areas ki tulna karo. Biology mein ye kyun maayne rakhta hai? (b) Cuboid ke ek kone pe milne waale teen faces ke area 6, 15 aur 10 cm² hain. Volume nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: A 5 cm cube painted on all faces is cut into 1 cm cubes. How many small cubes have exactly 3, 2, 1 and 0 painted faces? Also, how many unit cubes must be added to a cube of side a to make one of side a + 1?
hinglish_roman: Saare faces pe paint kiya 5 cm ka cube 1 cm ke cubes mein kaata gaya. Kitne chhote cubes ke theek 3, 2, 1 aur 0 faces paint hain? Saath hi, a bhuja ke cube ko a + 1 bhuja ka banaane ke liye kitne unit cubes jodne padenge?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is a right circular cylinder? Derive its curved surface area, total surface area and volume. What is a cross-section?
hinglish_roman: Right circular cylinder kya hai? Iska curved surface area, total surface area aur volume derive karo. Cross-section kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Savitri makes a cylindrical kaleidoscope 25 cm long with radius 3.5 cm. How much chart paper is needed for its curved surface (π = 22/7)? (b) The largest cylinder is cut out of a cube of edge r cm. Find its volume.
hinglish_roman: (a) Savitri 25 cm lamba aur 3.5 cm radius ka cylindrical kaleidoscope banaati hai. Curved surface ke liye kitna chart paper chahiye (π = 22/7)? (b) r cm edge ke cube se sabse bada cylinder kaata gaya. Uska volume nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Cylinder B has twice the radius and half the height of A. Find the ratios of their CSAs and volumes. (b) Two cylinders have radii in ratio 2 : 3 and heights 3 : 2. Find the ratios of their volumes and CSAs.
hinglish_roman: (a) Cylinder B ka radius A ka do guna aur oonchaai aadhi hai. CSAs aur volumes ke ratio nikaalo. (b) Do cylinders ke radii 2 : 3 aur oonchaaiyan 3 : 2 ke ratio mein hain. Volumes aur CSAs ke ratio nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A cylinder's radius is increased by 10% and its height decreased by x%, keeping the volume the same. Find x. (b) A 12 cm metal cube is melted into rods of radius 2 cm and height 12 cm. How many complete rods can be made (π ≈ 22/7)?
hinglish_roman: (a) Cylinder ka radius 10% badhaaya aur oonchaai x% ghataayi, volume same rakhte hue. x nikaalo. (b) 12 cm ke metal cube ko pighlaakar 2 cm radius aur 12 cm oonchaai ki rods banaayi gayi. Kitni poori rods banengi (π ≈ 22/7)?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: How is a right circular cone formed? Derive its curved surface area and give its total surface area.
hinglish_roman: Right circular cone kaise banta hai? Iska curved surface area derive karo aur total surface area batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is the volume of a cone? How can the factor 1/3 be verified experimentally? Who first found it?
hinglish_roman: Cone ka volume kya hai? 1/3 factor ko experiment se kaise jaanch sakte hain? Ise sabse pehle kisne khoja?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A right triangle with sides 5, 12, 13 cm is rotated about the 12 cm side. Find the volume of the solid. (b) A 6-8-10 cm right triangle is rotated about the 8 cm side. Find the volume and CSA (π ≈ 22/7).
hinglish_roman: (a) 5, 12, 13 cm bhujaon waale right triangle ko 12 cm bhuja ke chaaron taraf ghumaaya gaya. Bane solid ka volume nikaalo. (b) 6-8-10 cm right triangle ko 8 cm bhuja ke chaaron taraf ghumaaya. Volume aur CSA nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Find the TSA of a cone with slant height 21 m and base diameter 24 m (π ≈ 22/7). (b) Find the CSA of a cone with slant height 10 cm and radius 7 cm. (c) A cone has height 16 cm and radius 12 cm; find its CSA and TSA (π ≈ 3.14).
hinglish_roman: (a) 21 m slant height aur 24 m base diameter waale cone ka TSA nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7). (b) 10 cm slant height aur 7 cm radius waale cone ka CSA nikaalo. (c) Cone ki oonchaai 16 cm aur radius 12 cm hai; CSA aur TSA nikaalo (π ≈ 3.14).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A cone of height 15 cm has volume 1570 cm³. Find its radius (π ≈ 3.14). (b) A cone's CSA is 308 cm² and slant height 14 cm. Find its radius and TSA (π ≈ 22/7). (c) Find the sheet needed for 10 conical joker caps of radius 7 cm and height 24 cm.
hinglish_roman: (a) 15 cm oonchaai waale cone ka volume 1570 cm³ hai. Radius nikaalo (π ≈ 3.14). (b) Cone ka CSA 308 cm² aur slant height 14 cm hai. Radius aur TSA nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7). (c) 7 cm radius aur 24 cm oonchaai ki 10 conical joker caps ke liye sheet nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) What length of 3 m wide tarpaulin is needed for a conical tent of height 8 m and radius 6 m, with 20 cm extra for margins (π ≈ 3.14)? (b) A conical cup is filled with water to half its depth. What fraction of the cup's volume is water?
hinglish_roman: (a) 8 m oonchaai aur 6 m radius ke conical tent ke liye 3 m chaudi tirpal kitni lambi chahiye, 20 cm extra margin ke saath (π ≈ 3.14)? (b) Conical cup aadhi gehraai tak paani se bhara hai. Cup ke volume ka kitna hissa paani hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is a pyramidal shape? Give its volume formula and examples. How is its surface area found?
hinglish_roman: Pyramidal shape kya hai? Iska volume formula aur examples do. Iska surface area kaise nikaalte hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is a sphere? How did Archimedes find its surface area? How can 4πr² be verified with a ball and string?
hinglish_roman: Sphere kya hai? Archimedes ne iska surface area kaise nikaala? Gend aur dhaage se 4πr² kaise jaanch sakte hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is the volume of a sphere? Explain the link with the cone formula using thin cones.
hinglish_roman: Sphere ka volume kya hai? Patle cones ki madad se cone ke formula se iska sambandh samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is a hemisphere? Give its curved surface area, total surface area and volume, with examples.
hinglish_roman: Hemisphere kya hai? Iska curved surface area, total surface area aur volume examples ke saath batao.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Find the surface area of a ball bearing of radius 0.7 cm. (b) Find the volume of water a hemispherical bowl of radius 3.5 cm holds. (c) Find the CSA and TSA of a hemisphere of radius 21 cm (π ≈ 22/7).
hinglish_roman: (a) 0.7 cm radius waale ball bearing ka surface area nikaalo. (b) 3.5 cm radius ki hemispherical katori kitna paani rakh sakti hai? (c) 21 cm radius waale hemisphere ka CSA aur TSA nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Two metal spheres weigh 5920 g and 740 g; the smaller has diameter 5 cm. Find the radius of the larger. (b) The moon's diameter is about 1/4 of the earth's. Find the ratio of their surface areas. (c) A sphere's radius increases by 10%; show its volume increases by about 33.1%. (d) If the volume rises by 72.8%, by what % did the radius rise?
hinglish_roman: (a) Do metal ke spheres 5920 g aur 740 g ke hain; chhote ka diameter 5 cm hai. Bade ka radius nikaalo. (b) Chaand ka diameter prithvi ka lagbhag 1/4 hai. Surface areas ka ratio nikaalo. (c) Sphere ka radius 10% badhta hai; dikhaao ki volume lagbhag 33.1% badhta hai. (d) Agar volume 72.8% badhe, toh radius kitne % badha?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) 16 metal spheres of radius 2 cm are packed in a 16 × 8 × 8 cm box filled with liquid. Find the liquid volume. (b) A hemispherical dome has base circumference 35.2 m. Find the cost of painting it at ₹10 per 100 cm² (π ≈ 22/7).
hinglish_roman: (a) 2 cm radius ke 16 metal spheres 16 × 8 × 8 cm ke box mein rakhkar box liquid se bhara gaya. Liquid ka volume nikaalo. (b) Hemispherical gumbad ke base ki circumference 35.2 m hai. ₹10 per 100 cm² ki dar se use paint karne ka kharcha nikaalo (π ≈ 22/7).

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Show that a sphere's volume is 2/3 of the smallest cylinder enclosing it. (b) A string around the earth's equator is replaced by one 1 m longer, lifted evenly. How high is it above the ground? What about for the moon, Jupiter or a volleyball?
hinglish_roman: (a) Dikhaao ki sphere ka volume use gherne waale sabse chhote cylinder ka 2/3 hai. (b) Prithvi ki equator pe lipti dorii ko 1 m lambi dorii se badla gaya, jo har jagah barabar oonchaai pe hai. Ye zameen se kitni oonchi hai? Chaand, Jupiter ya volleyball ke liye?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A school serves milk in cylindrical glasses of diameter 7 cm filled to 12 cm. How many litres for 1600 students? (b) A glass of radius 4 cm has water at 16 cm; how many 1 cm-radius marbles must a crow drop to raise it to 20 cm? (c) Which is more chocolate: one 50 mm cube or a hundred 10 mm cubes?
hinglish_roman: (a) School 7 cm diameter ke cylindrical glasses mein 12 cm tak doodh deta hai. 1600 students ke liye kitne litre? (b) 4 cm radius ke glass mein 16 cm tak paani hai; 20 cm tak laane ke liye kauwe ko 1 cm radius ki kitni goliyan daalni hongi? (c) Zyada chocolate kisme: ek 50 mm cube ya sau 10 mm cubes?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) A sphere of radius 5 cm has 5 times the surface area of the curved surface of a cone of radius 4 cm. Find the cone's height and volume. (b) A square pyramid sits inside a cylinder of radius r and height h, with its base corners on the cylinder's base circle and apex on top. Find the ratio of their volumes.
hinglish_roman: (a) 5 cm radius ke sphere ka surface area 4 cm radius waale cone ki curved surface ka 5 guna hai. Cone ki oonchaai aur volume nikaalo. (b) r radius aur h oonchaai ke cylinder ke andar square pyramid hai, base ke kone cylinder ke base circle pe aur apex upar. Volumes ka ratio nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) By how much does a cuboid's volume change if its length increases by 1 unit? (b) A cylinder's radius increases by 1 unit? (c) A sphere's radius decreases by 1 unit? (d) Express a cube's surface area S in terms of its volume V, and vice versa.
hinglish_roman: (a) Cuboid ki lambaai 1 unit badhne pe volume kitna badalta hai? (b) Cylinder ka radius 1 unit badhne pe? (c) Sphere ka radius 1 unit ghatne pe? (d) Cube ke surface area S ko volume V mein likho, aur ulta.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: What is a guesstimate? Explain with the golgappa example: a cylindrical vessel of radius 10 cm holds pani 50 cm deep. How many golgappas can be served?
hinglish_roman: Guesstimate kya hai? Golgappa example se samjhao: 10 cm radius ke cylindrical bartan mein 50 cm tak pani hai. Kitne golgappe serve ho sakte hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: How many tennis balls of radius 3 cm fit in a 30 ft × 30 ft × 15 ft classroom? Why can't you just divide the room's volume by a ball's volume?
hinglish_roman: 30 ft × 30 ft × 15 ft ki class mein 3 cm radius ki kitni tennis balls aayengi? Kamre ke volume ko ball ke volume se seedha bhaag kyun nahi de sakte?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: (a) Taking Earth's radius 6370 km, Jupiter's 69,900 km and the Sun's 6,95,700 km, find the ratios of the volumes of Jupiter and the Sun to Earth's. (b) If Earth's 1.38 billion km³ of water formed a uniform layer over a sphere of radius 6371 km, about how thick would it be?
hinglish_roman: (a) Prithvi ka radius 6370 km, Jupiter ka 69,900 km aur Sooraj ka 6,95,700 km lekar Jupiter aur Sooraj ke volume ka Prithvi se ratio nikaalo. (b) Agar Prithvi ka 1.38 billion km³ paani 6371 km radius ke sphere pe ek-samaan parat bane, toh woh lagbhag kitni moti hogi?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Math of Space: Surface Area and Volume
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) Volume of a cone = ______. (b) Surface area of a sphere = ______. (c) Volume of a hemisphere = ______. (d) TSA of a cylinder closed at both ends = ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) Cone ka volume = ______. (b) Sphere ka surface area = ______. (c) Hemisphere ka volume = ______. (d) Dono sire band cylinder ka TSA = ______.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic. What does 'unique' mean here?
hinglish_roman: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic batao. Yahan 'unique' ka kya matlab hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Who first stated and who first proved the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic?
hinglish_roman: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic sabse pehle kisne likha aur kisne siddh kiya?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Express as a product of prime factors: (i) 140, (ii) 156, (iii) 3825, (iv) 5005, (v) 7429.
hinglish_roman: Prime factors ke guna ke roop mein likho: (i) 140, (ii) 156, (iii) 3825, (iv) 5005, (v) 7429.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How are HCF and LCM found by the prime factorisation method? How are HCF and LCM of two numbers related? Illustrate with 6 and 20.
hinglish_roman: Prime factorisation method se HCF aur LCM kaise nikaalte hain? Do numbers ke HCF aur LCM ka kya sambandh hai? 6 aur 20 se dikhaao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) Find the HCF and LCM of 96 and 404. (b) Find the HCF and LCM of 6, 72 and 120. Is the product of the three numbers equal to HCF × LCM?
hinglish_roman: (a) 96 aur 404 ka HCF aur LCM nikaalo. (b) 6, 72 aur 120 ka HCF aur LCM nikaalo. Kya teeno ka guna HCF × LCM ke barabar hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the HCF and LCM of each pair and verify LCM × HCF = product: (i) 26 and 91, (ii) 510 and 92, (iii) 336 and 54.
hinglish_roman: Har jodi ka HCF aur LCM nikaalo aur LCM × HCF = guna jaancho: (i) 26 aur 91, (ii) 510 aur 92, (iii) 336 aur 54.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the HCF and LCM by prime factorisation: (i) 12, 15 and 21; (ii) 17, 23 and 29; (iii) 8, 9 and 25. Also find LCM(306, 657) given HCF(306, 657) = 9.
hinglish_roman: Prime factorisation se HCF aur LCM nikaalo: (i) 12, 15 aur 21; (ii) 17, 23 aur 29; (iii) 8, 9 aur 25. Saath hi HCF(306, 657) = 9 diya hai, LCM(306, 657) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Can 4ⁿ or 6ⁿ end with the digit 0 for any natural number n? Justify using the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic.
hinglish_roman: Kya kisi natural number n ke liye 4ⁿ ya 6ⁿ ka aakhri ank 0 ho sakta hai? Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic se samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Explain why 7 × 11 × 13 + 13 and 7 × 6 × 5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 + 5 are composite numbers.
hinglish_roman: Samjhao ki 7 × 11 × 13 + 13 aur 7 × 6 × 5 × 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 + 5 composite numbers kyun hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Sonia takes 18 minutes and Ravi 12 minutes to drive one round of a circular path. If they start together from the same point in the same direction, after how many minutes will they meet again at the start?
hinglish_roman: Sonia ko gol raaste ka ek chakkar lagaane mein 18 minute aur Ravi ko 12 minute lagte hain. Agar dono ek hi point se, ek hi disha mein saath shuru karein, toh kitne minute baad shuruaati point pe phir milenge?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State and prove Theorem 1.2: if a prime p divides a², then p divides a.
hinglish_roman: Theorem 1.2 batao aur siddh karo: agar prime p, a² ko divide kare, toh p, a ko divide karta hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Prove that √2 is irrational.
hinglish_roman: Siddh karo ki √2 irrational hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Prove that √3 is irrational. Similarly, prove that √5 is irrational.
hinglish_roman: Siddh karo ki √3 irrational hai. Isi tarah siddh karo ki √5 irrational hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Show that 5 − √3 and 3√2 are irrational.
hinglish_roman: Dikhaao ki 5 − √3 aur 3√2 irrational hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Prove that the following are irrational: (i) 3 + 2√5, (ii) 1/√2, (iii) 7√5, (iv) 6 + √2.
hinglish_roman: Siddh karo ki ye irrational hain: (i) 3 + 2√5, (ii) 1/√2, (iii) 7√5, (iv) 6 + √2.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Is HCF × LCM equal to the product for three numbers p, q, r? What formulas hold instead?
hinglish_roman: Kya teen numbers p, q, r ke liye HCF × LCM unke guna ke barabar hai? Iski jagah kaun se formulas sahi hain?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (a) Every composite number has a unique prime factorisation, apart from order. (b) If 3 divides a², then 3 divides a. (c) The product of a non-zero rational and an irrational number is rational. (d) HCF of two consecutive primes is 1.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Har composite number ka prime factorisation unique hai, kram ko chhodkar. (b) Agar 3, a² ko divide kare, toh 3, a ko divide karta hai. (c) Non-zero rational aur irrational number ka guna rational hota hai. (d) Do lagaataar primes ka HCF 1 hai.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: (a) HCF is the product of the ______ power of each common prime factor. (b) LCM is the product of the ______ power of each prime factor involved. (c) For two positive integers a, b: HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: (a) HCF har common prime factor ki ______ power ka guna hai. (b) LCM har shaamil prime factor ki ______ power ka guna hai. (c) Do positive integers a, b ke liye HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = ______.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What are the degree of a polynomial and linear, quadratic and cubic polynomials? Give their general forms.
hinglish_roman: Polynomial ki degree aur linear, quadratic aur cubic polynomials kya hain? Inke general roop batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the value of a polynomial at x = k, and what is a zero of a polynomial? Find the zeroes of x² − 3x − 4 and of a linear polynomial ax + b.
hinglish_roman: x = k pe polynomial ki value kya hai, aur polynomial ka zero kya hai? x² − 3x − 4 aur linear polynomial ax + b ke zeroes nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is the geometrical meaning of the zeroes of a polynomial? Explain for linear and quadratic polynomials.
hinglish_roman: Polynomial ke zeroes ka geometrical matlab kya hai? Linear aur quadratic polynomials ke liye samjhao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How many zeroes can a quadratic polynomial have? Describe the three cases for the graph of y = ax² + bx + c.
hinglish_roman: Quadratic polynomial ke kitne zeroes ho sakte hain? y = ax² + bx + c ke graph ke teen cases batao.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How many zeroes can a cubic polynomial have? Illustrate with x³ − 4x, x³ and x³ − x². What is the general rule for degree n?
hinglish_roman: Cubic polynomial ke kitne zeroes ho sakte hain? x³ − 4x, x³ aur x³ − x² se dikhaao. Degree n ke liye general niyam kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Derive the relationship between the zeroes and coefficients of a quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c.
hinglish_roman: Quadratic polynomial ax² + bx + c ke zeroes aur coefficients ka sambandh derive karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the zeroes and verify the relationship with coefficients: (a) 2x² − 8x + 6, (b) 3x² + 5x − 2, (c) x² + 7x + 10, (d) x² − 3.
hinglish_roman: Zeroes nikaalo aur coefficients se sambandh jaancho: (a) 2x² − 8x + 6, (b) 3x² + 5x − 2, (c) x² + 7x + 10, (d) x² − 3.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the zeroes and verify the relationships: (i) x² − 2x − 8, (ii) 4s² − 4s + 1, (iii) 6x² − 3 − 7x.
hinglish_roman: Zeroes nikaalo aur sambandh jaancho: (i) x² − 2x − 8, (ii) 4s² − 4s + 1, (iii) 6x² − 3 − 7x.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find the zeroes and verify the relationships: (iv) 4u² + 8u, (v) t² − 15, (vi) 3x² − x − 4.
hinglish_roman: Zeroes nikaalo aur sambandh jaancho: (iv) 4u² + 8u, (v) t² − 15, (vi) 3x² − x − 4.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find a quadratic polynomial whose zeroes have sum −3 and product 2. Is it unique?
hinglish_roman: Aisa quadratic polynomial nikaalo jiske zeroes ka jod −3 aur guna 2 ho. Kya ye unique hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Find quadratic polynomials whose zeroes have the given sum and product: (i) 1/4, −1; (ii) √2, 1/3; (iii) 0, √5; (iv) 1, 1; (v) −1/4, 1/4; (vi) 4, 1.
hinglish_roman: Diye gaye jod aur guna waale zeroes ke quadratic polynomials nikaalo: (i) 1/4, −1; (ii) √2, 1/3; (iii) 0, √5; (iv) 1, 1; (v) −1/4, 1/4; (vi) 4, 1.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: State the relationships between the zeroes α, β, γ and coefficients of a cubic ax³ + bx² + cx + d. Verify them for 2x³ − 5x² − 14x + 8, whose zeroes are 4, −2 and 1/2.
hinglish_roman: Cubic ax³ + bx² + cx + d ke zeroes α, β, γ aur coefficients ke sambandh batao. 2x³ − 5x² − 14x + 8 ke liye jaancho, jiske zeroes 4, −2 aur 1/2 hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Verify that 3, −1 and −1/3 are the zeroes of p(x) = 3x³ − 5x² − 11x − 3, and verify the relationships with the coefficients.
hinglish_roman: Jaancho ki 3, −1 aur −1/3, p(x) = 3x³ − 5x² − 11x − 3 ke zeroes hain, aur coefficients se sambandh jaancho.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: How do you find the number of zeroes of p(x) from the graph of y = p(x)? What can you say if the graph touches the x-axis at one point, or never meets it?
hinglish_roman: y = p(x) ke graph se p(x) ke zeroes ki sankhya kaise nikaalte hain? Agar graph x-axis ko ek point pe chhooe, ya kabhi na mile, toh kya kehenge?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: True or False: (a) A quadratic polynomial can have three zeroes. (b) The zero of 2x + 3 is −3/2. (c) If a < 0, the parabola y = ax² + bx + c opens downwards. (d) A polynomial of degree n has exactly n real zeroes.
hinglish_roman: Sahi ya galat: (a) Quadratic polynomial ke teen zeroes ho sakte hain. (b) 2x + 3 ka zero −3/2 hai. (c) Agar a < 0, toh parabola y = ax² + bx + c neeche khulta hai. (d) Degree n ke polynomial ke theek n real zeroes hote hain.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Fill in the blanks: For ax² + bx + c with zeroes α, β: (a) α + β = ______, (b) αβ = ______. For ax³ + bx² + cx + d with zeroes α, β, γ: (c) αβγ = ______.
hinglish_roman: Khaali jagah bharo: zeroes α, β waale ax² + bx + c ke liye: (a) α + β = ______, (b) αβ = ______. Zeroes α, β, γ waale ax³ + bx² + cx + d ke liye: (c) αβγ = ______.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Akhila's Hoopla games are half her Giant Wheel rides. A ride costs ₹3 and a Hoopla game ₹4, and she spent ₹20. Form the equations and find how many rides and games she had.
hinglish_roman: Akhila ke Hoopla games uski Giant Wheel rides ke aadhe hain. Ek ride ₹3 ki aur ek Hoopla game ₹4 ka hai, aur usne ₹20 kharch kiye. Equations banao aur batao kitni rides aur games hue.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: What are consistent, inconsistent and dependent pairs of linear equations? How do they relate to the graphs of the lines?
hinglish_roman: Linear equations ki consistent, inconsistent aur dependent jodi kya hai? Inka lines ke graph se kya sambandh hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Use the ratios a₁/a₂, b₁/b₂, c₁/c₂ to classify these pairs: x − 2y = 0 & 3x + 4y − 20 = 0; 2x + 3y − 9 = 0 & 4x + 6y − 18 = 0; x + 2y − 4 = 0 & 2x + 4y − 12 = 0.
hinglish_roman: Ratios a₁/a₂, b₁/b₂, c₁/c₂ se in jodiyon ko classify karo: x − 2y = 0 aur 3x + 4y − 20 = 0; 2x + 3y − 9 = 0 aur 4x + 6y − 18 = 0; x + 2y − 4 = 0 aur 2x + 4y − 12 = 0.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Are these pairs consistent or inconsistent? (i) 3x + 2y = 5; 2x − 3y = 7 (ii) 2x − 3y = 8; 4x − 6y = 9 (iii) (3/2)x + (5/3)y = 7; 9x − 10y = 14 (iv) 5x − 3y = 11; −10x + 6y = −22 (v) (4/3)x + 2y = 8; 2x + 3y = 12
hinglish_roman: Ye jodiyan consistent hain ya inconsistent? (i) 3x + 2y = 5; 2x − 3y = 7 (ii) 2x − 3y = 8; 4x − 6y = 9 (iii) (3/2)x + (5/3)y = 7; 9x − 10y = 14 (iv) 5x − 3y = 11; −10x + 6y = −22 (v) (4/3)x + 2y = 8; 2x + 3y = 12

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Determine whether 5x − 8y + 1 = 0 and 3x − (24/5)y + 3/5 = 0 have no solution, a unique solution or infinitely many solutions.
hinglish_roman: Batao ki 5x − 8y + 1 = 0 aur 3x − (24/5)y + 3/5 = 0 ka koi solution nahi, unique solution hai ya anginat solutions hain.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Champa says: the number of skirts is two less than twice the number of pants, and also four less than four times the number of pants. Find how many of each she bought, graphically.
hinglish_roman: Champa kehti hai: skirts ki sankhya pants ki do guni se do kam hai, aur pants ki chaar guni se chaar kam bhi. Graph se nikaalo ki usne har ek kitne khareede.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Draw the graphs of x − y + 1 = 0 and 3x + 2y − 12 = 0. Find the vertices of the triangle formed by these lines and the x-axis.
hinglish_roman: x − y + 1 = 0 aur 3x + 2y − 12 = 0 ke graphs banao. In lines aur x-axis se bane triangle ke vertices nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: List the steps of the substitution method. What does it mean if you get a statement with no variable?
hinglish_roman: Substitution method ke steps batao. Agar aisa statement mile jisme koi variable na ho toh iska kya matlab hai?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Aftab tells his daughter: 'Seven years ago I was seven times as old as you; three years from now I shall be three times as old as you.' Find their present ages by substitution.
hinglish_roman: Aftab apni beti se kehta hai: 'Saat saal pehle main tumse saat guna bada tha; teen saal baad main tumse teen guna bada hounga.' Substitution se dono ki abhi ki umar nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: (a) 2 pencils and 3 erasers cost ₹9, and 4 pencils and 6 erasers cost ₹18. Can a unique price be found? (b) Two rails are x + 2y − 4 = 0 and 2x + 4y − 12 = 0. Will they cross?
hinglish_roman: (a) 2 pencil aur 3 rubber ₹9 ke, aur 4 pencil aur 6 rubber ₹18 ke hain. Kya unique keemat nikal sakti hai? (b) Do patriyan x + 2y − 4 = 0 aur 2x + 4y − 12 = 0 hain. Kya ye kaategi?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
hinglish_roman: Substitution se hal karo: (i) x + y = 14, x − y = 4; (ii) s − t = 3, s/3 + t/2 = 6; (iii) 0.2x + 0.3y = 1.3, 0.4x + 0.5y = 2.3; (iv) 3x − y = 3, 9x − 3y = 9.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Solve: (i) √2x + √3y = 0, √3x − √8y = 0; (ii) 3x/2 − 5y/3 = −2, x/3 + y/2 = 13/6. Also solve 2x + 3y = 11, 2x − 4y = −24 and find m if y = mx + 3.
hinglish_roman: Hal karo: (i) √2x + √3y = 0, √3x − √8y = 0; (ii) 3x/2 − 5y/3 = −2, x/3 + y/2 = 13/6. Saath hi 2x + 3y = 11, 2x − 4y = −24 hal karo aur y = mx + 3 ke liye m nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: (a) The larger of two supplementary angles exceeds the smaller by 18°. Find them. (b) A coach buys 7 bats and 6 balls for ₹3800 and 3 bats and 5 balls for ₹1750. Find each price.
hinglish_roman: (a) Do supplementary angles mein bada chhote se 18° zyada hai. Angles nikaalo. (b) Coach 7 bats aur 6 balls ₹3800 mein aur 3 bats aur 5 balls ₹1750 mein khareedti hai. Har ek ki keemat nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: (a) A taxi charges ₹105 for 10 km and ₹155 for 15 km (fixed charge + per km). Find the charges and the fare for 25 km. (b) In five years Jacob will be three times his son's age; five years ago he was seven times his son's age. Find their present ages.
hinglish_roman: (a) Taxi 10 km ke ₹105 aur 15 km ke ₹155 leti hai (fixed + per km). Charges aur 25 km ka kiraaya nikaalo. (b) Paanch saal baad Jacob apne bete se teen guna bada hoga; paanch saal pehle saat guna tha. Dono ki abhi ki umar nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: List the steps of the elimination method. What do true and false statements without variables indicate?
hinglish_roman: Elimination method ke steps batao. Bina variable ke sahi aur galat statements kya darshaate hain?

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Use elimination to find all solutions of 2x + 3y = 8 and 4x + 6y = 7.
hinglish_roman: Elimination se 2x + 3y = 8 aur 4x + 6y = 7 ke saare solutions nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Solve by elimination: (i) x + y = 5, 2x − 3y = 4; (ii) 3x + 4y = 10, 2x − 2y = 2; (iii) 3x − 5y − 4 = 0, 9x = 2y + 7; (iv) x/2 + 2y/3 = −1, x − y/3 = 3.
hinglish_roman: Elimination se hal karo: (i) x + y = 5, 2x − 3y = 4; (ii) 3x + 4y = 10, 2x − 2y = 2; (iii) 3x − 5y − 4 = 0, 9x = 2y + 7; (iv) x/2 + 2y/3 = −1, x − y/3 = 3.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: The sum of a two-digit number and its reverse is 66 and the digits differ by 2. Using elimination, find all such numbers.
hinglish_roman: Do-ank number aur uske ulte ka jod 66 hai aur ankon ka fark 2 hai. Elimination se aise saare numbers nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
original_english: Why are algebraic methods often preferred over the graphical method? Compare substitution and elimination.
hinglish_roman: Graphical method ki jagah algebraic methods aksar kyun pasand kiye jaate hain? Substitution aur elimination ki tulna karo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: What is a quadratic equation? What is its standard form?
hinglish_roman: Quadratic equation kya hoti hai? Iska standard form kya hai?

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Who contributed to solving quadratic equations historically?
