hinglish_roman: (a) Gullak mein sau 50p, pachaas ₹1, bees ₹2 aur das ₹5 ke sikke hain. P(50p) aur P(₹5 nahi) nikaalo. (b) Box mein 5 laal, 8 safed aur 4 hari goliyaan hain. P(laal), P(safed), P(hari nahi) nikaalo. (c) Die ke faces pe A, B, C, D, E, A hain. P(A) aur P(D) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: (a) A carton of 100 shirts has 88 good, 8 with minor defects and 4 with major defects. Jimmy accepts only good shirts; Sujatha rejects only major defects. Find each acceptance probability. (b) Of 144 pens, 20 are defective; Nuri buys only a good one. Find P(she buys) and P(she doesn't).
hinglish_roman: (a) 100 shirts ke carton mein 88 achchhi, 8 mein chhoti kami aur 4 mein badi kami hai. Jimmy sirf achchhi leta hai; Sujatha sirf badi kami waali lautaati hai. Dono ki sweekaar probability nikaalo. (b) 144 pens mein 20 kharaab hain; Nuri sirf achchha khareedti hai. P(khareedegi) aur P(nahi khareedegi) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: A die is thrown twice. Find P(5 does not come up either time) and P(5 comes up at least once).
hinglish_roman: Die do baar phenka gaya. P(dono baar 5 na aaye) aur P(kam se kam ek baar 5 aaye) nikaalo.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Which arguments are correct? (i) Two coins have three outcomes (two heads, two tails, one of each), so each has probability 1/3. (ii) A die gives odd or even, so P(odd) = 1/2. (iii) Two dice give sums 2 to 12, eleven outcomes, so each sum has probability 1/11.
hinglish_roman: Kaun se tark sahi hain? (i) Do sikkon ke teen outcomes (do head, do tail, ek-ek) hain, toh har ek ki probability 1/3. (ii) Die pe odd ya even aata hai, toh P(odd) = 1/2. (iii) Do dice ke jod 2 se 12, gyaarah outcomes, toh har jod ki probability 1/11.

subject: Mathematics
original_english: Which experiments have equally likely outcomes? (i) A car starts or does not start. (ii) A basketball shot is made or missed. (iii) A true-false question is guessed right or wrong. (iv) A baby is a boy or a girl. Also, why is a coin toss a fair way to decide which team gets the ball first?

hinglish_roman: Hum averages kyun use karte hain, aur unki seemayein kya hain?

subject: Social Science
original_english: How does the government spread awareness about consumer rights?
hinglish_roman: Sarkar consumer adhikaaron ke baare mein jaagrukta kaise failaati hai?

subject: Social Science
original_english: Critically examine the progress of the consumer movement in India.
hinglish_roman: India mein consumer movement ki pragati ki aalochnaatmak jaanch karo.

subject: Social Science
original_english: What changes were made by the 2019 amendment of COPRA?
hinglish_roman: COPRA ke 2019 sanshodhan mein kya badlav kiye gaye?

subject: Social Science
original_english: True or False: COPRA applies only to goods.
hinglish_roman: True ya False: COPRA sirf saamaan pe laagu hota hai.

subject: Social Science
original_english: True or False: The consumer redressal process is very simple and quick.
hinglish_roman: True ya False: Consumer nivaaran prakriya bahut aasaan aur tez hai.

subject: Social Science
original_english: True or False: A consumer has the right to get compensation depending on the degree of the damage.
hinglish_roman: True ya False: Consumer ko nuksaan ki maatra ke hisaab se muaavza paane ka haq hai.

subject: Social Science
original_english: Why is it said that consumer movements can be effective only with consumers' active involvement?
hinglish_roman: Kyun kaha jaata hai ki consumer movement sirf consumers ki sakriya bhaagidaari se hi asardaar ho sakta hai?

subject: Social Science
original_english: Fill in the blanks: There are more than ______ consumer groups in India, of which only about ______ are well organised and recognised. COPRA was amended in the year ______.
hinglish_roman: Blank bharo: India mein ______ se zyada consumer groups hain, jinme sirf lagbhag ______ achhe se sangathit aur maanyata praapt hain. COPRA ko ______ mein sanshodhit kiya gaya.

subject: Social Science
original_english: India has more than 2000 consumer groups, of which only about 50-60 are well organised and recognised. Roughly what percentage of consumer groups are well organised?
hinglish_roman: India mein 2000 se zyada consumer groups hain, jinme sirf lagbhag 50-60 achhe se sangathit aur maanyata praapt hain. Lagbhag kitne percent groups achhe se sangathit hain?

subject: Social Science
original_english: Assertion (A): It is often difficult for consumers to gather evidence in consumer cases. Reason (R): In most purchases cash memos are not issued. Choose: (a) Both A and R true, R explains A (b) Both true, R does not explain A (c) A true, R false (d) A false, R true
hinglish_roman: Assertion (A): Consumer cases mein saboot ikattha karna aksar mushkil hota hai. Reason (R): Zyadatar khareedari mein cash memo nahi diya jaata. Chuno: (a) A aur R dono sahi, R A ko samjhata hai (b) Dono sahi, R A ko nahi samjhata (c) A sahi, R galat (d) A galat, R sahi

subject: Social Science
original_english: Describe some of your duties as a consumer when you visit a shopping complex.
hinglish_roman: Shopping complex jaane pe ek consumer ke roop mein apne kuch kartavya batao.

subject: Social Science
original_english: Which of these offers would really benefit consumers: '15 gm more in every 500 gm pack' or 'Scratch and win gifts worth ₹10 lakhs'?
hinglish_roman: Inme se kaun sa offer sach mein consumers ke kaam ka hai: 'Har 500 gm pack mein 15 gm zyada' ya 'Scratch karo aur ₹10 lakh ke inaam jeeto'?
